# 2024: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 5,305 Wikipedia event assertions across 366 dates, with pinned source revisions, actual topic hierarchy and original citations. The SQLite database is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

The sources reflect Wikipedia’s selection and wording. They are not guaranteed exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not mean every event has been independently checked. Original errors and dated reporting figures remain visible; separately labeled editorial accounts record the limited checks actually performed.

Database: [2024.sqlite](2024.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `33e38d946c5b2c064a900398491e3e8db54d4ad7eb709544f871963ae796c445`. Publication contract: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `preservation-extraction-2024-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

The 6 entries originally lacking attached citations have separately cited editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 4; partial: 2; events without a full-event review: 5,299. Partial reviews do not establish every detail of the original statement.

Exact original daily files, cached Wikipedia payloads/metadata and previous extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with a guarded retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia text is attributed through pinned revision links and remains subject to CC BY-SA terms. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template displays use explicit original arguments, without live expansion, currency exchange or computed unit conversion. Complete original markup remains in SQLite. Source-depth gaps and malformed brackets are preserved rather than silently repaired.

## January

### 2024-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360237101](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%201&oldid=1360237101>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** The IDF withdraws five brigades, consisting of thousands of soldiers, from the Gaza Strip and says the war will enter a "different mode of operations".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/1/israel-says-it-will-pull-out-thousands-of-troops-from-gaza>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** At least 27 rockets are fired by Hamas shortly after midnight at cities and towns in central and southern Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-stroke-of-midnight-hamas-attacks-israel-with-heavy-new-year-rocket-barrage/>); [Ynet](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/34k49w124>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Nagorno-Karabakh conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Republic of Artsakh officially ceases to exist, in accordance with a decree signed by former president Samvel Shahramanyan.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax](<https://www.interfax.ru/world/938736>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed during an ambush in the Abyei region, an area disputed between Sudan and South Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/1/six-dead-in-disputed-oil-rich-area-between-sudan-and-south-sudan>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-01-01-1-2"></a>

Context: Public Domain Day / 2024 in American public domain.

**Archived source account.** The animated short film Steamboat Willie, the German-language version of the novel All Quiet on the Western Front, and other works published in 1928 enter the public domain in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Mashable](<https://mashable.com/article/major-public-domain-day-2024>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sheikh Zayed Festival at Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates breaks four Guinness World Records for a hour-long fireworks display and drone show during the New Year celebration.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/uae/sheikh-zayed-festival-in-abu-dhabi-emirate-breaks-4-guinness-world-records-during-new-year-2024-celebrations-1.100186555>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Noto earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes the Noto Peninsula in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, killing 55 people. A tsunami warning is issued for multiple prefectures along the Sea of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/japan/least-six-dead-after-huge-earthquake-rocks-japan-new-years-day-2024-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and 21 others are injured in a fire at a bar in Graz, Austria, that was hosting a New Year's party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/austria-graz-fire-injuries-death-bar-67738121e4237358a86f1df66c1c60c4>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-01-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Ethiopia, Foreign relations of Somaliland.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia announces an agreement with Somaliland to use 20 km of coastline, including the port of Berbera, in exchange for eventual recognition of the Somaliland Declaration of Independence, which would make it the first country to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/landlocked-ethiopia-signs-pact-use-somalilands-red-sea-port-2024-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates formally join the BRICS group as new members.

Source citations (as archived): [Tehran Times](<https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/493180/Iran-joins-BRICS-group-formally-in-2024>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-3-4"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of Sudan Abdallah Hamdok, leader of the pro-civilian Sudanese Coordination of Civil Democratic Forces, meets the leader of the Rapid Support Forces Hemedti in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia for peace talks.

Source citations (as archived): [All Africa](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202401020097.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-01-4-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Israeli judicial reform / Movement for Quality Government in Israel v. Knesset.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Israel votes 8–7 to strike down the "reasonableness" bill passed by the Knesset in July.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67859177>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/in-historic-ruling-high-court-strikes-down-key-judicial-overhaul-legislation/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-4-5"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Estonia / Same-sex marriage in Estonia.

**Archived source account.** Estonia becomes the 36th country in the world where same-sex couples can marry.

Source citations (as archived): [Postimees](<https://www.postimees.ee/7930244/uus-aasta-tuli-abieluvordsusega-avalduse-on-esitanud-juba-kaheksa-samasoolist-paari>).

<a id="event-2024-01-01-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bangladeshi economist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Muhammad Yunus and three people that worked at his company Grameen Telecom are sentenced to six months in prison for violating Bangladesh's labor laws.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/1/nobel-laureate-muhammad-yunus-convicted-in-bangladesh-labour-law-case>).

### 2024-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360237445](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%202&oldid=1360237445>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict / Assassination of Saleh al-Arouri.

**Archived source account.** Four people and Saleh al-Arouri, the deputy chairman of Hamas' political bureau with two other senior Hamas military officials killed in an Israeli airstrike in the Dahieh neighborhood of Beirut, Lebanon. Israel has not claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-lebanon-kills-senior-hamas-official-saleh-al-arouri-security-2024-01-02/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against infrastructure / 2 January 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Four civilians are killed and nearly 100 others are injured by a Russian missile attack in Kharkiv and at least 27 civilians are injured by a Russian missile attack in Kyiv.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kharkiv-kyiv-2b23b1163c859a645b485d5c38035369>).

<a id="event-2024-01-02-0-10"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Afghan conflict / Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen kill six people in Mir Ali, North Waziristan District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/gunmen-kill-6-barbers-former-stronghold-pakistani-taliban-106039837>).

<a id="event-2024-01-02-0-13"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Kordofan campaign.

**Archived source account.** The RSF attacked the town of Bara, North Kordofan and plundered the University of Gezira in Wad Madani. The SAF launched airstrikes on RSF positions in Wad Madani, Sennar, and the Khartoum area.

Source citations (as archived): [Dabanga Sudan](<https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/reports-about-intense-air-strikes-on-rsf-sites-in-central-sudan>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United States Congress hearing on antisemitism.

**Archived source account.** Claudine Gay resigns as president of Harvard University following controversial remarks she made during a congressional hearing on antisemitism and accusations of plagiarism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/harvard-president-gay-resigns-harvard-crimson-student-newspaper-2024-01-02/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-02-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Haneda Airport runway collision.

**Archived source account.** A Japan Airlines Airbus A350-900 aircraft collides with a Japan Coast Guard Dash 8 aircraft and bursts into flames at Haneda Airport in Tokyo, Japan. All 379 occupants aboard the Japan Airlines flight are evacuated, while five of the six occupants aboard the Coast Guard aircraft are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-asia-67862184>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/fire-breaks-out-plane-runway-japans-tokyo-haneda-airport-nhk-2024-01-02/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-02-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Ugandan People's Defence Force helicopter crashes in the village of Nyamisigiri, Kabarole District, Uganda, killing two people on board the helicopter and one person on the ground.

Source citations (as archived): [KFM](<https://www.kfm.co.ug/news/updf-helicopter-crashes-in-kabarole.html>); [Aviation Safety Network](<https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/349544>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Attempted assassination of Lee Jae-myung.

**Archived source account.** South Korean opposition politician Lee Jae-myung is stabbed in the neck in Gadeokdo, Busan.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/01/world/asia/south-korea-opposition-lee-jae-myung.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-02-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man breaks into the Colorado Supreme Court building in Denver, Colorado, United States. He holds a security guard at gunpoint and later voluntarily surrenders to police.

Source citations (as archived): [Colorado Public Radio](<https://www.cpr.org/2024/01/02/armed-man-under-arrest-breaking-into-colorado-supreme-court-building/>).

### 2024-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363161276](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%203&oldid=1363161276>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War, Turkey–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey denies access to the Black Sea for two Royal Navy minehunters saying their transit of the Bosporus and Dardanelles straits would be in violation of the Montreux Convention of 1936.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/turkey-britain-minehunter-ships-ukraine-b2472437.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine and Russia complete their first prisoner exchange in nearly five months, releasing over 200 people on each side, facilitated by mediation from the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-ukraine-stage-big-pow-exchange-after-uae-mediation-2024-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war / Operation 1027.

**Archived source account.** The Ta'ang National Liberation Army claimed to have taken control of the town of Mongngaw in Kyaukme Township in Shan State.

Source citations (as archived): [Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/myanmar-junta-loses-town-dozens-of-troops-in-five-days-of-resistance-attacks.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Clan del Golfo detonate explosives at an army encampment in Turbo, Antioquia Department, Colombia, killing a soldier and injuring 12 others.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/1-soldier-killed-12-injured-attack-colombia-blamed-106075987>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-0-11"></a>

Context: Kerman bombings.

**Archived source account.** Eighty nine people are killed and 284 others injured in a double bombing in Kerman, Iran, during a ceremony marking the fourth anniversary of the assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-soleimani-explosion-kerman-2524cfed1d040370bf98000e2b53ad5a>).

#### Disssters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and 30 others are injured after a bus carrying 45 passengers collided with a truck in Golaghat District, Assam, India.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE Noticias](<https://efe.com/en/other-news/2024-01-03/bus-crash-kills-12-in-northeast-india/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Sierra Leone coup attempt.

**Archived source account.** A court in Freetown, Sierra Leone, charges former president Ernest Bai Koroma with four offences, including treason for his alleged role during the November coup attempt.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20240103-sierra-leone-charges-former-president-koroma-with-treason-over-coup-attempt>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in India.

**Archived source account.** A court in India sentences two men to death over a train bombing in 2005 which killed 14 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Deccan Herald](<https://www.deccanherald.com/india/uttar-pradesh/2005-shramjeevi-express-blast-case-accused-get-death-penalty-2834131>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in the U.S. state of New York releases unsealed documents containing the associates list of Jeffrey Epstein to the public.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/jeffrey-epstein-list-names-documents-b2472960.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-03-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three men are stabbed and injured on a train at Akihabara Station in Tokyo, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/four-apparently-stabbed-train-station-tokyo-nhk-2024-01-03/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-01-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hilda Heine is sworn in as President of the Marshall Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/505980/hilda-heine-sworn-in-as-president-of-the-marshall-islands>).

### 2024-01-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1331924835](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%204&oldid=1331924835>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi conflict / U.S. drone strikes in Iraq and Syria.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. drone strike in Baghdad, Iraq, kills four Harakat Hezbollah al-Nujaba militants, including senior leader Mushtaq Talib Al-Saeedi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/three-iran-backed-militia-fighters-killed-baghdad-drone-strike-sources-2024-01-04/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-0-5"></a>

Context: 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Siege of Khan Yunis.

**Archived source account.** IDF claimed to have significantly degraded the command and control of Hamas Khan Younis Brigade's northern and eastern battalions with the destruction of tunnel systems, infrastructure and deaths of company commanders.

Source citations (as archived): [Understanding War](<https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-january-4-2024>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Kerman bombings.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State's Khorasan Province claims responsibility for yesterday's double bombing in Kerman, Iran, which killed 103 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-67888283>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-intelligence-confirms-islamic-states-afghanistan-branch-behind-iran-blasts-2024-01-05/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and 22 others are injured in a fire at a hospital in Uelzen, Lower Saxony, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-hospital-fire-efc7cdd7c89e4d32bf69dd210a1f06bb>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 1,000 cars are stranded on the E22 highway in Sweden between Hörby and Kristianstad due to heavy snow with people spending the night in their vehicles. The Swedish Army helped drivers get out of their vehicles and supplied them with basic amenities.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2503681-zeker-duizend-auto-s-hele-nacht-vast-door-hevige-sneeuw-zweden-leger-ingezet>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A private plane en route from J. F. Mitchell Airport in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines to Hewanorra International Airport in Saint Lucia crashes shortly after takeoff, killing four people including German actor Christian Oliver and his two daughters.

Source citations (as archived): [Loop News](<https://barbados.loopnews.com/content/four-die-plane-crash-bequia>); [AFP](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/hollywood/christian-oliver-of-valkyrie-fame-his-two-daughters-killed-in-plane-crash-101704512924945.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Perry High School shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed (including the perpetrator) and six others are injured during a mass school shooting in Perry, Iowa, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [KCCI-TV](<https://www.kcci.com/article/perry-iowa-shooting-victim-ahmir-jolliff-identified-sixth-grader/46297165>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-2-3"></a>

Context: Treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** A spokesman for the Vice and Virtue Ministry of the Taliban in Afghanistan announces the arrest of an unspecified number of women for wearing "bad hijab", in the first known crackdown on the dress code since the Taliban's return to power in August 2021.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-bad-hijab-women-09d5301ca830f1bdef26696add37fd02>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar announces the pardon of 9,652 prisoners, including 114 foreigners, to mark the country's independence day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-free-9652-prisoners-humanitarian-grounds-state-media-2024-01-04/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-01-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin issues a decree granting Russian citizenship to foreigners who fight for Russia in the war against Ukraine, and for their families.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-offers-citizenship-foreigners-who-fight-russia-2024-01-04/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-04-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mohammad Sabah Al-Salem Al-Sabah is appointed as Prime Minister of Kuwait.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kuwait-emir-appoints-sheikh-mohammed-sabah-al-salem-al-sabah-prime-minister-2024-01-04/>).

### 2024-01-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200179908](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%205&oldid=1200179908>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-05-0-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraq-prepares-close-down-us-led-coalitions-mission-pm-statement-2024-01-05/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-05-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Noto earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the magnitude 7.6 earthquake in the Noto Peninsula in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, on January 1, increases to 94 people. At least 222 others are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/earthquake-rescue-ishikawa-japan-disaster-missing-coastline-7063cef9950f59b9702a6fc8364ff363>).

<a id="event-2024-01-05-1-3"></a>

Context: Alaska Airlines Flight 1282.

**Archived source account.** An Alaska Airlines Boeing 737 Max 9 aircraft loses a door section of its fuselage mid-air and makes an emergency landing in Portland, Oregon, United States, with no major injuries reported. The Federal Aviation Administration subsequently orders a temporary grounding of all 737 Max 9 aircraft in response to the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2024/jan/06/alaska-airlines-grounds-boeing-737-max-9-planes-after-mid-air-window-blowout>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-67899564>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/01/06/us/alaska-airlines-window-landing/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-05-1-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Cicalengka station railway collision.

**Archived source account.** Two passenger trains collide near Cicalengka railway station in Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia, killing at least four people and injuring several others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-train-collision-java-b9357f6ef81dd15695ba43fa5f7bb47d>).

<a id="event-2024-01-09-0-4"></a>

Context: 2024 conflict in Ecuador.

**Archived source account.** President of Ecuador Daniel Noboa declares a state of emergency following the escape of José Adolfo Macías Villamar, leader of the Los Choneros drug cartel, from prison. Gangsters subsequently storm a TC Televisión newsroom in Guayaquil and launch a series of riots, kidnappings, and explosions across the country. Eight civilians are killed, including two at Centro Comercial Albán Borja, and three more injured during random shootings in Guayaquil, while two police officers are killed in Nobol. As a result, schools are closed and the military is called to stop gang activities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/10/ten-killed-gangs-unleash-terror-as-ecuador-declares-state-of-emergency>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-hit-ukraines-kharkiv-wounding-4-officials-say-2024-01-16/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-16-0-9"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Pakistan border skirmishes / 2024 Iranian missile strikes in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Iran launches ballistic missiles at Balochistan, Pakistan, targeting what it claims are Jaish ul-Adl terrorist sites, killing two children and injuring three other people. Pakistan calls the action an "unprovoked violation" of its airspace.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-iraq-militant-bases-attack-05c7530d66fb05dd6f2868527003ba2d>).

<a id="event-2024-01-16-0-11"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions.

**Archived source account.** A Congolese soldier is killed and two others are arrested by the Rwandan Army in a cross-border incident in Rubavu District, Rwanda.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/rwanda-congo-military-border-c53d5f990fe285e784b30c2c6d8c841e>).

<a id="event-2024-01-16-0-13"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An al-Shabaab suicide bomber kills three people and wounds two others outside of the Mayor of Mogadishu's office in Mogadishu, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/suicide-attack-rocks-somali-capital-mogadishu/3110171>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-01-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** Sudan suspends its membership in the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) after accusing it of inviting Rapid Support Forces official Hemedti to an upcoming summit in Kampala, Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sudan-burhan-dagalo-war-africa-e8fd4600ea0dc83e916958a3edfcd4bb>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** A lawsuit is filed against Madison Square Garden Entertainment chairman James Dolan, accusing him of pressuring a woman into having unwanted sex in 2014. The woman also files a lawsuit against film producer Harvey Weinstein, accusing him of sexually assaulting her.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/16/arts/music/james-dolan-harvey-weinstein-sexual-assault-lawsuit.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-16-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A drive-by shooting kills five people in Ceiba, Puerto Rico. Authorities say the killings are likely connected to drug trafficking.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/police-people-including-teenage-boy-killed-drive-shooting-106407016>).

<a id="event-2024-01-16-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian government extends Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi's jail term of 12 years for "spreading propaganda".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67986227.amp>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-01-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Rwanda asylum plan.

**Archived source account.** UK Conservative Party deputy chairmen Lee Anderson and Brendan Clarke-Smith resign to join 60 other Conservative MPs in voting to back an amendment to the Asylum and Immigration Bill, making it more strict. The amendment later fails to pass.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-67999810>).

<a id="event-2024-01-17-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Bashkortostan protests.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and five others injured during a mass shooting against a group of men outdoors in Morvant, Trinidad and Tobago.

<a id="event-2024-01-17-2-6"></a>

### 2024-01-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1292346258](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%2018&oldid=1292346258>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan / 2024 Iranian missile strikes in Pakistan, Operation Marg Bar Sarmachar, 2024 Iran–Pakistan border skirmishes.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistan Air Force launches "precision airstrikes" on militant targets inside Iran a day after Iranian missile strikes in Balochistan, Pakistan, killed two at least two civilians. Camps belonging to the Baluch Liberation Front and Balochistan Liberation Army are reportedly hit.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/pakistan-hits-militant-targets-in-iran-day-after-strikes-killed-2-in-balochistan-sources-2490166-2024-01-18>); [First Post](<https://www.firstpost.com/world/pakistan-strikes-militant-targets-in-iran-day-after-serious-consequences-warning-13627002.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine says that it struck an oil terminal in Saint Petersburg, Russia, with a domestic-produced long-range drone, as part of a new campaign against strategic targets inside Russian territory. However, Russia reports that the attack failed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-hits-targets-russia-during-drone-attack-oil-terminal-military-source-2024-01-18/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-0-7"></a>

Context: Jordanian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Jordan launches airstrikes against alleged drug traffickers in Arman, Syria, hitting several buildings and killing ten civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/18/at-least-10-civilians-dead-in-suspected-jordanian-air-raids-in-syria>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-01-18-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022–2024 United Kingdom industrial disputes and strikes.

**Archived source account.** The largest general strike in more than 50 years occurs in Northern Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-67981000>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian multinational company Tata Steel announces the closure of both its blast furnaces in Port Talbot, Wales, with the loss of around 3,000 jobs across the United Kingdom, in what trade unions are calling a "worst-case scenario" for workers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-68022901>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed, two are injured and one person is missing due to landslides caused by heavy rains in Davao de Oro, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/philippines-landslide-davao-de-oro-province-d8e16d07726e76b72c69234b4ff82c8e>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve children and two teachers are killed after a boat on a school trip capsized into a lake near Vadodara, Gujarat, India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-68022869>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-2-2"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Reuters reported that an Atlas Air Boeing 747-8 returned to Miami on January 18 after an engine problem shortly after departure; everyone aboard was safe.

Editorial date: 2024-01-18. Checked: 2026-10-21. The original model designation 747-800 is retained as source wording. The opened report identifies a 747-8; the remaining main assertions are supported.

Evidence: [Reuters via Investing.com](<https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/atlas-air-says-a-cargo-aircraft-landed-in-miami-after-engine-malfunction-3277948>).

Original source account: An Atlas Air cargo Boeing 747-800 suffers an engine malfunction after takeoff in Miami International Airport, and shortly makes an emergency landing. No injuries were reported.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-01-18-3-1"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Mexico and Chile announce that they have filed a request for the International Criminal Court to investigate allegations of war crimes committed in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mexico-chile-seek-international-criminal-court-probe-on-crimes-against-civilians-in-gaza-101705612926618.html>).

**Archived source account.** Two people are arrested for killing public prosecutor César Suárez.

<a id="event-2024-01-18-4-3"></a>

Context: Corruption in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singaporean Transport Minister S. Iswaran resigns both as cabinet minister, member of parliament of West Coast GRC and as a member of the PAP after being charged with 27 counts of corruption and receiving gratification as a public servant by the Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau (CPIB). It is considered as the highest-profile graft involving a cabinet minister in 38 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/iswaran-charged-corruption-transport-minister-cpib-4054406>).

A government minister’s house is set on fire and roads are barricated in the capital Moroni, while protestors are tear gassed by police. A person is killed and six more injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/comoros-protests-unrest-elections-assoumani-bbea90c144941c0cae2c129c2fee6507>).

Context: Government shutdowns in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States Congress approves a stopgap bill to extend the deadline for government funding to March 2024, narrowly avoiding a government shutdown, which would have begun at midnight, January 19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-congress-scrambles-pass-stopgap-bill-avert-government-shutdown-2024-01-18/>).

Context: Commercial Lunar Payload Services.

**Archived source account.** Astrobotic's and NASA's Peregrine Mission One lunar lander is destroyed as it reenters Earth's atmosphere over the Pacific Ocean following the failure of its propulsion system.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-67962397>).

<a id="event-2024-01-18-6-3"></a>

Context: Water on Mars.

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency probe Mars Express finds huge deposits of dusty ice beneath the equator of Mars, with the discovery being the largest amount of water ice ever found near the planet's equator.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/mars-water-ice-equator-frozen-ocean>).

### 2024-01-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1270798857](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20January%2021&oldid=1270798857>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-01-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Ust-Luga Multimodal Complex in Leningrad Oblast is hit by a drone attack, causing a large fire. Russian gas producer Novatek subsequently suspends all operations at the complex in response to the attack. Ukraine claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2505649-brand-bij-russische-gasproducent-in-oostzee-mogelijk-door-droneaanval>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/fire-erupts-russias-novatek-baltic-sea-terminal-after-explosions-heard-2024-01-21/>); [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/27007>).

<a id="event-2024-01-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least 27 people are killed by alleged Ukrainian artillery strikes on Donetsk, according to Russian-appointed local officials. Donetsk People's Republic leader Denis Pushilin declares a day of mourning in response. Ukraine denies responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-0725abea3e507a8112931660617a745c>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/eight-killed-after-ukraine-shells-russian-controlled-city-donetsk-mayor-2024-01-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali civil war / American military intervention in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** The United States Africa Command says a U.S. drone strike has killed three al-Shabaab militants near Kismayo, Somalia. The strike was carried out at the request of the Somali government.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<https://www.africanews.com/2024/01/23/al-shabaab-militants-killed-in-us-military-strike/>).

<a id="event-2024-01-21-0-9"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 gunmen are killed by security forces on a highway in Sonora, Mexico, during a failed attempt to rescue the son of a prominent Sinaloa Cartel hitman from police custody. Two officers are also injured in the shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-12-dead-suspected-attempt-rescue-son-mexican-cartel-hitman-2024-01-22/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-01-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023–24 North American winter.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the ongoing winter storms in the United States increases to 89, with most of the deaths reported in Oregon and Tennessee.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-68049923>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-01-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A soldier opens fire upon fellow soldiers at a barracks in Kerman, Iran, killing five. The suspect is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-soldier-killings-kerman-d73dccb9533b8c796febb2ba7f0d7dd2>); [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/amp/iran-sodier-kills-5-fellow-troops-kerman/32786371.html>).

<a id="event-2024-01-21-2-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Joliet shootings.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Police attributed eight deaths and one nonfatal shooting near Joliet on January 21 to Romeo Nance. They reported that he died by suicide after a confrontation with officers in Texas on January 22.

Editorial date: 2024-01-21. Checked: 2026-10-21. Four shooting sites are described by the opened report: two homes and two other locations. Three sites had fatalities; the original three-location shorthand omits the separate nonfatal site. Official attribution is distinguished from adjudicated fact.

Evidence: [ABC News](<https://abcnews.com/amp/US/police-joliet-searching-man-after-multiple-deceased-people/story?id=106579185>).

Original source account: A man commits a spree shooting in three locations in Illinois, United States killing eight people and injuring one other before committing suicide a day later after he was confronted by police.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-01-21-3-2"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / 2024 Republican presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Florida governor Ron DeSantis ends his presidential campaign and endorses former President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/florida-gov-ron-desantis-drops-out-2024-presidential-race-endorses-trump>).

<a id="event-2024-01-21-3-4"></a>

Context: 2024 German anti-extremism protests.

**Archived source account.** Organising groups Campact and Fridays for Future say that 1.4 million people protested against the Alternative for Germany party in 100 cities across Germany following the meeting of right-wing extremists at Potsdam in 2023.

Source citations (as archived): [Agence France-Presse](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20240121-tens-of-thousands-rally-in-germany-for-second-day-of-protests-against-far-right-deportation-plans>).

### 2024-01-26

However, Israel is not required to end its military operation.

Source citations (as archived): [Jewish Telegraphic Agency](<https://www.jta.org/2024/01/26/politics/international-court-of-justice-rules-that-some-allegations-of-israel-committing-genocide-are-plausible>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/01/26/world/israel-hamas-gaza-news>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/jan/26/middle-east-crisis-live-updates-icj-genocide-case-ruling-israel-hamas-gaza-hostage-talks-cia#maincontent>).

<a id="event-2024-02-27-2-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The National Weather Service documents multiple tornadoes in northern Illinois and northwest Indiana on February 27, an unusual February occurrence. Calling this late-season weather is misleading in this context.

Editorial date: 2024-02-27. Checked: 2026-10-21. The opened regional event report supports multiple tornadoes and February rarity. The original parenthetical is a label, not an attached citation; the late-season wording remains preserved in the original account.

Evidence: [US National Weather Service Chicago](<https://www.weather.gov/lot/2024_02_27_Severe>).

Original source account: Multiple tornadoes spawn from a very rare late season tornado outbreak. (February 27-28, 2024 Tornadoes)

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** A Russian missile strike kills at least five people and injures eight others in an industrial area of Kharkiv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-kharkiv-kills-three-people-police-say-2024-03-20/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Three Jenin Brigades militants are killed during an airstrike against a vehicle by Israel in Jenin, Palestine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Mayadeen](<https://english.almayadeen.net/news/politics/-israel--bombs-car--kills-three-palestinians-in-jenin--west>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-7"></a>

Context: Gang war in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** Gangs attack the neighborhood of Pétion-Ville in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, killing at least five people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/03/20/haiti-gangs-petionville-attack-violence/90d910f8-e6dd-11ee-9eba-1558f848ec25_story.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-8"></a>

Context: Gang war in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** The United States evacuates its citizens by helicopter as fighting spreads.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/20/haiti-us-evacuation-violence>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-10"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Eight Balochistan Liberation Army gunmen are killed after trying to storm Gwadar's port in the Balochistan Province, Pakistan. Two security guards are also wounded in the gunfight, which lasted for two hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/pakistans-gwadar-port-attacked-eight-armed-fighters-killed>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-0-12"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Twelve bodies are found in Mexico, five inside a truck in the municipality of Villa Corona, Jalisco and seven in Sonora.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universal](<https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/identifican-a-uno-de-los-cinco-cuerpos-hallados-en-camioneta-abandonada-en-villa-corona-jalisco/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed in an explosion at a mine in Harnai District, Balochistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-coal-mine-blast-44e58508054b2a8a78bd60dba513e40e>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed, one is injured, and two are missing after the South Korean-flagged tanker MV Keoyoung Sun loaded with 980 tons of acrylic acid capsizes near Mutsure Island, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/several-missing-as-south-korean-flagged-tanker-capsizes-off-japan>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-03-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentina tells the International Civil Aviation Organization that Venezuela violated the Convention on International Civil Aviation when Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro banned Argentine aircraft from its airspace earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/politica/2024/03/20/argentina-enfrenta-a-venezuela-en-naciones-unidas-por-la-decision-ilegal-de-maduro-contra-los-vuelos-de-aerolineas/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-03-20-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Fine Gael leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Leo Varadkar announces his resignation as Taoiseach and leader of Fine Gael, triggering a leadership election. Varadkar will remain as Taoiseach until his successor as party leader is elected.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/20/europe/leo-varadkar-ireland-prime-minister-resignation-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-20-3-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Indonesian general election.

**Archived source account.** The General Elections Commission announces that Prabowo Subianto had received the most votes in the presidential election, but the determination of the winner as president-elect is still waiting complaints from other candidates at the Constitutional Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/indonesia-election-commission-confirms-prabowo-subianto-wins-presidency>).

### 2024-03-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1253347564](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2021&oldid=1253347564>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence announces that its forces have captured the Ukrainian village of Tonenke in Donetsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/03/21/Russia-says-it-has-captured-the-village-of-Tonenke-in-eastern-Ukraine->).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kyiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches a massive attack on Kyiv and the surrounding region with ballistic and cruise missiles, injuring at least 17 people.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/21/europe/kyiv-missile-attack-ukraine-russia-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Mykolaiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** At least one civilian is killed and four others are injured in a Russian ballistic missile attack on Mykolaiv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-one-injures-four-ukraines-mykolaiv-officials-say-2024-03-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-0-9"></a>

Context: Islamic State–Taliban conflict / 2024 Kandahar New Kabul Bank bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills 21 people and injures 50+ at a New Kabul Bank in Kandahar, Afghanistan. ISIS-K claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-187925>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-0-11"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** The Islamic Resistance in Iraq launches drone attacks on Kiryat Shmona Airport and Ben Gurion Airport in Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Mehr News Agency](<https://en.mehrnews.com/amp/212742/>); [Islamic Republic News Agency](<https://en.irna.ir/amp/85422962/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A capsized boat carrying Rohingya refugees is found off the coast of Aceh, Indonesia, with 69 refugees rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2513612-boot-met-rohingyavluchtelingen-gekapseisd-bij-atjeh>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the capsized South Korean-flagged tanker MV Keoyoung Sun increases to nine with one person still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nine-dead-after-south-korean-flagged-vessel-capsized-off-japan-skorea-says-2024-03-21/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-03-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Accession of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Council agrees to open talks on Bosnia and Herzegovina's membership of the European Union days after the recommendation by the European Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/eu-enlargement-bosnia-bid-candidate-western-balkans-e2862599316dea5973a4fd7b1a2781ee>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-03-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Russia sentences the Volga Maniac serial killer to life in prison for the murders of 31 elderly women in Tatarstan in 2011 and 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/volga-maniac-gets-life-sentence-killing-31-russian-women-2024-03-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis laicizes Belgian bishop Roger Vangheluwe due to allegations of abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2513661-paus-zet-belgische-hoogbejaarde-bisschop-uit-ambt-vanwege-misbruik>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dutch Royal Marechaussee arrests three British soldiers of the HMS Prince of Wales after multiple incidents in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2513667-militairen-brits-vliegdekschip-aangehouden-voor-mishandeling-en-dronkenschap>).

<a id="event-2024-03-21-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Filipino former legislator Arnolfo Teves Jr. is arrested in Dili, East Timor, after being placed in the Interpol Red Notice in connection with his role in the 2023 massacre in Negros Oriental, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/ex-lawmaker-accused-of-killing-philippine-governor-arrested-in-east-timor-de07aefc>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-03-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Vietnam Võ Văn Thưởng resigns after just over a year in office amid the Communist Party's anti-corruption campaign, making him the shortest-serving president in Vietnamese history.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/once-beacon-stability-vietnam-name-third-president-year-2024-03-20/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/vietnams-president-vo-van-thuong-resigns-amid-anti-corruption-campaign>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-03-20/vietnam-s-president-quits-in-latest-sign-of-leadership-turmoil>).

### 2024-03-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1216100097](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2022&oldid=1216100097>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / March 2024 Ukraine missile strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches dozens of ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities for a second consecutive day with reports of power outages in Kharkiv after critical infrastructure was damaged. At least eight missile strikes on Zaporizhzhia are reported, while a "critical infrastructure object" is damaged in Vinnytsia. More than a million people are left without power across Ukraine due to the strikes, with five people killed and dozens more reportedly injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68634444>); [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2024-03-21/russian-missile-strikes-damage-power-supply-in-ukraines-kharkiv>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / March 2024 Ukraine missile strikes.

**Archived source account.** The Dnieper Hydroelectric Station in Zaporizhzhia is hit by a missile causing extensive damage and a large fire. A trolleybus initially reported as carrying civilians was destroyed in the attack, later confirmed to have been empty apart from the driver who was killed. Shelling also damages one of the two power lines connected to the Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/22/ukraine-war-briefing-anti-putin-forces-behind-raids-into-russia-speak-out>); [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/russia-launches-large-scale-missile-drone-attack-against-ukraine/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Russian government states in a press conference that the invasion of Ukraine is now a "war" and is no longer a "special military operation", the official term used for the war by the Russian government. In another press conference later in the day, Kremlin Press Secretary Dmitry Peskov tells reporters that although the invasion is a de facto war, the Russian government is not currently planning to change the invasion's de jure status as a "special military operation".

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2513788-kremlin-woordvoerder-spreekt-nu-van-oorlog-tegen-oekraine>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-says-russia-is-war-due-western-intervention-ukrainian-side-2024-03-22/>); [Meduza](<https://meduza.io/en/news/2024/03/22/we-are-at-war-putin-spokesman-says-invasion-of-ukraine-has-grown-beyond-special-military-operation>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 135 people, including two attackers, are killed and more than 140 others are injured in a mass shooting at the Crocus City Hall music venue in Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast, Russia, with the building subsequently catching on fire following an explosion. The perpetrators remain at large after escaping in a vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [Baza](<https://t.me/bazabazon/26109>); [Meduza](<https://meduza.io/en/news/2024/03/22/at-least-12-reportedly-killed-dozens-injured-in-shooting-at-moscow-region-music-hall>); [Baza 2](<https://t.me/bazabazon/26126>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/shooting-blast-reported-concert-hall-near-moscow-agencies-2024-03-22/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-8"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State claims responsibility for the attack in a statement issued by its official Amaq News Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/22/europe/crocus-moscow-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-9"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** The Freedom of Russia Legion claims that the Russian government committed the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrainska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/03/22/7447750/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-10"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** The Russian government claims that the Ukrainian government committed the attack. This was denied by them, who instead claim that the attack was a false flag attack by the Russian government designed to provoke public opinion in Russia against Ukraine and allow the Russian Army to mobilize more troops in its invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/ukraine-denies-involvement-in-deadly-concert-hall-shooting-in-russia/3172206>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-12"></a>

Context: Jihadist insurgency in Niger.

**Archived source account.** At least 23 Nigerien soldiers are killed, 17 are injured, and 34 others are missing after an ambush in Teguey, Tillabéri Region, Niger, by unknown jihadists. The Nigerien junta states that 30 jihadists were also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Sahara Reporters](<https://saharareporters.com/2024/03/22/terrorists-ambush-nigerien-soldiers-near-mali-burkina-faso-border-kill-23-34-others>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-14"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines announces that Islamic terrorist group Abu Sayyaf has been "fully dismantled", bringing an end to the decades-long jihadist insurgency. Twenty members of the group remain in Sulu and Basilan provinces, and negotiations are ongoing for their surrender.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlas News](<https://theatlasnews.co/latest/2024/03/22/philippine-general-says-abu-sayyaf-group-is-dismantled/>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1922001/abu-sayyaf-now-dismantled-after-over-three-decades-says-westmincom-chief>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-0-16"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are rescued from kidnappers by Nigerian forces and local vigilante groups in Katsina State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Channels TV](<https://www.channelstv.com/2024/03/22/security-agents-rescue-abducted-bus-passengers-in-katsina/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 East Java earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes Bawean, East Java, Indonesia, causing severe damage.

Source citations (as archived): [Detik](<https://www.detik.com/jatim/berita/d-7256289/puluhan-rumah-warga-di-bawean-gresik-hancur-imbas-gempa-tuban-m-6-5>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Organization for Migration (IOM) says that at least 65 bodies have been discovered at a mass grave in the Libyan Desert. The IOM says the bodies are those of migrants who were being smuggled towards Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-68640792>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-03-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Cannabis in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Bundesrat approves a partial legalization of cannabis in Germany, which is expected to come into effect on April 1.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-approves-partial-legalization-of-cannabis-from-april/a-68641043>).

<a id="event-2024-03-22-2-3"></a>

Context: Gang war in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** Prominent Haitian gang leader Ti Greg, who escaped from prison earlier this month, is shot dead by police in Port-au-Prince, Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/amp/prominent-haitian-gang-leader-shot-dead-by-police-as-political-groups-near-finalisation-of-transition-council-13099622>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-03-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catherine, Princess of Wales announces that she was diagnosed with cancer following recent abdominal surgery and is currently undergoing chemotherapy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-68641441>).

### 2024-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1215950286](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2023&oldid=1215950286>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Crimea attacks.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Air Force launches a wave of airstrikes across Crimea, with several explosions reported in Sevastopol. Russian officials say at least ten missiles have been shot down over the peninsula, and that at least two civilians have been injured.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russia-says-shot-down-ukraine-missiles-fired-at-crimea-5299532>).

<a id="event-2024-03-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Russian military states that it has captured the town of Ivanivske in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/russian-army-claims-seized-ukrainian-village-near-bakhmut-79b1c501>).

<a id="event-2024-03-23-0-6"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from yesterday's terrorist attack at the Crocus City Hall music venue in Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast, Russia, increases to at least 137 people. Russian authorities report that 11 suspects, including the four assailants, have been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-suspects-moscow-attack-detained-after-car-chase-lawmaker-2024-03-23>); [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/03/23/islamic-state-group-claims-russia-gun-attack-a84583>).

<a id="event-2024-03-23-0-8"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** A Houthi missile hits Panamanian-flagged, Chinese-owned and operated oil tanker Huang Pu. It suffers minimal damage and a fire on board is quickly extinguished. No casualties are reported, and the vessel resumes its course.

Source citations (as archived): [X](<https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/1771726107168960751?s=20>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/china-red-sea-houthi-ship-attack-deal-russia-1882933>); [Marine Log](<https://www.marinelog.com/news/houthi-missile-hits-chinese-owned-tanker-huang-pu/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Somali civil war / 2024 Busley army base attack.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab insurgents storm a Somali military base in Lower Shabelle, killing seven soldiers, including the commander of the base, while ten al-Shabaab fighters are reportedly killed in the ensuing shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-launches-deadly-attack-military-base-somalia-2024-03-23/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-03-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Safeguarding National Security Ordinance law, passed by the Legislative Council, comes into effect in Hong Kong. The new law allows for a pre-charge detention of up to 16 days, and restricts legal rights for suspects, including their access to lawyers.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://hongkongfp.com/2024/03/23/breaking-hong-kongs-new-homegrown-security-law-comes-into-effect/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-03-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Tasmanian state election.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Party win a plurality of seats in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-03-23/tas-state-election-results-live-blog/103619024>).

<a id="event-2024-03-23-2-3"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Primary elections are held for the Republican and Democratic parties in Louisiana and for the Democratic Party in Missouri.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/missouri-louisiana-primaries-biden-trump-6ff7f6c67471cbe61b72dc8b31c5b41c>).

### 2024-03-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1216363794](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2024&oldid=1216363794>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / March 2024 Polish airspace violation.

**Archived source account.** A Russian cruise missile violates NATO airspace over Poland, prompting the activation of aircraft from the Polish Air Force.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kyiv-lviv-under-russian-air-attack-poland-activates-aircraft-officials-say-2024-03-24/>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/russia-ukraine-war-latest-children-evacuated-as-ukraine-attacks-russia-putin-passes-new-law-to-boost-army-numbers-12541713>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches major airstrikes on Kyiv and Lviv in Western Ukraine using Kinzhal hypersonic missiles and drones with strikes damaging ground level infrastructure at Ukraine's main gas storage site.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/ukraine-boosts-power-imports-after-russian-attack-losing-generation-capacities-2024-03-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict / Kuriga kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** The pupils kidnapped on March 7 from schools in Kuriga, Chikun, Kaduna State, are freed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-68649221>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-9"></a>

Context: 2024 Ecuadorian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Brigitte García, the youngest mayor in Ecuador, and one of her advisors are found shot dead in Manabí Province, western Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuadors-youngest-mayor-found-shot-death-alongside-advisor-2024-03-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-11"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** Four Tajik men are charged with terrorism. They are brought to Basmanny District court in Moscow, where they are ordered to be held in pre-trial detention until at least May 22.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68652380>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-13"></a>

Context: Salvadoran gang crackdown.

**Archived source account.** Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announces the beginning of a blockade of four municipalities in northern El Salvador, mobilizing 5,000 soldiers and 1,000 police officers to arrest suspected gang members.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://diario.elmundo.sv/nacionales/bukele-anuncia-capturas-y-cerco-militar-por-homicidios-en-chalatenango>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-0-14"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 East Sepik earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.9 earthquake has hit a remote part of western Papua New Guinea, killing five people and causing extensive damage to around 1,000 homes.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/five-dead-1-000-homes-destroyed-in-papua-new-guinea-earthquake/7541249.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-24-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-three people are killed in a rainstorm in Espírito Santo and Rio de Janeiro states, Brazil.

<a id="event-2024-03-24-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rally car veers off the road and crashes into a group of spectators during the Esztergom-Nyerges Rally between the towns of Lábatlan and Bajót in northwest Hungary, killing four people and injuring eight others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/rally-car-race-accident-hungary-60bb6c1afc9dd6f332e8d3f4ee7b5908>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-03-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Marielle Franco.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Federal Police arrests three men, including federal deputy Chiquinho Brazão and his brother Domingos, for ordering and planning the assassination of Rio de Janeiro city councillor Marielle Franco in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [G1](<https://g1.globo.com/politica/blog/andreia-sadi/post/2024/03/24/decisao-moraes-mandantes-mareielle.ghtml>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/24/marielle-franco-two-powerful-politicians-arrested-over-brazil>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-03-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Fine Gael leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Irish education minister Simon Harris is elected as Leader of Fine Gael following the resignation of Leo Varadkar. At age 37, Harris will become Ireland's youngest ever Taoiseach upon taking office.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ireland-premier-simon-harris-leo-varadkar-d63a5d855800dcd2b121ea7b5c1d3f86>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2024-03-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch female darts players Anca Zijlstra and Aileen de Graaf, leave the Netherlands National Team to protest trans athlete Noa-Lynn van Leuven playing on the team.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2514076-dartsters-stappen-uit-oranje-selectie-omdat-teamgenoot-trans-vrouw-is>).

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico declares an epidemic of dengue fever following an increase in cases.

### 2024-03-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1215980440](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2026&oldid=1215980440>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / 2024 Shangla bombing.

<a id="event-2024-03-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-airstrikes-deir-elzour-iran-israel-b386b4c4a1d5f55d9fc5a96015b99a53>).

<a id="event-2024-03-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli warplanes launch airstrikes against Hezbollah targets near the towns of Ras Baalbek and Hermel in Baalbek-Hermel Governorate, Lebanon, killing at least three Hezbollah members.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/suspected-israeli-airstrikes-hit-northeast-lebanon-say-four-security-sources-2024-03-26/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse.

**Archived source account.** The Francis Scott Key Bridge in Baltimore, Maryland, United States, collapses after the container ship MV Dali strikes a bridge column, causing multiple vehicles to fall into the water below.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/francis-scott-key-bridge-baltimore-collapse-container-ship/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-26-1-2"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-03-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The US Supreme Court announces that it will hear oral arguments on whether to restrict access to mifepristone, a commonly-used abortion pill.

<a id="event-2024-03-26-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's High Court of Justice grants WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange a stay of extradition to the United States, and demands that the US not consider the death penalty against Assange if he is sent to the US to face espionage charges.

<a id="event-2024-03-26-3-2"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 2024 presidential campaign.

### 2024-03-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1270960842](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20March%2027&oldid=1270960842>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-27-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed, and sixteen others are injured, by Russian guided bomb strikes on Kharkiv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-airstrikes-kill-least-one-ukrainian-city-kharkiv-mayor-says-2024-03-27/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-0-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven killed in an Israeli airstrike on a Hezbollah paramedic center in Hebbariye. Hezbollah claims that the casualties were civilian staff.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68675608>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-03-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Leipzig FlixBus highway accident.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 35 others are injured after a double-decker FlixBus overturns and crashes on the Bundesautobahn 9 near Leipzig, Saxony, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68673114>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed by several wildfires across the State of Mexico, Mexico.

<a id="event-2024-03-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentina orders the deployment of at least two gendarmerie to the Argentine embassy in Venezuela, where allies of opposition leader María Corina Machado have taken refuge amid increased tensions between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2024/03/27/argentina-enviara-gendarmes-a-venezuela-para-custodiar-la-embajada-en-caracas/>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Rockford stabbings.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and seven others are injured during a stabbing spree in Rockford, Illinois, United States.

<a id="event-2024-03-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Tunisia.

**Archived source account.** A court in Tunisia sentences four people to death and two others to life in prison for the 2013 murder of politician Chokri Belaid.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/27/tunisia-sentences-four-to-death-for-2013-murder-of-politician-chokri-belaid>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-3-5"></a>

Context: First Liberian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The French judiciary sentences the former leader of the United Liberation Movement of Liberia for Democracy Kunti Kamara to 30 years in prison on charges of committing "crimes against humanity".

<a id="event-2024-03-27-3-7"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** The Thai House of Representatives approves a bill to legalize same-sex marriage by a vote of 400–10, with five abstentions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/lawmakers-in-thailand-overwhelmingly-approve-a-bill-to-legalize-same-sex-marriage/ar-BB1kBMAo>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Lithuanian presidential election.

Nauseda rejects the findings, accusing them of being politically motivated.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty Belarusian Service](<https://www.svaboda.org/a/32879780.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-27-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Maltese presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Malta](<https://timesofmalta.com/article/parliament-approves-myriam-spiteri-debono-malta-next-president.1089991>).

### 2024-03-28

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-03-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war / Operation 0307.

**Archived source account.** The Kachin Independence Army captures the town of Lweje and its nearby border crossings in Kachin State, Myanmar, after junta forces abandoned their posts and fled across the border into China.

Source citations (as archived): [Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/kachin-rebels-claim-china-border-trade-town-after-ousting-nine-myanmar-junta-battalions.html>).

<a id="event-2024-03-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023–24 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Cyclone Gamane makes landfall in Madagascar, killing at least eleven people and causing widespread flooding, according to local officials.

<a id="event-2024-03-28-2-3"></a>

Context: Mamatlakala highway accident.

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying Christian pilgrims from Botswana crashes in Limpopo, South Africa, killing 45 people.

<a id="event-2024-03-28-3-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / South Africa v. Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/world-court-orders-israel-take-measures-ensure-food-gets-into-gaza-2024-03-28/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/28/famine-is-setting-in-icj-orders-israel-to-unblock-gaza-food-aid>).

<a id="event-2024-03-28-4-1"></a>

Context: United States v. Bankman-Fried.

**Archived source account.** A federal court in the United States sentences Sam Bankman-Fried to 25 years in prison for stealing $8 billion in a cryptocurrency fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/sam-bankman-fried-be-sentenced-multi-billion-dollar-ftx-fraud-2024-03-28/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2024-04-03/sylmar-burglary-money-storage-facility-30-million>); [KABC-TV](<https://abc7.com/la-heist-millions-stolen-from-money-storage-facility-sylmar-easter-sunday/14614219/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/04/us/la-bank-heist-money-storage-facility/index.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20240331-bulgaria-romania-partially-join-european-union-visa-free-schengen-zone-austria-migrants-land-sea-air>).


## April

### 2024-04-01

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Israel–Hamas war / World Central Kitchen drone strikes.

**Archived source account.** Seven volunteers from the World Central Kitchen, including six British, Polish, Australian and Palestinian nationals and a dual American-Canadian citizen, are killed in an Israeli airstrike south of Deir el-Balah.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2024/4/2/australias-pm-demands-full-accountability-over-death-of-gaza-aid-worker>).

Context: Israel–Hamas war.
