Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog%20entry/army-says-building-damaged-in-eilat-drone-attack-apparently-launched-from-iraq/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict, Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war / Israeli bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/building-close-iranian-embassy-hit-syria-iranian-media-report-2024-04-01/>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d9%87%d8%ac%d9%88%d9%85-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%81%d8%a7%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%af%d9%85%d8%b4%d9%82-%d8%a5%d8%b3%d8%b1/708875/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-04-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Amur Oblast, Russia, end the rescue operations for 13 workers who were trapped in a deep gold mine since March 18, and declare the workers dead.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russian-officials-end-efforts-reach-13-workers-collapsed-108704288>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-04-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan near South Korean territory.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-ballistic-missile-kim-jong-un-fdce94520f3ccb53b047f99d3df031bf>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68708984>).

Context: Politics of San Marino.

Source citations (as archived): [San Marino RTV](<https://sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/alessandro-rossi-e-milena-gasperoni-sono-i-nuovi-capitani-reggenti-a256710>).

### 2024-04-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1318861188](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20April%202&oldid=1318861188>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-04-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine launches airstrikes more than 1000 km inside Russia, targeting an oil refinery and the dormitory of a factory producing Iranian-designed Shahed drones in Yelabuga, Tatarstan. Several people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/02/ukrainian-drone-attacks-russia-tatarstan-oil-refinery-factory>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/program/newsfeed/2024/4/2/drone-strikes-dormitory-in-russias-tatarstan>).

<a id="event-2024-04-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Dnipro strikes.

**Archived source account.** Eighteen people, including five children, are injured in a Russian missile strike in Dnipro, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-damages-educational-facility-ukraines-dnipro-governor-says-2024-04-02/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war / Israeli bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Iran's Supreme National Security Council says that it has decided on a response to the Israeli attack on its diplomatic facilities in Damascus, Syria, which killed several high-ranking members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/02/iran-response-israeli-strike-damascus-consulate>).

<a id="event-2024-04-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Ethnic violence in South Sudan.

**Archived source account.** Armed youths belonging to the Murle people attack a village in Greater Pibor Administrative Area, South Sudan, killing 12 people and injuring 10 others, with 15 children reported missing. Most of the victims were elderly residents.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-12-killed-15-children-missing-south-sudan-attack-2024-04-02/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: Gayrettepe nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-nine people are killed and eight others are injured in a fire at a nightclub under renovation in Istanbul, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/fire-istanbul-nightclub-kills-15-people-mayor-says-2024-04-02/>).

Source citations (as archived): [AOL](<https://www.aol.com/news/six-children-dead-14-injured-190225128.html>).

Context: 2024 Mexican general election.

Context: Viertola school shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/finland-school-shooting-helsinki-viertola-8f2e89a87bbea73f554f946ca0b785af>); [Yle](<https://yle.fi/a/74-20081687>).

### 2024-04-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1318860654](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20April%203&oldid=1318860654>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-04-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine lowers the age of conscription from 27 years to 25.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/03/ukraine-military-draft-age-law>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/04/03/world/europe/zelensky-ukraine-military-draft-age.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-04-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Army Corps of Engineers begins dredging the San Juan Bay in Puerto Rico to open space for a new natural gas terminal that is expected to add $400 million to the local economy.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/article/puerto-rico-san-juan-bay-dredging-environment-0a6a0c0cd0e197c0fb32593e0ca567e1>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-04-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Hualien earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.4 earthquake strikes off the coast of Taiwan, prompting tsunami warnings for Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. A large section of the uninhabited Guishan Island collapses into the ocean. Nine people are killed in Taiwan, including four by rockfalls, with more than 930 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/taiwan-earthquake-tsunami-f086aac0c3082036d1ca77c01828fb28>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/4/3/taiwan-7-5-earthquake-live-tsunami-warnings-in-japan-philippines-taiwan>).

<a id="event-2024-04-03-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people, including two children are killed in a fire at a tailoring shop in Aurangabad, India.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/article/india-fire-tailoring-shop-mararashtra-3eaf225df7a1ec461a75c6f6902ba855>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-04-03-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Philippines relations, Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines says that it will respond to any Chinese attempts to interfere with its resupply of troops in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-says-it-is-committed-maintaining-position-second-thomas-shoal-2024-04-03/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** The National Defense Ministry of Taiwan says that more than 30 Chinese PLA Air Force warplanes have entered Taiwanese airspace and that at least nine PLA Navy warships have been detected around Taiwan. The ROC Armed Forces are deployed in response to the violation.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Now News](<https://www.timesnownews.com/world/asia/over-30-chinese-warplanes-9-navy-vessels-around-taiwan-report-article-108989298>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-04-03-4-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Uganda.

**Archived source account.** Uganda's Constitutional Court upholds the Anti-Homosexuality Act, 2023, which prescribes the death penalty for certain homosexual acts.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/3257708/uganda-top-court-declines-block-controversial-anti-gay-law-sees-some-rights-infringed?module=Africa&amp;pgtype=section>).

### 2024-04-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218268134](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20April%204&oldid=1218268134>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches multiple Shahed drone strikes on Kharkiv, Ukraine, killing at least five people, including three rescue workers, and injuring five others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-rescue-workers-killed-russian-drone-attack-ukraines-kharkiv-officials-say-2024-04-03/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian appointed officials claim that Ukrainian shelling has killed two civilians and injured nine others in Donetsk. Separately, four people are killed in drone attacks in Russian-occupied Kherson Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-installed-officials-say-six-civilians-killed-ukrainian-attacks-2024-04-04/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** U.S Secretary of State Antony Blinken says that Ukraine will eventually become a NATO member.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-secretary-state-blinken-says-ukraine-will-be-nato-member-2024-04-04/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two West Papua National Liberation Army leaders, including Abubakar Tabuni, are killed during a shootout with the Indonesian Army near the Grasberg mine in Mimika Regency, Central Papua.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-papua-clashes-rebel-leaders-grasberg-mine-a427101fe9d7fbcbdbc527d5942fbee2>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-8"></a>

Context: Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Eleven security forces, including five Revolutionary Guards, are killed in Sistan and Baluchestan, Iran, during an attack against the Revolutionary Guards' headquarters by members of Jaish ul-Adl. Sixteen militants are killed in the ensuing shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/militants-kill-5-iranian-security-officers-southeast-state-media-says-2024-04-04/>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Former Al-Nusra Front emir Abu Maria al-Qahtani is assassinated in a suicide bombing in Sarmada, Idlib Governorate, Syria. The Islamic State are accused of being behind the attack, which also injured several others at his house.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/top-iraqi-jihadist-killed-suicide-bombing-northwest-syria-2024-04-05/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-04-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 99 Cents Only Stores announces an orderly wind-down, closing all of its 371 stores in the United States beginning April 5.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/99-cents-only-stores-close-4-states-1887194>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shipping lanes and airspace in the Great Belt strait in Denmark are closed for several hours after a missile launcher malfunctions on the frigate Niels Juel.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2024-04-04-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2024 H5N1 outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Scientists from the Federation University Australia report that thousands of Adélie penguins have been found dead in Antarctica amid an increase in bird flu cases among wild bird populations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/scientists-investigate-thousands-dead-antarctic-penguins-bird-flu-2024-04-04/>).

Context: 2020–2024 H5N1 outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Bird flu spreads to cattle herds in at least six U.S. states, while a dairy farm worker is infected in Texas, becoming the second person to ever become infected with the virus in the United States.

<a id="event-2024-04-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, the Speaker of the National Assembly of South Africa, is arrested and charged with corruption one day after resigning from office.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/south-african-parliament-speaker-resigns-charged-with-corruption/7556627.html>).

<a id="event-2024-04-04-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man stabs the Governor of Murmansk Oblast Andrey Chibis at a meeting in Apatity, Murmansk Oblast, Russia. The attacker is arrested by police.

<a id="event-2024-04-04-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Maltese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Myriam Spiteri Debono is sworn in as President of Malta, succeeding George Vella and becoming the third woman to hold the office.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Malta](<https://timesofmalta.com/article/watch-myriam-spiteri-debono-arrives-sworn-11th-president-malta.1090397>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-04-04-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument in Arizona, United States, release the largest 3D map of the universe featuring more than six million galaxies. Using this map, researchers are able to measure the acceleration of the expansion rate of the universe with unprecedented accuracy, detecting hints that the rate of expansion has been increasing over time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2024/apr/04/biggest-ever-3d-map-universe-dark-energy-data-scientists>); [Berkeley Lab](<https://newscenter.lbl.gov/2024/04/04/desi-first-results-make-most-precise-measurement-of-expanding-universe/>).

Junta planes subsequently bomb the town, causing more than 1,000 locals to flee into neighbouring Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/11/asia/myanmar-myawaddy-knu-military-junta-intl-hnk/index.html>); [Radio Free Asia](<https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/residents-flee-myawaddy-04102024054612.html>).

## May

### 2024-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1227208370](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20May%201&oldid=1227208370>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-05-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Odesa strikes.

**Archived source account.** Two Russian ballistic missiles strike the port city of Odesa, killing three people and injuring sixteen others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-three-ukrainian-port-odesa-2024-05-01/>); [Reuters 2](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missile-strikes-ukrainian-port-odesa-13-injured-regional-governor-says-2024-05-01/>); [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/31925>).

<a id="event-2024-05-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia displays captured NATO military vehicles and equipment at an open-air exhibition in Victory Park on Poklonnaya Hill in Moscow. Among the captured vehicles are a German Leopard 2 tank and an American M1 Abrams tank.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68934205>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/russias-kremlin-parades-western-equipment-captured-ukrainian-army-exhibition>).

<a id="event-2024-05-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli invasion of Gaza, Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Amid pressure from the United States, Israel reopens the Erez-Beit Hanoun Crossing and allows aid trucks into the northern part of the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-allows-trucks-newly-reopened-erez-crossing-into-gaza-after-us-pressure-2024-05-01/>).

Context: 2024 Guangdong floods.

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war / Colombia–Israel relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/colombia-president-petro-says-will-break-diplomatic-relations-with-israel-2024-05-01/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-05-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Rwanda asylum plan.

**Archived source account.** British authorities begin detaining migrants ahead of deportation flights to Rwanda.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-begins-detaining-migrants-set-be-deported-rwanda-2024-05-01/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-01-3-2"></a>

Context: Rwanda asylum plan.

**Archived source account.** Irish Taoiseach Simon Harris announces the deployment of 100 police officers to the border with Northern Ireland amid fears that thousands of migrants might flee the UK in order to avoid deportation to Rwanda. Ireland also declares the United Kingdom a "safe country" so that asylum seekers can be deported back to the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/05/01/sunak-dont-send-police-to-irish-border-to-stop-migrants/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czq588jqz8lo>).

<a id="event-2024-05-01-3-4"></a>

Context: Abortion in North Carolina.

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal judge Catherine Eagles blocks several of North Carolina's restrictions on the abortion pill mifepristone, striking down a requirement that the drug can only be prescribed by doctors in-person, as well as a requirement for patients to have an in-person follow-up appointment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-judge-blocks-some-north-carolina-restrictions-abortion-pill-2024-05-01/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-01-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A student is fatally shot by police officers outside Mount Horeb Middle School in Mount Horeb, Wisconsin, United States, after the police received reports of someone carrying a weapon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-police-fire-tear-gas-detain-dozens-may-day-protesters-istanbul-2024-05-01/>).

**Archived source account.** At least 45 people are arrested and 12 police officers are injured at May Day protests in Paris. French police use tear gas and batons to disperse several protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/riot-police-protesters-clash-paris-during-may-day-protests-2024-05-01/>).

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests / 2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses / 2024 University of California, Los Angeles pro-Palestinian campus occupation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/united-methodist-lgbtq-clergy-general-conference-acabe18fe22b6838e3005ad8895534fa>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/books/article/2024/may/21/jenny-erpenbeck-michael-hofmann-win-2024-international-booker-prize-kairos>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-05-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pixar Animation Studios lays off 14% of its workforce, approximately 175 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/pixar-animation-lay-off-about-14-workforce-2024-05-21/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-05-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Singapore Airlines Flight 321.

**Archived source account.** A Singapore Airlines flight from London, England, to Singapore makes an emergency landing at Suvarnabhumi Airport in Bangkok, Thailand, after experiencing severe air turbulence over the Bay of Bengal, resulting in one death and 104 injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8889d7x8j4o>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven workers drown after a microbus falls off a ferry into the Nile River in Giza, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/523963/Egypt/Urban--Transport/-women-drown-as-microbus-falls-off-Nile-ferry-in-G.aspx>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and 35 are injured as a strong tornado devastates the town of Greenfield, Iowa, United States. A Doppler on Wheels unit records a wind gust of between 250 mph and 290 mph over Greenfield, the strongest winds recorded inside a tornado by a mobile weather radar since the 2013 El Reno tornado, equivalent to EF5 intensity on the Enhanced Fujita scale.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/severe-weather-midwest-iowa-tornadoes-26c73e14ab481ef77a1b0606a2b10adc>); [University of Illinois](<https://x.com/dowfacility/status/1793317945294094337>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-05-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Spain permanently recalls its ambassador from Argentina amid a diplomatic crisis over President of Argentina Javier Milei's comments about Prime Minister of Spain Pedro Sánchez's wife, Begoña Gómez.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2024/05/21/espana-retira-embajadora-buenos-aires-argentina-orix/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Moldova–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Moldova becomes the first non-European Union (EU) signatory country to sign a security and defense pact with the EU to receive assistance in strengthening and managing its borders, facilitating cooperation in cybersecurity, and combating disinformation.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/moldova-security-defense-pact-eu-security-cooperation-josep-borrell-border-management-cybersecurity-disinformation/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Swiss parliamentary committee rejects a ruling by the European Court of Human Rights that alleged the country violated its citizens' human rights by not doing enough to prevent climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/swiss-parliamentary-committee-rejects-european-climate-ruling-2024-05-21/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-05-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Ministry of Communications seizes broadcasting equipment from the Associated Press and suspends their live feed of Gaza, accusing them of breaking the new media law by supplying images to Al Jazeera.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/live-transmission-israel-associated-press-57e8f662907334ba3599156276381190>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canadian serial killer Robert Pickton is reported to be on life support after being physically attacked in a prison in Port-Cartier, Quebec.

Source citations (as archived): [Vancouver Sun](<https://vancouversun.com/news/crime/bc-serial-killer-robert-pickton-savagely-attacked-in-prison>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union passes the Artificial Intelligence Act, to be applied in 2026. The act imposes strict transparency obligations on AI systems, restricts governments from using real-time biometric surveillance in public spaces, and bans social scoring, predictive policing, and untargeted scraping of facial images.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-countries-back-landmark-artificial-intelligence-rules-2024-05-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Saint Petersburg, Russia, sentences Anatoly Maslov, a 77-year-old hypersonic missiles expert, to 14 years in prison for state treason.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-hypersonics-expert-jailed-14-years-treason-2024-05-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-21-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands moves to ban international adoptions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/netherlands-will-no-longer-allow-international-adoptions-2024-05-21/>).

### 2024-05-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1327256467](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20May%2022&oldid=1327256467>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-05-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russia captures the village of Klishchiivka in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/23/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-818>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and four are injured by Ukrainian shelling in Lysychansk, Luhansk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/23/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-818>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Sweden announces US$7 billion in military aid to Ukraine from 2024 to 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-05-22/sweden-plans-7-billion-in-military-aid-to-ukraine-for-2024-2026>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia returns six Ukrainian children displaced by the war back to Ukraine, in a deal brokered by Qatar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/russia-returns-six-children-to-ukraine-in-qatar-brokered-deal-state-media>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-0-8"></a>

Context: 2024 New Caledonia unrest.

**Archived source account.** Australia and New Zealand begin evacuating their citizens from New Caledonia amid civil unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/new-caledonia-france-macron-australia-new-zealand-f3d9c67561bda538c5cfda37251573f9>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-05-22-1-1"></a>

Context: San Pedro Garza García stage collapse.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed, including a child, and 213 are injured after a temporary stage collapses in high winds at a campaign event for the Citizens' Movement party in San Pedro Garza Garcia, Nuevo León, Mexico. Later, the Nuevo León government pledges 400,000 pesos ($23,900) in compensation to families of the deceased.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-election-maynez-wind-stage-knocked-over-1c4745f31a5b3caf2bce2db47d7cec12>); [El País](<https://elpais.com/mexico/2024-05-23/muertos-y-heridos-tras-colapso-del-escenario-donde-alvarez-maynez-celebraba-un-mitin-en-nuevo-leon.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-state-pledges-compensation-stage-collapse-victims-2024-05-24/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-05-22-2-2"></a>

Context: International recognition of the State of Palestine / Norway–Palestine relations, Ireland–Palestine relations, Palestine–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** The governments of Norway, Ireland, and Spain announce that they will recognise the State of Palestine as a sovereign state beginning on May 28, and also call for a two-state solution. In response, Israel recalls its ambassadors to these countries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-69047220>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-2-4"></a>

Context: Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence proposes to unilaterally adjust Russia's maritime border in the Baltic Sea, prompting comments of concern made by Baltic members of NATO, including Finland and Lithuania. The Ministry of Defense later retracts the proposal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-ministry-proposes-revising-baltic-sea-border-2024-05-22/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6ppl5v1lwzo>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-05-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Bishkek riots.

**Archived source account.** The Kyrgyz Ministry of Internal Affairs announces that ten people, including four foreigners, have been detained in connection with violent riots that occurred in Bishkek last week.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyz-foreign-nationals-detained-mob-attack/32959434.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-05-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Chadian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Succès Masra of the transitional government resigns after Mahamat Déby is elected President.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/chad-prime-minister-resigns-after-disputed-vote-winner-confirmed>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 United Kingdom general election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Rishi Sunak announces that the next general election will be held on 4 July.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/22/uk/uk-early-elections-sunak-conservatives-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-4-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Vietnamese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Security Minister Tô Lâm is elected President by the National Assembly, two months after the resignation of Võ Văn Thưởng amid the ruling Communist Party's anti-corruption campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/vietnam-elects-to-lam-as-new-president/a-69145381>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Joe Biden announces a student loan debt cancellation of $7.7 billion for 160,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/biden-cancels-7-7bn-more-in-student-debt-for-160000-borrowers>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** German far-right party Alternative for Germany bans Maximilian Krah, its leading candidate in European elections, from further activities due to his comments defending members of the Schutzstaffel (SS).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/germanys-afd-bans-top-candidate-from-eu-poll-events-over-nazi-comments>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-05-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia launches a Soyuz-2 rocket carrying the Kosmos 2576 satellite from the Plesetsk Cosmodrome launch site in Arkhangelsk Oblast. The United States Space Command accuses it of being an anti-satellite weapon capable of attacking other satellites, and is in the same orbit as a satellite operated by the National Reconnaissance Office.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/russia-launches-space-weapon-in-path-of-us-satellite-pentagon>).

<a id="event-2024-05-22-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council votes against a resolution introduced by Russia and China banning member states from placing weapons in outer space.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/russian-space-weapon-ban-un-security-council>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2024-05-22-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023–24 UEFA Europa League.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Atalanta win the UEFA Europa League over Bayer Leverkusen by a score of 3–0 in the final, ending Bayer Leverkusen's record of 51 unbeaten games. It is also Atalanta's first major trophy since 1963.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2024/may/22/atalanta-v-bayer-leverkusen-europa-league-final-live-score-updates>).

<a id="event-2024-05-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Romanian author Mircea Cărtărescu wins the International Dublin Literary Award for his novel Solenoid, translated by Sean Cotter.

<a id="event-2024-05-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Thane explosion.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and 64 others are injured after an explosion of four boilers at a chemical factory in Dombivili, India.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 16 others are injured when the second floor of a restaurant collapses in Palma de Mallorca, Spain.

<a id="event-2024-05-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** China's People's Liberation Army begins two days of military drills around Taiwan. In response, Taiwan mobilizes its military.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqvv29gpqn1o>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-starts-military-drills-around-taiwan-days-after-new-president-takes-office-2024-05-23/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Diplomatic missions to Palestine.

**Archived source account.** Colombian President Gustavo Petro orders the opening of an embassy in Ramallah in the West Bank.

<a id="event-2024-05-23-3-5"></a>

Context: Kenya–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden announces during a state visit by Kenyan President William Ruto that he will designate Kenya a major non-NATO ally as it is expected to lead the international intervention in Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-expected-designate-kenya-major-non-nato-ally-source-says-2024-05-22/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/biden-kenya-state-visit>).

**Archived source account.** Russia removes the border markers signaling the border with Estonia on the Narva River, prompting a protest by the EU.

Context: United States v. Live Nation Entertainment.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Justice sues Ticketmaster and its parent company Live Nation, seeking the breakup of the company and accusing the company of creating a monopoly by eliminating competition and increasing prices.

<a id="event-2024-05-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly votes 84–19, with 68 abstentions, to establish July 11 as an annual day of remembrance for the Srebrenica genocide, despite receiving opposition from Serbia and Bosnian Serbs.

### 2024-05-24

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-05-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Sources claim that Russian President Vladimir Putin is interested in negotiating a ceasefire, which would freeze the conflict at the current frontlines.

<a id="event-2024-05-24-0-2"></a>

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-05-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Cannes Film Festival.

**Archived source account.** Norah becomes the first film from Saudi Arabia to screen as part of the official calendar at the Cannes Film Festival.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2515551/lifestyle>).

<a id="event-2024-05-24-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Cannes Film Festival.

**Archived source account.** Black Dog, a Chinese film directed by Guan Hu, wins the Un Certain Regard prize for international films at the Cannes Film Festival.

<a id="event-2024-05-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Enga landslide.

**Archived source account.** Four people are confirmed killed and many others are presumed dead in a landslide in Enga Province, Papua New Guinea.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-05-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Bishkek riots.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of international students from Pakistan and other Asian countries leave Kyrgyzstan following attacks by Kyrgyz nationalist mobs on student hostels in Bishkek earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hundreds-foreign-students-flee-kyrgyzstan-after-mob-attack-2024-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Crocus City Hall attack.

**Archived source account.** Russia arrests more than 20 people in connection with the Islamic State – Khorasan Province attack on the Crocus City Hall concert venue in Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast, in March.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-spy-chief-says-ukraine-was-directly-involved-moscow-concert-hall-attack-2024-05-24/>).

Context: South Africa's genocide case against Israel.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice, in a 13–2 decision, orders Israel to stop their military offensive in Rafah.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/world-court-rule-request-halt-israels-rafah-offensive-2024-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-24-3-7"></a>

Context: United States v. Live Nation Entertainment.

**Archived source account.** The first consumer class action lawsuit by ticket buyers is filed against Ticketmaster and Live Nation Entertainment, following the lawsuit filed by the United States Department of Justice.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/live-nation-ticket-buyers-sue-wake-us-justice-department-case-2024-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-05-24-3-9"></a>

Context: Uvalde school shooting.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-06-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A University of Illinois team lead by Joshua Wurman and Karen Kosiba confirms mobile radar measurements of between 309 mph and 318 mph in the tornado that struck Greenfield, Iowa, United States, on May 21. This is the first unambiguous radar confirmation of tornado winds over 300 mph.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/science/environment/storm-chasers-catch-tornado-300-mph-winds-rcna158040>); [University of Illinois](<https://x.com/dowfacility/status/1804575739330613507>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-07-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war.

<a id="event-2024-07-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** A review article published in the medical journal The Lancet estimates the total death toll of Palestinians in Gaza to be at least 186,000 compared to the currently reported number of 38,000, around 8% of Gaza's pre-war population. This is attributed to the lack of reporting for indirect deaths, as well as the lack of operating hospitals and officials to report those deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [The Lancet](<https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(24)01169-3/fulltext>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2024/02/29/1234159514/gaza-death-toll-30000-palestinians-israel-hamas-war>).

### 2024-07-08

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against infrastructure / 8 July 2024 Ukraine missile strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-provided-support-m23-rebels-congo-un-report-says-2024-07-08/>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20240708-rwandan-soldiers-fighting-with-m23-rebels-in-dr-congo-says-un-report>).

<a id="event-2024-07-18-3-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The Chandigarh–Dibrugarh Express derailed near Gonda on July 18. Contemporary reporting described twelve derailed coaches and an initial death toll of two. A later Ministry of Railways reply dated August 9 recorded four deaths and twelve injuries; these later figures do not establish the original report’s injury count.

Editorial date: 2024-07-18. Checked: 2026-10-21. The precise 25-injury figure has not been corroborated. Early and later casualty reports must retain their reporting times; this partial review does not turn either into a timeless final total. The original train-name ordering is preserved.

Evidence: [Deccan Herald](<https://www.deccanherald.com/india/uttar-pradesh-train-accident-news-at-least-10-coaches-of-chandigarh-dibrugarh-express-derail-in-gonda-indian-railways-yogi-aditynath-ashwini-vaishnaw-3110740>); [India Ministry of Railways / Rajya Sabha](<https://sansad.in/getFile/annex/265/AU2202_IW5XOK.pdf?source=pqars>).

Original source account: Twelve cars of the Dibrugarh–Chandigarh Express train derailed in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, India, resulting in at least two dead and 25 injured.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Belarus.

**Archived source account.** The Minsk Regional Court in Belarus, in a secretive trial, sentences a German national Rico Krieger to death over alleged crimes including terrorism and mercenary activity.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/belarus-sentences-german-man-to-death-for-terrorism-rights-group/a-69716052>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-3"></a>

Context: Gaza humanitarian crisis, Societal breakdown in the Gaza Strip during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations reports that "anarchy" and societal breakdown is expanding across the Gaza Strip due to Israeli military destabilization, citing an increase in looting and extrajudicial killings of police and humanitarian workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-rights-office-says-anarchy-spreading-gaza-2024-07-19/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-5"></a>

Context: ICJ case on Israel's occupation of the Palestinian territories, Israel and apartheid.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice rules that Israel's land annexation and settlement construction in East Jerusalem and the West Bank is unlawful, and demands an end to these practices "as soon as possible". The Court also rules that Israel's occupation in the West Bank amounts to apartheid.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/icj-court-israel-palestinians-settlements-2d5178500c0410341b252335859f2316>); [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/icj-delivers-landmark-opinion-57-year-israeli-occupation>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Yekaterinburg, Russia, convicts American journalist Evan Gershkovich of spying and sentences him to 16 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/19/media/evan-gershkovich-espionage-trial-verdict-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Communist Party general secretary and paramount leader of Vietnam Nguyễn Phú Trọng dies at the age of 80, and is succeeded on an acting basis by President Tô Lâm.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c51y3r09zr2o>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistani counter-terrorism authorities arrest Amin al-Haq, a high-ranking member of Al-Qaeda and a close confidant of Osama bin Laden.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisian-court-jails-opposition-leader-bans-him-presidential-elections-2024-07-19/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-10"></a>

<a id="event-2024-07-19-4-11"></a>

<a id="event-2024-07-26-2-1"></a>

Context: China–India relations, Sino-Indian border dispute.

**Archived source account.** China and India agree to cooperate in withdrawing all their troops from their disputed border, with aims of peacefully achieving "complete disengagement" from the border conflict as quickly as possible.

The Kremlin denounces the transfer as "illegal" under international law and pledges legal retaliation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/eu-russia-frozen-assets-ukraine-fund-b743697199adccd5187b4b59159b3a54>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-pledges-legal-action-over-planned-eu-transfer-ukraine-interest-accrued-2024-07-23/>).

**Archived source account.** A former top United States official states that the Department of Defense covertly admits to conducting a mass disinformation campaign targeting the Philippines using social media bots and fake accounts to discredit the safety of Chinese CoronaVac vaccinations during the COVID-19 pandemic, following public denial of involvement in June.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-told-philippines-it-made-missteps-secret-anti-vax-propaganda-effort-2024-07-26/>).

**Archived source account.** The Guatemalan government grants temporary resident permits to over 200 Mexicans, mostly children, on humanitarian grounds as they escape drug violence.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/guatemala-mexico-refugees-cartels-violence-b4a0d0f16ab9308a6505ca3c67911676>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Panama–Venezuela relations, 2024 Venezuelan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Panama suspends diplomatic relations with Venezuela and withdraws its diplomatic personnel from the country until a full review of the presidential election results is concluded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/several-feared-dead-after-landslides-indias-kerala-local-media-report-2024-07-30/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-07-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Southport stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Three children are killed and ten other people are injured in a mass stabbing at a dance school in Southport, Merseyside, England. A teenager is subsequently arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cevwgqz0x41t>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sakina Muhammad Jan becomes the first person to be jailed under Australia's forced marriage laws after ordering her 21-year-old daughter to marry a man who later murdered her.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx72ll7460vo>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Grand National Assembly of Turkey approves a law ordering the euthanization of stray dogs that are sick or have been deemed aggressive.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3272347/turkey-approves-controversial-stray-dog-cull>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** French police report multiple sabotage acts targeting telecommunications operators in parts of the country, affecting 11,000 clients, with the incidents being treated as vandalism.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/france-telecom-fiber-optic-networks-sabotaged/a-69795351>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/french-fiber-optic-cable-hit-with-alleged-acts-of-sabotage/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** King Mohammed VI of Morocco pardons jailed journalists Taoufik Bouachrine, Omar Radi, and Soulaimane Raissouni, along with 2,476 other convicts, as part of a gesture marking the 25th anniversary of his reign.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/morocco-releases-jailed-journalists-pardons-2476-convicts-2024-07-29/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-07-29-5-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan presidential election / Foreign relations of Venezuela / United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Antony Blinken states that the U.S. government has "serious concerns" that the Venezuelan election results do not reflect "the will nor the votes of the Venezuelan people" and demands that Venezuelan electoral authorities publish fair and transparent election results, adding that the United States and the international community will "respond accordingly".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/us-venezuela-blinken-dd01f952543c1b6ba9d243393202682f>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-5-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan presidential election / Foreign relations of Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela recalls its diplomats in Argentina, Chile, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Panama, Peru, and Uruguay after those countries oppose the election results.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/americas/venezuela-to-pull-envoys-from-seven-countries-after-protests-to-maduro-win-18189254>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-5-6"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan presidential election / 2024 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed as protests occur throughout Venezuela due to the disputed election results.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-presidential-election-maduro-machado-edmundo-results-acee6c8cd3a8fc88086c2dd71963b759>); [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/one-dead-in-venezuela-as-protesters-teargassed-in-wake-of-disputed-vote-101722309979909.html>).

<a id="event-2024-07-29-5-8"></a>

Context: 2024 Serbian environmental protests, Jadar mining project.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of environmentalists and opposition group members protest across Serbia against a European Union–Serbian government lithium mining project meant to reduce its dependency on Chinese lithium that would seize and raze several rivers and forests.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/serbia-protest-lithium-excavation-environment-175fd1eab486736b572b0ecbc8567783>).

Context: 2024 Summer Olympics / Concerns and controversies at the 2024 Summer Olympics.

### 2024-07-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1239585912](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20July%2030&oldid=1239585912>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict / 2024 Haret Hreik airstrike.

**Archived source account.** Israel launches a missile attack on southern Beirut, Lebanon, killing at least four civilians and injuring 80 others. Senior Hezbollah commander Fuad Shukr is claimed by Israel to be the main target. He was in the area at the time of the attack, but his status is currently unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/death-toll-from-israeli-strike-on-south-beirut-rises-to-4/3291038>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/7/30/israel-lebanon-tensions-live-israel-strikes-building-in-beirut-suburbs>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli civilian is killed in the HaGoshrim kibbutz by a rocket fired from Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/hezbollah-israel-conflict-not-inevitable-us-defense-secretary-says-2024-07-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Russian defense ministry says that its forces have taken control of the settlement of Pivdenne in Donetsk region, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-forces-took-control-pivdenne-eastern-ukraine-2024-07-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Attempted assassination of Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

**Archived source account.** Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, the military junta leader of Sudan, survives an assassination attempt carried out with a drone strike while he was visiting a military base in Gibet. Five people are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240731-sudan-army-chief-burhan-survives-assassination-attempt/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-11"></a>

Context: 2024 Southport riot.

**Archived source account.** Riots occur in response to a previous mass stabbing in Southport, Merseyside. The right-wing English Defence League was present in front of a mosque, despite not having existed for over a decade.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/article/2024/jul/31/three-arrested-over-southport-riots>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-13"></a>

Context: Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United States carries out an airstrike near Hillah, Iraq, killing four members of Iraq's Popular Mobilization Units. Iraq condemns the strike, saying the US-led military coalition committed a "heinous crime" by targeting security sites and said the attacks were a serious violation of the coalition's mission and mandate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/explosions-iraqs-pmf-security-agency-base-south-baghdad-kill-one-member-sources-2024-07-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-15"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Angolan President João Lourenço announces that the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda have agreed to a ceasefire following Angola-mediated talks.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT Afrika](<https://www.trtafrika.com/africa/ceasefire-reached-in-eastern-drc-18189698>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-17"></a>

Context: Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish defense ministry says that it targeted Kurdish militants in northern Iraq with air strikes, killing 13 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-says-it-killed-13-kurdish-militants-northern-iraq-2024-07-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-0-18"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen open fire on a bulletproof vehicle carrying local staff working for a United Nations development agency in Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan. No casualties have been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [TOI](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/gunmen-open-fire-on-a-vehicle-carrying-un-staff-in-northwest-pakistan-no-casualties/articleshow/112137504.cms>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tesla recalls more than 1.8 million vehicles due to a hood issue that could increase the risk of a crash. An over-the-air software update for the issue was made available in June.

Source citations (as archived): [Quartz](<https://qz.com/tesla-recall-electric-vehicles-models-hood-issues-nhtsa-1851608569>).

<a id="event-2024-07-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rex Airlines, Australia's third-largest airline, suspends all domestic Boeing 737 flights and enters voluntary administration.

Source citations (as archived): [AFR](<https://www.afr.com/companies/transport/rex-grounds-city-flights-virgin-steps-in-to-rescue-passengers-20240730-p5jxqz>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240730-spain-watchdog-fines-booking-com-413-mn-euros>).

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports that it is now "very likely" that poliovirus has infected Gazan citizens and is spreading among the population. The statement was released shortly after the Gaza Health Ministry declared a polio epidemic in the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/polio-cases-very-likely-gaza-population-who-says-2024-07-30/>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/gaza-health-ministry-declares-territory-polio-epidemic-area-24da98d1>).

Context: 2024 Wayanad landslides.

**Archived source account.** At least 162 people are killed, 191 others are injured, and more than 89 others are missing in landslides in Wayanad district, Kerala, India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/thiruvananthapuram/wayanad-landslide-news-live-updates-hundreds-feared-trapped-govt-launches-massive-rescue-operation/liveblog/112122036.cms>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/30/several-feared-dead-hundreds-trapped-after-landslides-hit-indias-kerala>).

### 2024-07-31

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-07-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh.

**Archived source account.** Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh is assassinated in Tehran, Iran, after attending the inauguration ceremony of Iranian president Masoud Pezeshkian. Hamas and Iran blame Israel for the assassination; however, the Israeli government officially declines to comment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/31/life-of-defiance-ismail-haniyeh-hamas-political-boss-killed>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-hamas-israel-30968a7acb31cd8b259de9650014b779>).

<a id="event-2024-07-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh.

**Archived source account.** Qatar and Egypt warn that peace negotiations are in jeopardy as a result of the assassination.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/qatar-pm-says-how-can-mediation-succeed-when-one-side-assassinates-negotiator-2024-07-31/>).

<a id="event-2024-07-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Killing of journalists in the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera Arabic journalist Ismail al-Ghoul and his cameraman are killed in an Israeli airstrike while conducting a news broadcast near Ismail Haniyeh's home in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/31/al-jazeera-journalist-cameraman-killed-in-gaza-attack>).

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict / Killing of Fuad Shukr.

**Archived source account.** A source close to Hezbollah tells AFP that the body of top commander Fuad Shukr has been recovered, nearly 24 hours after he was killed in an Israeli airstrike on southern Beirut, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/07/31/body-of-hezbollah-s-commander-fuad-shukr-found-in-rubble-in-beirut>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/body-hezbollah-military-commander-found-beirut-rubble-two-security-sources-say-2024-07-31/>).

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

Context: Mali War / Battle of Tinzaouaten.

**Archived source account.** The Cavite provincial government in the Philippines declares a "state of calamity" after an oil spill from the sunk MT Terra Nova ship reaches the shores of eight municipalities, requiring implementation of a no-catch zone and relief aid to be given to around 25,000 fishermen.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/eu-spain-police-sex-abuse-6327a563efaa8266e350915c49750d6e>).

Journalist Evan Gershkovich, former marine Paul Whelan, and Russian opposition figure Vladimir Kara-Murza are among those freed.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The original August 8 claim remains incompletely corroborated. An Arab News report published August 8 describes a strike the preceding day that killed a civilian and a Hezbollah member. Its reported injury figures differ from the portal entry, so it does not establish the portal’s exact event date and three-civilian injury total.

Editorial date: 2024-08-08. Checked: 2026-10-21. Possible publication-date/event-date confusion remains unresolved. Keep the original August 8 placement and wording; the similar August 7 report is a research lead rather than proof that the accounts describe one identical incident.

Evidence: [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.pk/middle-east/fatalities-in-israeli-attack-include-head-of-hezbollahs-anti-tank-rocket-unit-2564576>).

Original source account: One Lebanese civilian and a Hezbollah militant are killed and three Lebanese civilians are injured in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Conscription was previously scrapped in 2008 when Croatia shifted to a volunteer-based system.

### 2024-08-16

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2024 Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine reports capturing 82 Russian settlements within an area of 1150 sqkm since the start of the Kursk incursion on August 6.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-its-forces-advance-1-3-km-russias-kursk-region-2024-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2024 Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Over 120,000 Russian citizens have been evacuated according to Russia, and at least 100 Russian soldiers are captured according to Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-fighting-sudzha-kursk-090f03d7f809af49ae9957e851525eb1>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2024 Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russia accuses the United States and European nations of directly helping Ukraine in its incursion on Kursk Oblast by planning operations and providing military support, and states that their involvement "created all the prerequisites for Ukraine to lose its sovereignty and lose part of its territories".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/kremlin-aide-says-nato-west-helped-ukraine-attack-russia-2024-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile strike on an airbase in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Ukraine, destroys a MiG-29 jet that was equipped with Storm Shadow missiles. Ukraine's air force spokesperson Yurii Ihnat later confirms the loss of the aircraft on August 20. There are no casualties reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-lost-mig-29-fighter-jet-air-force-says/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli occupation of the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** One Palestinian is killed and many houses are burned down in a large organized Israeli settler raid on the village of Jit, Qalqilya Governorate, in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/17/middleeast/west-bank-settler-attack-jit-israel-intl/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinians-describe-brutal-west-bank-settler-attack-2024-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-11"></a>

Context: Ituri conflict.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and 20 more kidnapped during an attack by Allied Democratic Forces militants at agricultural lands in Mambasa, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-violence-islamicstate-ituri-e8a24f7922bad8c2599c65dc94ea0537>).

<a id="event-2024-08-16-0-13"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen soldiers are killed and 18 more injured during a suicide car bombing in Mudiyah, Abyan Governorate, Yemen. Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/16/suicide-bomber-kills-16-soldiers-in-southern-yemen-official-says>).

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people are ordered to evacuate in northern Japan as Typhoon Ampil approaches the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2024/08/17/officials-report-case-of-polio-in-gaza-as-un-appeals-for-ceasefire-to-roll-out-vaccines>).

Context: Haitian crisis.

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / Cornel West 2024 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Thai House of Representatives selects Paetongtarn Shinawatra as the new Prime Minister, replacing Srettha Thavisin who was dismissed by the Constitutional Court on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-08-16/thailand-new-pm-thaksin-s-daughter-paetongtarn-shinawatra-elected-as-premier>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / August 2024 Deir el-Balah attacks.

<a id="event-2024-08-17-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Two senior Hamas militants are killed in an Israeli airstrike in Jenin in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-airstrike-kills-least-two-palestinians-west-bank-health-ministry-says-2024-08-17/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-17-0-7"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal.

**Archived source account.** Israeli officials state that they are attempting to "lower expectations" of a ceasefire deal due to significant gaps between Israel and Hamas demands, after United States president Joe Biden stated that he was "optimistic" about the progress of US-mediated negotiations in Qatar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/17/israel-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-attacks-continue-as-focus-on-truce-talks?update=3123123>).

<a id="event-2024-08-17-0-11"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2024 Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Rockets launched by the Armed Forces of Ukraine destroy a Russian bridge over the Seym river in Glushkovo, Kursk Oblast. Russia's foreign ministry claims that the missiles were launched using Western-made rocket launchers and that the missiles killed volunteers who were evacuating Russian civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-ukraine-used-western-rockets-destroy-bridge-kursk-region-2024-08-17/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-17-0-13"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War, Budget of Germany, Germany–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany issues an indefinite ban on requesting or providing new military aid to Ukraine that has not already been approved in order to reduce federal budget spending. The moratorium results in a "tangible dispute" within the Scholz coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-halt-new-ukraine-military-aid-report-war-russia/>); [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/germany-to-limit-new-military-aid-to-ukraine-faz-reports/>).

**Archived source account.** The International Atomic Energy Agency declares that the safety of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant is deteriorating, following an investigation into an explosive drone strike that targeted a perimeter access road at the power plant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-accuses-ukraine-bombing-road-near-zaporizhzhia-nuclear-power-plant-2024-08-17/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign / Pokrovsk offensive.

<a id="event-2024-08-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

<a id="event-2024-08-19-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Belarus announces that it has further increased its Belarus–Ukraine border presence against Ukraine significantly, adding aircraft and air defense forces following its accusations of Ukraine's military sending 120,000 troops to its border and conducting "aggressive policies". Ukraine denies Lukashenko's claims, stating its forces have not observed unusual movements of Belarusian troops on the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-says-it-sends-more-troops-aircraft-armoury-border-with-ukraine-2024-08-20/>).

**Archived source account.** Nine people, including five security officers and four civilians are killed and dozens are injured in an Al-Shabaab suicide car bomb attack on a security checkpoint on the Mogadishu–Afgoye highway in Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Post Nigeria](<https://www.nationalaccordnewspaper.com/10-die-in-mogadishu-suicide-car-bombing/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-08-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Unemployment in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Labor issues a significant estimate correction stating that the U.S. economy added 818,000 fewer jobs between April 2023 and March 2024 than what was initially reported in July, the largest estimate revision since 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/jobs-hiring-employers-workers-government-labor-department-eae6b26b76136cf4936fbc781f79c2f4>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2024/08/21/nonfarm-payroll-growth-revised-down-by-818000-labor-department-says.html>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-1-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Canada railway shutdown.

**Archived source account.** Canada's two largest freight railroads Canadian Pacific Kansas City and Canadian National Railway announce a complete shutdown of services due to a contract dispute, shutting out its Teamsters-represented union workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/canadian-national-railways-canadian-pacific-lock-out-teamsters-union-workers-2024-08-22/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/canadian-railroad-unions-cpkc-csx-a8b705c9b2e69bb8a8bc97d28f0be23c>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** With regards to the rapid growth of the artificial intelligence market, Bloomberg alleges that technology companies are "concealing their actual carbon footprints" by invoking outdated emissions accounting rules.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-08-21/ai-tech-giants-hide-dirty-energy-with-outdated-carbon-accounting-rules/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-08-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Atchutapuram pharmaceutical factory explosion.

**Archived source account.** At least seventeen workers are killed and 41 others are injured, many from severe chemical burns, in an explosion at a pharmaceutical facility in Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/india/skin-peeling-off-chemical-burns-andhra-reactor-blast-killed-14-broken-homes-9526074/>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/18-injured-in-explosion-at-andhra-pradesh-pharma-company-6385152>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-eight people are killed and 23 others are injured when a bus carrying Shia Pakistani pilgrims to the Arba'in pilgrimage in Iraq crashes and overturns in Yazd province, Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/28-killed-23-injured-bus-accident-carrying-pakistani-pilgrims-iran-isna-reports-2024-08-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four bodies are recovered from the superyacht Bayesian that sank two days ago, bringing the death toll to five. The search for the last missing person is ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/search-resumes-six-missing-after-mike-lynchs-yacht-sank-hopes-dim-2024-08-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 mpox epidemic.

**Archived source account.** Thailand reports its first case of mpox in a 66-year-old European man who worked in an African country affected by the ongoing epidemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/21/world/asia/thailand-mpox.html>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-3-2"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 mpox epidemic.

**Archived source account.** Several suspected cases of mpox clade 1b are reported in Somerset, England, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Devon Live](<https://www.devonlive.com/news/health/suspected-monkeypox-case-identified-devon-9499313.amp>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-3-3"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 mpox epidemic.

**Archived source account.** Honduras reports five suspected cases of the new mpox clade.

<a id="event-2024-08-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Hungary and the Russo-Ukrainian war, Hungary–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** A Hungarian law restricting or removing state support and accommodations for Ukrainian refugees not from regions directly affected by the Russian invasion comes into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckg2jxjd7r7o>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Sanski Most school shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three staff members are killed in a mass shooting at a school in Sanski Most, Bosnia and Herzegovina. The perpetrator, who also worked at the school, is seriously injured after shooting himself.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-school-shooting-employee-8047c11fda2bb9bcee0a9d25c903072f>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people, including three children, are killed in a house fire in Bradford, England, United Kingdom. Police say that the fire was started deliberately and that a suspect has been arrested under suspicion of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9r48nzx33o>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-08-21-5-1"></a>

Context: International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The United States drafts a punitive sanctions list of sixty Venezuelan government officials from the country's National Electoral Council, Supreme Court, and counterintelligence police agency for alleged electoral fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-drafts-list-60-venezuelans-possible-sanctions-over-election-sources-say-2024-08-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-21-5-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.ua/rubric-polytics/3897252-rada-ratifikuvala-rimskij-statut.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-08-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

<a id="event-2024-08-22-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eleven police officers are killed in an ambush on a convoy by armed attackers near Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-08-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Botswana presents to the public a 2,492-carat raw diamond, discovered by the Lucara diamond and mining company from the Karowe diamond mine, and said to be the second largest in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/diamond-botswana-largest-carats-mining-0a736574d7cadaa8d9fe23c651ece97a>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/22/diamond-found-in-botswana-could-be-worlds-second-largest-gem>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-08-22-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Canada railway shutdown.

**Archived source account.** Canadian National Railway and Canadian Pacific Kansas City lock out roughly 10,000 unionized railroad workers in Canada, leading to a railway stoppage that impacts many North American supply chains and may cost the economy of Canada C$341 million per day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/canadian-national-railways-canadian-pacific-lock-out-teamsters-union-workers-2024-08-22/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-22-2-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Canada railway shutdown.

**Archived source account.** In response to the railway stoppage, Canadian labour minister Steven MacKinnon refers the two disputes to binding arbitration.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/cn-railway-cpkc-lockout-job-action-negotiations-1.7301419>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-08-22-3-2"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 South American drought / 2024 Brazil wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Nearly 1,500 firefighters are dispatched to contain intense wildfires that are causing dense hazardous smoke to fully "engulf" Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, with the total number of wildfires in Brazil reaching 59,000 since the start of the year.

Context: Thai Flying Service Flight 209.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed when a Cessna 208 Caravan crashes into a mangrove forest in Chachoengsao shortly after taking off from Suvarnabhumi Airport in Bangkok, Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-plane-crash-cessna-chachoengsao-bangkok-airport-6997869f9000749f953fa5a54dc227ae>); [The Nation Thailand](<https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40040814>).

<a id="event-2024-08-22-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed after a boat carrying migrants capsize while trying to cross the Drina river from Serbia to Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/death-toll-rises-11-after-boat-capsized-between-bosnia-serbia-media-say-2024-08-23/>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation Thailand](<https://www.nationthailand.com/news/world/40040844>).
