<a id="event-2024-08-22-5-1"></a>

Context: Belarus–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Belarus and China agree to greatly strengthen mutual trade, financial, energy, and security cooperation, which includes enhancing industrial supply chains and collaboration with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china-belarus-agree-strengthen-cooperation-trade-security-2024-08-23/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-08-22-6-1"></a>

Context: Treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban bans women from singing, reciting poetry, or reading aloud in public and mandates that women must wear a veil in public under new laws approved by the Supreme Leader as part of efforts to combat "vice" and promote "virtue".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/08/22/taliban-bans-women-s-voices-bare-faces-in-public-under-new-vice-laws-in-afghanistan>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-08-22-7-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Indonesian local election law protests, 2024 Indonesian local elections.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather outside the House of Representatives in Jakarta, Indonesia, as well as in other major cities across the country, to protest attempted changes to local elections law that would benefit the ruling coalition, in defiance of two recent Constitutional Court decisions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8er13zy1gxo>).

<a id="event-2024-08-22-7-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Indonesian local election law protests, 2024 Indonesian local elections.

**Archived source account.** Police fire tear gas and water cannons at protesters attempting to storm the House of Representatives, prompting the Parliament to delay and eventually cancel the vote on the proposed changes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-protest-jokowi-widodo-345949895cc83bd18abcd90f2d1a9715>).

<a id="event-2024-08-22-7-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Venezuela certifies the results of the 2024 presidential election, denying claims that opposition candidate Edmundo González Urrutia won the election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-election-supreme-court-certifies-maduro-39d9f3b9beb0fe96fa052e4d2a3c106b>).

<a id="event-2024-08-22-7-6"></a>

Context: Human rights in Afghanistan, Afghanistan and the United Nations.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban prohibits Richard Bennett, the United Nations special rapporteur on human rights in Afghanistan, from entering the country, accusing him of spreading propaganda.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/taliban-ban-un-human-rights-rapporteur-in-afghanistan/a-70011037>).

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a new military aid package to Ukraine, including air defense missiles, munitions for High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS), an array of anti-armor missiles, vehicles, and other equipment.

<a id="event-2024-08-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah launches over 100 rocket strikes on Israel Defense Forces targets in Mount Meron and Al-Malkiyya that were intercepted by Iron Dome and caused wildfires.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-6-hezbollah-members-killed-in-idf-strikes-as-projectiles-fired-at-north/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven Hezbollah militants are killed in Israeli airstrikes and shelling on Tayr Harfa and Shebaa in southern Lebanon.

Context: Surovikino penal colony hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Four inmates linked to the Islamic State seize control of a prison in Surovikino, Volgograd Oblast, Russia, and take hostages, killing four prison staff members and injuring three others. The attackers are shot dead by responding security forces.

<a id="event-2024-08-23-4-1"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Russia–United States relations, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Treasury Department imposes sanctions on more than 400 individuals and entities, including Chinese firms that are allegedly aiding Russia in order to avoid western sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-imposes-sanctions-400-more-targets-aiding-russias-war-effort-2024-08-23/>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/08/23/politics/us-sanctions-russia/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-08-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, India–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** During a meeting in Kyiv, Ukraine, Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi urges Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to end the Russo-Ukrainian War, and volunteers to act as a mediator in talks between Zelenskyy and Russia. In a later national address, Zelenskyy thanked Modi but stated that it is necessary for India to respect international law as well as Ukraine's territorial integrity and sovereignty.

Context: Poland–South Africa relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/south-africa-blocks-artillery-shells-delivery-to-poland-due-to-fear-of-transfer-to-ukraine-media-says/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-23-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 antisemitic riots in the North Caucasus.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-court-sentences-five-men-anti-israel-riots-dagestan-airport-2024-08-23/>).

Context: 2024 Solingen stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and eight others are wounded in a mass stabbing at a public festival Solingen, NRW, Germany, during celebrations for the 650th anniversary of the city. A manhunt for the suspect and a citywide shelter-in-place emergency for residents are ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-knife-attack-solingen-festival-84ad7df23ca5ecc8c2145d57e75090d6?utm_source=RecoReel&amp;utm_medium=articlePage&amp;utm_id=Taboola>).

<a id="event-2024-08-23-5-5"></a>

Context: 2024 United Kingdom riots.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination recommends that the United Kingdom implement bans and auditing of hate speech, xenophobia, and far-right rhetoric by politicians, in addition to prohibiting the strip-searching of children and addressing the over-policing of schools, following widespread destructive anti-immigration protests exacerbated by remarks made by public figures and politicians.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/curb-hate-speech-after-riots-un-committee-urges-britain-2024-08-23/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/article/2024/aug/23/un-urges-uk-to-tackle-rise-in-racist-hate-speech-by-politicans-and-public-figures>).

<a id="event-2024-08-23-6-2"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 2024 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announces that he is ending his presidential campaign and endorses Donald Trump's campaign. However, Kennedy will remain on the ballot in some states as he has already registered his campaign there.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/4844566-rfk-jr-suspends-campaign-trump/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/08/23/rfk-drops-out-2024-supports-donald-trump/74896591007/>).

### 2024-08-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355647085](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20August%2024&oldid=1355647085>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal.

**Archived source account.** Hamas states that it will refuse any ceasefire conditions that allow Israel to continue to control the Rafah Crossing and Philadelphi Corridor, and also accuses the United States of spreading false optimism to support Democratic nominee Kamala Harris's presidential campaign instead of implementing constructive diplomatic measures.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://aje.io/hwuqc6?update=3137769>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Defence Forces shells Ayta ash Shab, Aitaroun and Maroun al-Ras in southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Andalou Ajansi](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/hezbollah-says-it-carried-out-15-attacks-targeting-israeli-military-sites/3311558>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah launches 20 rockets, drone strikes and shelling on IDF sites in northern Israel and the Golan Heights.

Source citations (as archived): [Andalou Ajansi](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/hezbollah-says-it-carried-out-15-attacks-targeting-israeli-military-sites/3311558>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Governor of Belgorod Oblast Vyacheslav Gladkov says that five civilians have been killed by Ukrainian shelling in Rakitnoye, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/five-civilians-die-ukraines-shelling-russias-belgorod-region-governor-says-2024-08-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-10"></a>

Context: 2024 Solingen stabbing.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State group claims responsibility for yesterday's mass stabbing in Solingen, Germany, that killed three people and injured eight others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crlr2z23ykno>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-12"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Three people, including two children, are killed and fifteen others are injured in a motorcycle bomb blast in Pishin District, Balochistan Province, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/24/two-children-killed-in-bomb-blast-in-southwest-pakistan-police-say>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/24/pakistan-blast-southwest-balochistan-killed-children/9848e6fe-61f0-11ef-ae22-cef4d8785d67_story.html>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-14"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A large fire breaks out at the Elasha-Biyaha market near Mogadishu, Somalia following an IED explosion linked to Al-Shabaab. No casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/large-fire-at-elasha-biyaha-market-linked-to-suspected-al-shabaab-attack/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-0-16"></a>

Context: Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** French police arrests a man suspected of attempted arson upon a synagogue in La Grande-Motte, Occitanie, France. The incident is being treated as an anti-semitic terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/08/24/europe/france-synagogue-arson-la-grande-motte-intl/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-08-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Brazil wildfires, 2023–2024 South American drought.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed at an industrial plant in Urupês after trying to control widespread wildfires impacting at least 30 cities in São Paulo state, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/wildfires-affecting-30-cities-brazils-sao-paulo-state-leave-2-dead-2024-08-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least three workers are missing at the construction site of the Bangkok–Nong Khai high-speed railway in Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand after a tunnel collapses.

Source citations (as archived): [MCOT](<https://tna.mcot.net/english-news-1410713>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2024-08-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Red Sea oil spill.

**Archived source account.** The European Union Operation Aspides task force warns of a likely significant and ongoing oil spill in the Red Sea following Houthi demolition of the Greek-flagged Sounion oil tanker carrying 150,000 tons of petroleum, with Houthi footage showing flaming oil leaking into the sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/red-sea-attack-sounion-eu-yemen-houthis-9eb36bb2450b986bb677d67a32ec5ef0>); [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/7f886279-fecb-4410-b402-fbf85b9411b1>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-08-24-3-2"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Hungary, Hungary and the Russo-Ukrainian war / Lukoil oil transit dispute.

**Archived source account.** Hungary accuses the European Union of being behind Ukraine-placed sanctions blocking Russian oil shipments to both Hungary and Slovakia essential for their fuel security as blackmail for anti-Ukraine acts, following the European Commission's refusal to mediate sanction negotiations while asserting that there was no oil shortage.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungarys-foreign-minister-accuses-eu-disrupting-oil-supplies-russia-2024-08-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, Russian invasion of Ukraine / Prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine complete a prisoner exchange mediated by the United Arab Emirates with 115 prisoners of war from each side.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/24/russia-and-ukraine-swap-115-prisoners-each-in-uae-mediated-exchange>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-08-24-4-2"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war / 2010 San Fernando massacre, 2011 San Fernando massacre.

**Archived source account.** Eleven Los Zetas gunmen are sentenced to 50 years in prison each for the 2010–2011 massacres of 122 men in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, Mexico, who were taken off passing buses and forced to fight each other to death with sledgehammers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-2010-massacre-bus-passengers-drug-cartel-06b887ec07d5c0041ca93bc852163ff3>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-4-4"></a>

Context: Arrest of Pavel Durov.

**Archived source account.** The owner and founder of the Telegram and VK social networks Pavel Durov is arrested at Paris–Le Bourget Airport in France shortly after arriving from Azerbaijan, in connection with alleged illegal activity on his Telegram app.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckg2kz9kn93o>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/telegram-messaging-app-ceo-pavel-durov-arrested-france-tf1-tv-says-2024-08-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-24-4-6"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Nigerian police announce that the 20 medical students who were kidnapped in Benue State, Nigeria, last week have been found without making any ransom payments.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/24/police-say-20-abducted-nigerian-medical-students-freed>).

### 2024-08-25

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** At least five people, including three children, are killed and 13 others are injured in an overnight Ukrainian strike on Rakitnoye, Belgorod Oblast, Russia, according to Russian officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/five-die-in-ukrainian-strike-on-belgorod-as-russian-raid-harms-journalists>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine accuses Belarus of building up a "significant level" of troops and weaponry, including artillery, multiple-launch rocket systems and air defense systems along the border under the guise of military exercises, and demands their immediate withdrawal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/belarus-gathering-significant-number-of-troops-weaponry-along-ukraines-border-under-guise-of-exercises-ukraine-says/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-calls-belarus-pull-back-forces-border-2024-08-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** A British safety adviser working for Reuters is killed and two other journalists are injured in a Russian ballistic missile strike on their hotel in Kramatorsk, Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/reuters-staff-hit-strike-hotel-ukraines-kramatorsk-2024-08-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Northern Ukraine skirmishes, Chernihiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed and 37 others are injured in overnight Russian attacks in Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, and Donetsk Oblasts, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attacks-ukraine-with-missiles-drones-ukraine-military-says-2024-08-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-9"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy publicly presents the Ukrainian-produced Palianytsia rocket drone and loitering munition, intended to serve as the Ukrainian counterpart to the Russian ZALA Kub-BLA.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrainska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/news/2024/08/25/7471770/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-12"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / August 2024 Lebanon strikes.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces says that it has launched preemptive strikes on Hezbollah in Lebanon ahead of an expected major missile and drone attack on Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/2024/08/25/israel-hezbollah-lebanon-attack>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-strikes-hezbollah-targets-lebanon-military-says-2024-08-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-13"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / August 2024 Lebanon strikes.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Defence Minister Yoav Gallant declares an "emergency situation" in Israel for the next 48 hours due to the "special situation in the home front".

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/emergency-situation-declared-in-israel-for-next-48-hours/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-16"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 71 people are killed and 112 others are injured in Israeli attacks in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/at-least-eight-people-killed-in-israeli-air-attack-in-gazas-deir-el-balah>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-19"></a>

Context: Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso / 2024 Barsalogho attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 400 people are killed and over 300 others are injured in a shooting attack by the al-Qaeda-linked Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin jihadist organization in Barsalogho Department, Burkina Faso.

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-21"></a>

Context: 2024 Solingen stabbing.

**Archived source account.** German police detain a 26-year-old Syrian asylum seeker with ties to the Islamic State as the suspect of the stabbing attack in Solingen, Germany, on Friday. The man is charged with three counts of murder, as well as attempted murder, dangerous bodily harm and membership of a terrorist organisation abroad.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-knife-attack-solingen-islamic-state-1095235a9dadf6e1005e8adff52d05b4>).

<a id="event-2024-08-25-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are killed and three others are injured in an attack in Abuja, Nigeria. A police spokesperson says that the proscribed Islamic Movement of Nigeria was responsible for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/two-nigerian-police-officers-killed-attack-by-islamist-group-say-police-2024-08-25/>).

### 2024-08-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273740626](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20August%2026&oldid=1273740626>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / 26 August 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Massive Russian attacks are launched on cities across Ukraine, killing at least seven people. Ukrainian officials call it the largest Russian attack on Ukraine since the beginning of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/explosions-in-kyiv-russia-launches-massive-missile-and-drone-attack-on-cities-across-ukraine/>); [Kyiv Independent 2](<https://kyivindependent.com/a-near-death-feeling-largest-yet-russian-attack-on-ukraines-energy-infrastructure-brings-back-widespread-power-outages/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-drone-attack-kyiv-ukraines-military-says-2024-08-26/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / 26 August 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Poland says that a Russian Shahed drone had likely entered its airspace during the attacks on Ukraine and that searches are underway for the object as it may have landed in Polish territory around 30 kilometers (18 miles) from the Poland–Ukraine border.

Source citations (as archived): [The Defense Post](<https://www.thedefensepost.com/2024/08/27/poland-shahed-drone-airspace/>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/poland-russian-drone-airspace-ukraine/33093125.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-army-says-object-entered-poland-during-russian-attack-ukraine-2024-08-26/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / 26 August 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian F-16 fighter jet crashes after shooting down several missiles fired from Russia, killing the pilot.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/29/europe/ukraine-f16-crashes-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War, Corruption in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Audits conducted by the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense determine that between March and July, multiple Armed Forces of Ukraine units never received nearly US$4.2 million in military aid labeled as "humanitarian aid" to bypass customs fees, prompting embezzlement and illicit enrichment investigations.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/military-units-have-not-received-humanitarian-aid-worth-over-4-million-due-to-alleged-customs-violations-dm-says/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-10"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan / Operation Hereof.

**Archived source account.** The Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) launches an offensive against the Pakistani Army in Balochistan, Pakistan, gaining control of several key highways, including the Karachi–Quetta section of National Highway 8, and also damages a train station in Mastung.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/at-least-38-killed-in-multiple-armed-attacks-in-pakistans-balochistan>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan / Operation Hereof.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 soldiers and policemen and 21 BLA gunmen are killed in ambushes and clashes on highways in Balochistan. Five civilians are also killed in Kalat.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/at-least-38-killed-in-multiple-armed-attacks-in-pakistans-balochistan>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-12"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan / Operation Hereof.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-three people are killed in a mass shooting targeting Punjabis on a highway in Musakhail District. Between 30 and 40 armed men offloaded passengers from trucks and buses and shot them after checking their identities, subsequently setting fire to their vehicles. The BLA claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1854830>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2024/08/26/g-s1-19547/gunmen-attacks-southwestern-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-15"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces shell an internally displaced persons camp in North Darfur, Sudan, killing 25 people and wounding at least 40 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article290027/>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-17"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** IDF launches airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in Kfar Kila, Tayr Harfa, Shebaa and Aita ash-Shaab and shelling of Chamaa and Naqoura in southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Ajansi](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-18"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Hezbollah militant survives an Israeli drone strike in Sidon.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Ajansi](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon>).

<a id="event-2024-08-26-0-19"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah launches three drone strike on IDF surveillance equipment in Ramya.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Ajansi](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon>).

Context: Libyan crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Benghazi-based Libyan Government of National Stability says that it is suspending production at all oil fields and oil terminals that it controls until further notice amid a dispute with the central bank in Tripoli.

<a id="event-2024-08-26-4-1"></a>

Context: France–Russia relations, Arrest of Pavel Durov.

<a id="event-2024-09-01-4-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / September 2024 Israel ceasefire protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of Israelis, including approximately 300,000 in Tel Aviv, protest in cities across the country following the recovery of the bodies of six hostages from Gaza, with the national trade union center calling for a general strike on Monday and for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to resign after failing to negotiate a ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/09/01/world/israel-hamas-gaza-war>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hostages-war-gaza-news-09-01-24/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-09-01-4-3"></a>

<a id="event-2024-09-01-4-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Saxony state election, 2024 Thuringian state election.

**Archived source account.** Parliamentary elections in the German states of Saxony and Thuringia show large gains for the right-wing populist Alternative for Germany party and the left-wing populist Bündnis Sahra Wagenknecht party as well as losses for the left-wing and liberal parties of the governing coalition and for the socialist The Left party. In Thuringia, a far-right party comes in first place in a state election for the first time since World War II.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-09-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Ukraine, Mongolia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** President of Russia Vladimir Putin arrives in Mongolia to discuss a China–Russia gas pipeline meant to recoup Russian losses from Western sanctions, despite Ukraine and the European Union urging Mongolia to arrest Putin under his International Criminal Court warrant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/putin-arrives-mongolia-key-link-planned-gas-pipeline-china-2024-09-02/>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/09/02/brussels-urges-mongolia-to-comply-with-icc-request-and-arrest-putin-during-official-visit>).

<a id="event-2024-09-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Ukraine, Mongolia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's Foreign Ministry states that Mongolia's refusal to arrest Vladimir Putin while on a state visit means that it shares "responsibility for the war crimes" committed by Russia, and vows to work with allies to enforce punitive measures on Mongolia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-criticises-mongolias-failure-arrest-putin-2024-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-02-3-4"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey formally applies to join the BRICS geopolitical bloc, citing the lack of progress in its accession to the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-09-02/turkey-submits-bid-to-join-brics-as-erdogan-pushes-for-new-alliances-beyond-west>); [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/diplomacy/turkiye-applies-for-brics-membership-in-push-for-new-alliances-report>).

<a id="event-2024-09-02-3-6"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States seizes a Dassault Falcon 900 jet used by Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro on accusations that the purchase of the jet violated U.S. sanctions against Venezuela, and flies the jet from the Dominican Republic to Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-seizes-venezuelan-presidents-plane-dominican-republic-2024-09-02/>).

#### Law and crime

Context: Brazilian investigation into Elon Musk.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Supreme Court unanimously upholds justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to block social media platform X, in the country. De Moraes also set a daily fine of R$50,000 (US$8,900) for people or companies using VPNs to access the site.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-musk-x-platform-moraes-shutdown-6942614705a4e85064f1d98628b49295>).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/south-korea-launches-telegram-deepfake-porn-probe/a-70107568>).

**Archived source account.** One person is fatally shot and at least four other people are injured including one person who was critically injured in a mass shooting at the West Indian Day Parade in Brooklyn, New York, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/new-york-west-indian-caribbean-parade-carnival-b2b87995006cfd8ab598862599905c52>).

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests / Israel–Hamas war protests in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in Manhattan, New York City, United States, to protest against the Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip, rally for support of Palestinians, and call for New York institutions to divest from Israeli businesses.

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests / September 2024 Israel ceasefire protests.

**Archived source account.** Histadrut, Israel's national trade union center, begins a one-day general strike to protest against the Netanyahu government's failure to negotiate a ceasefire and hostage deal. The strike is later ordered to end prematurely by a Tel Aviv labor court, claiming the strike was illegally political in nature rather than economic.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgez7ez10lo>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/sep/02/israel-gaza-war-national-strike-hostages-ceasefire-netanyahu>).

Context: 2024 Summer Paralympics / Thailand at the 2024 Summer Paralympics, Wheelchair fencing at the Summer Paralympics.

**Archived source account.** Thai wheelchair fencer Saysunee Jana becomes the first female wheelchair fencer, and the second overall, to win gold medals in all three fencing disciplines, épée, foil, and sabre.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/sports/2861203/saysunee-makes-history-with-paralympics-fencing-treble>).

<a id="event-2024-09-08-5-4"></a>

Context: 2024 US Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Jannik Sinner defeats Taylor Fritz in the final of the US Open Men's singles tournament to win his first US Open title ever and his second Grand Slam title overall. Sinner is also the first Italian man to ever win the US Open.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/08/sport/us-open-mens-final-sinner-fritz-spt-intl/index.html>).

### 2024-09-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273133206](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%209&oldid=1273133206>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops capture the village of Memryk in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/9/eu-claims-credible-information-iran-sent-ballistic-missiles-to-russia>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** The Latvian Defence Ministry confirms that a Russian military Shahed drone that crashed near the village of Gaigalava, Latvia, last week was carrying explosives and was likely intended to strike Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drone-that-crashed-latvia-carried-explosives-latvian-military-says-2024-09-09/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Use of incendiary weapons in the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine begins the implementation of "dragon drones" that spray molten thermite on forest cover to reveal and help destroy Russian units and military equipment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/9/what-are-dragon-drones-ukraines-latest-weapon-against-russia>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least eight people are killed and dozens are wounded in Israeli strikes across the Gaza Strip, bringing the confirmed Palestinian death toll to over 41,000.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/9/at-least-eight-palestinians-killed-as-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-intensify>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and more than 40 others are injured in overnight Israeli airstrikes targeting Iranian research centers in Syria, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/sep/09/middle-east-crisis-seven-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-on-iran-linked-military-site-in-syria-says-war-monitor>); [Syriahr](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/343584/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-14"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are injured when a roadside bomb targets a police vehicle escorting a polio vaccination team in Wana, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2570677/pakistan>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-16"></a>

Context: Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Ministry of Defense announces that a Turkish soldier was killed in clashes with the Kurdistan Workers' Party in Duhok Governorate, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/war-on-terror/turkish-soldier-killed-in-clashes-with-pkk-terrorists-in-iraq>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-0-18"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces renew an assault on the city of Sennar, Sennar State, Sudan, killing at least 31 people and injuring more than 100 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rsf-paramilitaries-kill-31-sudanese-city-sennar-activists-say-2024-09-09/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-09-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Draghi report on European competitiveness is published.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://politico.eu/article/mario-draghi-report-says-eu-must-spend-twice-as-much-after-wwii/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-09-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Brazil wildfires, 2023–2024 South American drought.

**Archived source account.** Fifty-nine percent of Brazil's area suffers from significant drought conditions, the worst national drought recorded. These conditions cause historically low Amazon basin levels and are contributing to at least 160,000 wildfires in 2024 that are causing widespread air pollution.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-drought-amazon-wildfires-smoke-heat-7d96dbbf5c4339050fb24bbbde6c3b82>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-2-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Typhoon Yagi in northern Vietnam increases to more than 64 people, with 24 others still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/9/at-least-24-dead-in-vietnam-after-typhoon-yagi-triggered-landslides-floods>); [AP News](<https://apnews.com/video/vietnam-bridge-collapses-hurricanes-and-typhoons-a299ea1c51894f6da58bae9a4138b6c8>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eighteen people are killed and four are missing during floods caused by torrential rains in southern Morocco. Fifty-six homes are destroyed and 110 roads damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2570616/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 16 people are killed and 22 others are injured when a bus and a truck collide in Bambey Department, Senegal.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT Afrika](<https://www.trtafrika.com/africa/16-dead-22-injured-in-senegal-road-crash-18205586>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least six people are killed when a boat carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of Senegal over the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-six-dead-after-boat-carrying-migrants-sinks-off-senegal-2024-09-09/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-09-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Slovakia–Ukraine relations, Far-right politics in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Foreign Ministry expresses "disappointment" regarding assertions made by Slovakian Prime Minister Robert Fico that Kyiv should remove "fascist elements" from the Armed Forces of Ukraine, using rhetoric similar to Russian allegations of current neo-Nazism in Ukraine's Azov Brigade.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-disappointed-slovak-pms-fascism-comments-2024-09-10/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** The Nigerian State Security department arrests Joe Ajaero, the leader of the Nigeria Labour Congress, at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja, Nigeria, days after Ajaero criticised the Nigerian government for increasing gas prices.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-main-labor-union-says-its-leader-has-been-arrested/a-70171450>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ali Kiba, a Tanzanian official from the opposition party Chadema, who went missing last week, is found dead with signs of beatings and acid poured on his face.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/tanzanian-opposition-official-found-dead-signs-beating-acid-113513060>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany's traffic light coalition government announces border restrictions on all its national land borders, including those with other EU nations, for at least six months in order to combat irregular migration from asylum seekers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-put-temporary-controls-all-land-borders-source-says-2024-09-09/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The exiled National Council of Resistance of Iran claim that its offices in Stockholm, Sweden, were firebombed overnight with Molotov cocktails. The Swedish Police Authority announces that they have opened an investigation into the arson.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/09/09/exiled-iran-opposition-group-says-stockholm-offices-firebombed->).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Forty-seven inmates escape from a maximum security prison in Margibi County, Liberia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/forty-seven-inmates-escape-liberian-prison-2024-09-09/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Finnish-Canadian sportswear mogul Peter Nygård is sentenced to 11 years in prison for sexual assault.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/peter-nygard-sentencing-1.7317334>).

<a id="event-2024-09-09-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Guinea-Bissau say that they have seized more than 2.6 tonnes of cocaine that was found on a plane arriving from Venezuela at Osvaldo Vieira International Airport in Bissau.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1w7vzxe1v1o>).

### 2024-09-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362424624](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%2010&oldid=1362424624>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine launches drone attacks on multiple Oblasts of Russia, including Moscow, prompting all flights to be suspended at Vnukovo International Airport and Moscow Domodedovo Airport. Bryansk Governor Alexander Bogomaz says that at least 59 Ukrainian drones have been shot down over the region. Russia also reports that two people were killed in the Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-destroys-ukraine-launched-drone-flying-towards-moscow-mayor-says-2024-09-09/>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/child-killed-in-ukrainian-drone-attack-on-moscow-russia-says/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Iran and the Russian invasion of Ukraine, International sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken says that Russia has received a shipment of Fath 360 tactical ballistic missiles from Iran, and expects their deployment "within weeks". Iran denies the claim, calling it "psychological warfare". In response, the United Kingdom, France, and Germany announce new sanctions on Iran for supplying Russia with ballistic missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c75n2wnkp1vo>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/09/10/israel-hamas-war-latest-news-airstrikes-mawasi-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands lifts all of its weapons restrictions on military equipment that it provided to Ukraine, allowing the Ukrainian military to target Russia with long-range weapons, while also urging NATO allies to lift their own weapons restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/38760>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people are killed and more than 60 others are injured in an Israeli airstrike on the Al-Mawasi refugee camp in Rafah in the Gaza Strip. Twenty tents housing displaced people are destroyed during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/10/heinous-at-least-40-killed-in-israeli-attack-on-tent-camp-officials-say>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-10"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military says the strike targeted senior Hamas commanders operating in a command center embedded inside a designated humanitarian area whom the Israel Defense Forces says were all involved in the October 7 attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/09/10/israeli-military-says-it-struck-senior-hamas-commanders-in-gaza>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/dozens-said-killed-as-idf-targets-prominent-hamas-operatives-in-gaza-tent-camp/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-0-12"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Redwan Force commander is killed and fourteen civilians are injured in Israeli airstrikes on Saghbine and Rachaf in southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/10/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-held-polio-vaccinators-at-gun-point-un>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the capsizing of a migrant boat off the coast of Senegal over the weekend increases to 26 after the discovery of 17 more bodies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-capsized-migrant-boat-offshore-senegal-rises-26-2024-09-10/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-09-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Belarus–European Union border crisis, Germany–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Poland Donald Tusk condemns Germany's new land border restrictions due to Germany's previous lack of support for other European Union nations impacted by irregular migration.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polands-tusk-criticises-german-decision-tighten-border-controls-2024-09-10/>); [TVN24](<https://tvn24.pl/polska/niemcy-wprowadzaja-kontrole-na-wszystkich-granicach-ladowych-donald-tusk-komentuje-st8080239>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-09-10-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Court of Justice of the European Union rules that Apple Inc. must pay €13 billion (US$14.3 billion) to the government of the Republic of Ireland as compensation for extraordinarily low taxes levied by Ireland against Apple.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/09/10/apple-ireland-lose-13bn-sweetheart-tax-deal-case-in-victory-for-eus-tax-lady>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google is fined €2.4 billion (US$2.7 billion) by the Court of Justice of the European Union for favoring its own shopping search results over those of its competitors.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/google-loses-court-battle-over-first-eu-antitrust-fine/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** His Majesty's Prison Service begins releasing thousands of prisoners in England and Wales early amid a record high prison population and a shortage of prison cells for new inmates.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c62rygz20gjt>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Swiss appeals court convicts Islamic scholar Tariq Ramadan of rape and sexual coercion, sentencing Ramadan to three years in prison, with two years suspension.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/10/swiss-court-convicts-islamic-scholar-on-rape-charges>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2n74n6q1vo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-09-10-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Jordanian general election.

**Archived source account.** Jordanians go to the polls to elect all 138 members of the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2024/09/10/g-s1-21747/jordanian-voters-go-to-polls-amid-fears-of-a-wider-war>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Mexican judicial reform.

**Archived source account.** Protesters opposed to the ruling Morena party's reform package storm the Senate of Mexico and force an interruption of the bill's first reading in the upper house. The session reconvenes later at an alternative venue and passes the bill by an 86–41 vote.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/sep/11/mexico-senate-approve-changes-judiciary>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/09/10/americas/mexico-judicial-reform-debate-senate-intl-latam/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-4-5"></a>

Context: 2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis.

**Archived source account.** The House of Commons of the United Kingdom votes 348–228 to end the Winter Fuel Payment for 10 million pensioners in England and Wales after Prime Minister Keir Starmer warned that the scheme was no longer affordable to be applied universally.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/mps-vote-to-cut-winter-fuel-payment-for-millions-of-pensioners-13212264>).

<a id="event-2024-09-10-4-7"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** A presidential debate hosted by ABC News between U.S. vice president and Democratic nominee Kamala Harris and former president and Republican nominee Donald Trump takes place at the National Constitution Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-harris-election-09-09-24/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-09-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** Following the launch of the Russian Soyuz MS-26 spacecraft from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan, there were a record 19 people in outer space: the three astronauts on the MS-26 mission, three more on China's Tiangong space station, four people on the SpaceX Polaris Dawn mission, and nine more on board the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [CollectSPACE](<http://www.collectspace.com/news/news-091124a-soyuz-ms-26-launch-space-station.html>).

### 2024-09-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273133023](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%2012&oldid=1273133023>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russian artillery shelling kills three Red Cross workers and injures two others in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-two-injured-russian-shelling-eastern-ukrainian-village-2024-09-12/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A spokesperson for the Indian Foreign Ministry say that about 45 Indian nationals have been discharged from the Russian military, with efforts currently underway to get a further 50 Indians released.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-discharges-45-indians-fighting-its-army-2024-09-12/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russian shelling of the settlement of Borova in Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine, kills three civilians and injures nine others, including several emergency service personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-village-ukraines-kharkiv-region-kills-three-injures-nine-2024-09-12/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War, Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin warns that Ukrainian use of NATO weapons to strike deep into Russian territory indicates NATO's formal entry into war against Russia, due to the programming of these weapons by NATO personnel representing a "direct confrontation".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-putin-missiles-war-b2611904.html>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine accuses Russia of conducting missile strikes on a Saint Kitts and Nevis-flagged bulk carrier carrying grain to Egypt in the exclusive economic zone of Romania in the Black Sea. No casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-hits-civilian-ship-with-ukrainian-grain-black-sea-zelenskiy-says-2024-09-12/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-13"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2024 Israeli military operation in the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Israel's military operation in the occupied West Bank increases to 50, with three people killed by a drone strike in Tulkarm.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/12/israels-war-on-gaza-live-women-children-blown-to-pieces-in-school-raid?update=3174049>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-15"></a>

Context: Gaza war / United States support for Israel in the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department approves $165 million in weapons sales to Israel to fund tank transporters along with spare parts, tool kits, and technical and logistics support. The parts are expected to be delivered in 2027.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-weapons-us-tank-trailers-b5882a9ed12ad9d2ffe0a48a297f0424>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-18"></a>

Context: Afghan conflict / 2024 Afghanistan bus shooting.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed and six more are injured during a mass shooting by Islamic State militants against a bus carrying Shia Hazara people between the Afghan provinces of Ghor and Daikundi, after returning from a pilgrimage in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-islamic-state-shiite-hazara-attack-c6e6e4004a11569156723f9061a7f0dc>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-0-20"></a>

Context: Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Three border guards are killed and a civilian is injured by Jaish ul-Adl gunmen in Mirjaveh, Sistan and Baluchestan province, Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-baluchistan-jaish-aladl-attack-border-guards-ad25428b32f82f3c936201a6671fbfcf?utm_source=RecoReel&amp;utm_medium=articlePage&amp;utm_id=Taboola>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-09-12-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 video game industry layoffs.

**Archived source account.** Microsoft announces that it will lay off 650 Microsoft Gaming employees as part of cuts to its workforce.

Source citations (as archived): [Variety](<https://variety.com/2024/gaming/news/microsoft-gaming-layoffs-650-employees-1236141947/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2024-09-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The British government announces that a ban on junk food adverts on television before 9 PM will enter force in October 2025 under plans to tackle childhood obesity.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/ban-on-junk-food-ads-before-9pm-to-come-into-force-next-year-13213403>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-09-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Jordan–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom suspends visa-exempt status for Jordanian nationals traveling to the UK due to an increase in asylum claims made by Jordanians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/international/article-819891>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Brazil–Ukraine relations, China–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy strongly denounces a Brazilian–Chinese peace initiative, stating that both nations are effectively siding with Russia for allowing the Russian army to take Ukrainian territory as a means to "de-escalate" the war instead of assisting Ukraine in resisting the invasion.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-on-china-brazil-plan/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-3-5"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations, 2024 Venezuelan political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States government imposes sanctions on 16 allies of Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, accusing them of voter suppression and human rights abuses.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-us-sanctions-presidential-election-0e0033f6259d4b7d3a600965813db2b7>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States announces it will support the addition of two new permanent seats on the United Nations Security Council for African nations and one non-permanent seat for a small island developing nation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/un-security-council-expansion-africa-us-54d1a31c24229b40a2103e08f36e52b9>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-09-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Blasphemy in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A police officer shoots and kills a man being held in custody on suspicion of blasphemy at a police station in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/09/12/pakistani-police-officer-kills-man-accused-of-blasphemy>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-09-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papuan prime minister James Marape survives a vote of no confidence.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/527805/james-marape-remains-pm-after-no-confidence-vote-against-him-fails>).

<a id="event-2024-09-12-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Senegalese president Bassirou Diomaye Faye dissolves the opposition-led National Assembly and calls for a snap election on November 17.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/senegal-president-dissolves-parliament-faye-581a6f55ead32310f792c30758e40ced>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-09-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Polaris program.

**Archived source account.** American billionaire Jared Isaacman becomes the first person to perform a commercial spacewalk as part of the Polaris Dawn private spaceflight mission operated by SpaceX.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/spacex-spacewalk-private-polaris-dawn-87d4c78853f0249baf29631bedfac749>).

### 2024-09-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357250810](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%2013&oldid=1357250810>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Russian artillery targets 15 areas in Sumy Oblast, Ukraine, killing two civilians near the village of Yampil and injuring nine others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-russian-shelling-ukraines-sumy-region-regional-authority-says-2024-09-13/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / China and the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that Russia has begun production of thousands of Garpiya-A1 long-range combat drones used against Ukrainian civilian and military targets, that incorporate engines, parts, and technology from China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-produces-new-kamikaze-drone-with-chinese-engine-say-european-intel-2024-09-13/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Humanitarian impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Central Intelligence Agency reports that due to the ongoing war, Ukraine's death rate is now the highest in the world at 18.6 per thousand people, while its birth rate is the lowest at six children born per thousand people.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/38938>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-9"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Islamic State insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Abu Ali Al-Tunisi, an Islamic State commander for whom the U.S. Treasury Department had offered $5 million for information for, is killed during a joint United States–Iraq operation in Al Anbar Governorate. Ahmad Hamed Zwein, an Islamic State deputy commander in Iraq, is also killed in the operation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iraq-syria-islamic-state-anbar-e8e397305c3d95847d7cf4215d3aba0a>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-12"></a>

Context: War on drugs in Ecuador / Ecuadorian security crisis.

**Archived source account.** Maria Daniela Icaza, director of the Litoral Penitentiary in Guayaquil, the largest prison in Ecuador and the site of the country's deadliest prison riot in 2021, is fatally shot in her vehicle by suspected drug cartel gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ecuador-prison-director-killed-maria-daniela-icaza-driving/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-14"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Two Indian soldiers are killed in action in clashes with separatists in Kishtwar, Jammu and Kashmir, India.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/fierce-encounter-breaks-out-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-kishtwar-6558579>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-16"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Redwan Force commander is killed and 17 injured in Israeli drone strikes in Ahmadiya and Kfar Remen in southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/13/israels-war-on-gaza-live-dozens-more-killed-amid-anger-over-school-attack>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-0-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the Comoros Azali Assoumani is stabbed and injured in an assassination attempt in Salimani, Comoros.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/comoros-president-attack-4e46a5799b1430ababf98c474e7c37b5>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-09-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Boeing machinists strike.

**Archived source account.** More than 33,000 Boeing factory workers go on strike for the first time since 2008 after rejecting a labor contract.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2024/09/13/boeing-workers-strike-reject-contract.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-13-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Typhoon Yagi in northern Vietnam increases to 233 people, with more than 820 others injured, and 103 people still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-flooding-typhoon-yagi-deaths-95c5de93c84e636c32f2a875c77db0fa>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-2-2"></a>

Context: 2024 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** At least ten people are killed by flooding and landslides caused by Typhoon Yagi in Thailand, along with at least 33 people killed in Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/typhoon-yagi-batters-thailand-myanmar-as-vietnam-cleans-up/a-70215185>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Bulgarian Air Force L-39 Albatros jet crashes during rehearsals for an air show at the Graf Ignatievo Air Base near Plovdiv, Bulgaria, killing both pilots.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/military-jet-crash-bulgaria-46e7faf0bcbd33a906f680593cc464f1>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are presumed dead and at least two others are injured in an explosion and subsequent fire at a gas station in Clearwater County, Idaho, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/idaho-gas-station-explosion-fire-cardiff-17c393b1ede0179ca6f3117e71459d09>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-09-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Germany–Kenya relations, Immigration to Germany.

**Archived source account.** Germany and Kenya agree on a labour migration deal which will see 250,000 skilled and semi-skilled Kenyan workers go work in Germany amid a shortage of skilled labour in the German economy. The agreement will also simplify the return of illegal migrants to Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gegkkg14ko>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia revokes the accreditation of six British diplomats and accuses them of espionage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c7858qqzyv8t>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-09-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt.

**Archived source account.** A court in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, sentences 37 people to death for their alleged roles in the attempted coup the prior May.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-verdict-trial-coup-americans-93ca1f26b27b0a45f239db12a3b1e1d5>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-4-3"></a>

Context: Rotherham child sexual exploitation scandal.

**Archived source account.** Seven men receive prison sentences ranging from six to 25 years for sexual offences against girls aged 11 to 16 that occurred in the town of Rotherham, South Yorkshire, Northern England from the late 1980s until 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyly0rdyz0o>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bedfordshire Police arrest an 18-year-old man on suspicion of murder after three people are found dead in flat in a tower block in Luton, England, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0qeqydgekpo>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three young Chinese people are killed in a suspected arson attack on a shop in Milan, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [ANSA](<https://www.ansa.it/english/news/2024/09/13/three-chinese-youths-killed-in-milan-store-fire_9b2fa36e-3634-48c8-b567-106b1b7790d7.html>).

<a id="event-2024-09-13-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** China increases the country's retirement age for the first time since 1978. Beginning in 2025, the retirement age for men will be increased to 63, and the retirement age for women will be increased to either 55 or 58 depending on their occupation.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2024/09/13/g-s1-22510/china-retirement-age>).

### 2024-09-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1246320170](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%2014&oldid=1246320170>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian officials say that the approval of Ukrainian use of long-range weapons to strike inside Russia will result in an "uncontrolled escalation" with the West and the "destruction" of Kyiv.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-threatens-ukraine-west-long-range-strikes-decision-looms-2024-09-14/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** NATO Chair Rob Bauer backs the use of long-range weapons by Ukrainian forces to strike targets inside Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nato-military-committee-chair-back-ukraines-long-range-113690875?cid=social_twitter_abcn>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Ukrainian conscription crisis.

**Archived source account.** Following a meeting in Kyiv, Ukraine, the foreign ministers of Poland and Ukraine call for ending social benefits for Ukrainian men in Poland, and for programs in the European Union to return them to Ukraine in order to stop draft evasion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-minister-visiting-kyiv-calls-end-benefits-ukrainian-men-europe-2024-09-14/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Four injured in an Israeli airstrike on Hermel in northern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/14/israels-war-on-gaza-live-19-killed-as-first-phase-of-polio-drive-ends>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-0-9"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and eight others are injured in a series of roadside explosions in Kahda District, Mogadishu, Somalia. The local government blames jihadist group Al-Shabaab due to its frequent targeting of civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-deadly-blasts-at-youth-photography-spot-in-mogadishu-kill-5>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/somalia-mogadishu-roadside-explosion-956278334ebf751244263623eda0c0df?utm_source=copy&amp;utm_medium=share>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-14-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South American wildfires / 2024 Brazil wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The estimated area burned by wildfires in Brazil this year reaches 37.6 million ha, an area larger than the size of Germany and more than double the yearly average from 2012–2023.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/bdcdd185-73ba-411b-93f0-1a3b3b879834>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-1-4"></a>

Context: 2024 European floods.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed and thousands of homes are damaged in floods in Romania and the Czech Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-four-die-romania-floods-rain-batters-central-europe-2024-09-14/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and around 40 others are injured when a tank truck explodes in Miragoâne, Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/more-than-15-people-killed-40-injured-in-haiti-tanker-truck-explosion>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and 49 others are injured in a train collision in Zagazig, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/14/middleeast/egypt-train-collision-intl-latam/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-1-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least forty people drown and 24 more are presumed dead after a wooden boat carrying farmers capsizes near Gummi, Zamfara State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/14/africa/nigeria-boat-accident-64-dead-intl-latam/index.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/15/boat-capsizes-in-nigeria-drowning-at-least-40-people>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-09-14-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Tunisian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian police arrest more than 80 members of the opposition Ennahda Movement party amid protests against President Kais Saied in the capital city Tunis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/tunisia-arrests-dozens-of-opposition-members-in-pre-election-crackdown>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-2-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan interior minister Diosdado Cabello announces that three US citizens, two Spanish citizens, and a Czech citizen have been arrested and are accused of planning to "generate violence" and "destabilize" Venezuela, with the Spanish citizens also accused of being Spanish secret service workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/spain-says-venezuela-arrests-foreigners-destabilizing-country-2024-09-14/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-14-2-5"></a>

Context: 2026 South Sudanese general election.

**Archived source account.** The government of South Sudan and President Salva Kiir postpone the general election originally scheduled for December 2024 to December 2026, citing a need for additional time to complete a census, register political parties, and draft a permanent constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/south-sudan-postpones-december-election-by-two-years>).

### 2024-09-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1305648532](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20September%2015&oldid=1305648532>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-09-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** A Houthi ballistic missile launched from Yemen reaches central Israel for the first time. The missile is fragmented by an interceptor, with no casualties reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/missile-fired-yemen-set-off-sirens-central-israel-military-says-2024-09-15/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** At least 41 people are injured when a Russian guided bomb hits an apartment building in Kharkiv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/09/15/europe/russian-strike-kharkiv-ukraine-apartment-block-intl/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-15-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 European floods / 2024 Central European floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the ongoing floods in Central and Eastern Europe increases to eight, including six people in Romania, one in Poland, and a firefighter in Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/15/death-toll-rises-as-storm-boris-lashes-central-eastern-europe>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/floods-southwest-poland-kill-one-force-evacuations-2024-09-15/>).

<a id="event-2024-09-15-1-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Typhoon Yagi in Myanmar increases to 74 people, with 89 others still missing and nearly 240,000 people displaced.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-typhoon-yagi-floods-dead-missing-f41b7e73b7ed72bd58e1221e7f620456>).

<a id="event-2024-09-15-1-6"></a>

Context: English Channel migrant crossings.

**Archived source account.** At least eight illegal migrants are killed and ten others are hospitalized after a boat capsizes off the French coast while attempting to cross the English Channel.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/29/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-non-stop-bombardment-as-hezbollah-mourns-chief?update=3210580>); [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2024/09/29/airstrikes-launched-at-yemen-s-hodeidah-port-sources>).

<a id="event-2024-09-29-1-4"></a>

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-09-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Coal phase-out.

**Archived source account.** The last coal-fired power station in the United Kingdom shuts down in Ratcliffe-on-Soar, Nottinghamshire, England, ending the 142-year history of coal-fired electricity in the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2024/sep/30/end-of-an-era-as-britains-last-coal-fired-power-plant-shuts-down>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-09-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Nepal floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the floods and landslides in Nepal increases to 204 people, with 30 others missing. This is the highest recorded monsoon rainfall in Nepal in the past two decades.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/sep/30/more-than-200-dead-in-nepal-floods-as-parts-of-kathmandu-left-under-water>).

Source citations (as archived): [ITV News](<https://www.itv.com/news/2024-09-30/two-people-dead-as-wildfire-burns-through-southern-greece>).
