Context: Australia–Tuvalu relations, Climate change in Tuvalu.

**Archived source account.** Tuvalu's climate minister denounces the Australian Labor government's decision to expand three coal mines as an existential threat to the nation, due to the role of the mines in causing rising sea levels that have forced mass displacement across Tuvalu's low-lying islands.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2024/oct/01/australia-coalmine-decision-akin-to-drowning-its-pacific-neighbours-tuvalu-climate-minister-says>).

<a id="event-2024-09-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Shanghai supermarket stabbings.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and fifteen others are injured in a mass stabbing at a supermarket in Songjiang district, Shanghai, China. Police arrest a 37-year-old man at the scene, adding that the man had come to Shanghai in order to "vent his anger due to a personal economic dispute".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/shanghai-knife-attack-kills-three-wounds-15-others-xinhua-reports-2024-10-01/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9dyxpe2dy1o>).

Context: Solar eclipse of October 2, 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [EclipseWise](<https://eclipsewise.com/solar/SEprime/2001-2100/SE2024Oct02Aprime.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c98ynejg4l5o>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/britain-agrees-chagos-island-sovereignty-deal-with-mauritius-2024-10-03/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/georgia-signs-sweeping-anti-lgbtq-bill-into-law/>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/iswaran-jail-12-months-sentencing-former-singapore-minister-guilty-court-live-4653961>); [Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/live-singapore-iswaran-sentencing>).

The woman's captor is believed to have previously been killed in an Israeli airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yazidi-woman-freed-gaza-us-led-operation-after-decade-captivity-2024-10-03/>).

### 2024-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273130393](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20October%2024&oldid=1273130393>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-10-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Five Israeli soldiers are killed and seven others are injured in gun battles with Hezbollah militants in southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-says-five-soldiers-were-killed-during-combat-southern-lebanon-2024-10-24/>).

<a id="event-2024-10-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / Assassination of Hashem Safieddine.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah confirms that Hossein Ali Hazimeh, head of its intelligence headquarters, was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Beirut, Lebanon, on October 3.

Source citations (as archived): [Webangah](<https://en.webangah.ir/2024-10-24/news=213180/>); [Mehr News Agency](<https://en.mehrnews.com/news/223492/Hezbollah-confirms-martyrdom-of-Hussein-Ali-Hazimeh>).

**Archived source account.** The Armed Forces of Ukraine reports that Russian Armed Forces have made significant advances in the strategic city of Selydove, predicting that it could be captured in a few days.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/10/24/russian-forces-on-verge-of-capturing-selydove-in-eastern-ukraine-isw-says>).

<a id="event-2024-10-24-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 Palestinians, including children, are killed in an Israeli airstrike on a school in Nuseirat refugee camp.

<a id="event-2024-10-24-0-10"></a>

Context: Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Israel says that it killed Muhammad Abu Attawi, a commander in Hamas' Nukhba forces who participated in the Nova music festival massacre, in an airstrike in Gaza yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-it-killed-hamas-commander-who-doubled-un-aid-worker-2024-10-24/>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-says-it-killed-hamas-man-who-led-massacre-at-reim-shelter-an-unrwa-worker/>).

The People's Democratic Movement party wins three seats and the Movement for Change and Prosperity party wins one seat.

### 2024-10-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1287383914](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20October%2028&oldid=1287383914>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-10-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon / 2024 Tyre airstrikes.

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed in an Israeli raid and airstrikes on Tyre, Lebanon, which targeted neighborhoods adjacent to a UNESCO World Heritage site.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2024/10/28/israeli-air-strikes-pummel-lebanese-historic-city-of-tyre>).

<a id="event-2024-10-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon / 2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes.

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes kill at least 60 people and injure 58 others in the Beqaa Valley, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8ye05pyjvo>).

<a id="event-2024-10-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** At least 21 people are injured when Russian guided bombs and rocket artillery hit Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-air-attacks-pound-kharkiv-injure-several-people-ukraines-officials-say-2024-10-28/>).

<a id="event-2024-10-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** In the last four days, at least 34 people have been killed in Tecpan de Galeana, Guerrero, Mexico, in cartel ambushes and clashes. Mexican police arrest 21 people, including sixteen Guatemalan and Salvadoran nationals.

Source citations (as archived): [Revista Proceso](<https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2024/10/28/guerrero-en-cuatro-dias-se-han-registrado-34-muertos-en-tecpan-de-galeana-339284.html>); [El Debate](<https://www.debate.com.mx/estados/Detienen-a-15-tras-enfrentamiento-en-Tecpan-de-Galeana-Guerrero-11-son-extranjeros-20241026-0157.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-10-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of archaeologists announce the discovery of more than 6,000 ancient Mayan structures hidden by vegetation in the southeastern Mexican state of Campeche, including a city of pyramids they dubbed Valeriana.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/lost-mayan-city-discovered-by-accident-in-mexican-jungle/a-70636302>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-10-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024 United Kingdom riots.

**Archived source account.** British anti-Islam far-right activist Tommy Robinson is sentenced to eighteen months imprisonment for contempt of court and repeating false allegations about a Syrian refugee.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-anti-islam-activist-tommy-robinson-admits-breaching-injunction-2024-10-28/>).

<a id="event-2024-10-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian government executes the Iranian dissident holding German citizenship Jamshid Sharmahd.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2yv8327g9o>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-10-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Gaza humanitarian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israel's Knesset votes 92–10 to ban the UNRWA from operating within Israel and the State of Palestine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/28/israel-parliament-approves-bill-to-ban-unrwa>).

<a id="event-2024-10-28-3-3"></a>

Context: October 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The GERB-SDS coalition wins the most seats in the parliamentary election with 69 seats, with PP-DB coming in second and Revival in third. GERB's leader Boyko Borisov promises to work with everyone except Revival to form a coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bulgarias-gerb-party-wins-parliamentary-vote-preliminary-results-show-2024-10-28/>).

#### Sports

Context: 2024 Ballon d'Or.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Spanish players Rodri and Aitana Bonmatí win the Ballon d'Or and the Ballon d'Or Féminin, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/10/28/sport/rodri-aitana-bonmati-win-ballon-dor-spt-intl/index.html>).

### 2024-10-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-10-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / 29 October 2024 Beit Lahia airstrike.

**Archived source account.** At least 93 Palestinians are killed and 40 others are missing in Israeli strikes on a residential building in Beit Lahia in northern Gaza.

Context: Gaza war / Siege of North Gaza, Gaza Strip famine, Israeli generals' plan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/29/live-warnings-israels-unrwa-ban-will-collapse-aid-efforts-in-gaza?update=3283199>).

<a id="event-2024-10-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russia claims that it has taken the cities of Selydove and Hirnyk in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine, with open-source data indicating that Russian forces are advancing at their fastest pace in at least one year amid signs of North Korean involvement in the war.

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

<a id="event-2024-10-29-0-13"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

<a id="event-2024-10-29-0-14"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Eight Austrian Army soldiers and peacekeepers are injured when a rocket, likely fired by Hezbollah, hits the UNIFIL headquarters in Naqoura, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/29/eight-wounded-in-new-attack-on-unifil-peacekeepers-in-lebanon>); [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/10/29/austria-says-eight-of-its-unifil-troops-in-lebanon-injured-in-rocket-attack>).

<a id="event-2024-10-29-0-16"></a>

<a id="event-2024-10-29-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 European floods / 2024 Spain floods.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/29/four-missing-after-torrential-rain-brings-flash-flooding-to-spain>).

**Archived source account.** A ten-story hotel collapses in Villa Gesell, Argentina, killing one person and leaving at least seven others trapped.

<a id="event-2024-10-29-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are injured after a derailed tram crashes into a phone and computer shop in central Oslo, Norway.

Context: German economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** German metalworkers union IG Metall begins a labor strike over the working conditions and wages of 3.9 million workers in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-metalworkers-launch-strikes-over-pay/a-70624072>).

<a id="event-2024-10-29-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/29/hezbollah-appoints-naim-qassem-as-new-chief>).

<a id="event-2024-10-30-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and eight others are injured in a stabbing spree in Kagadi, Uganda, by members of an unknown cult. Two attackers are killed by police.

<a id="event-2024-10-30-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council votes 15–0 to make changes to the United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia, forming a new mission called the United Nations Transitional Mission in Somalia, which is expected to begin operating on November 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Mirage News](<https://www.miragenews.com/unsc-adopts-resolution-2753-transfers-somalia-1347633/>).

Context: 2024 Botswana general election.

### 2024-10-31

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-10-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict / 2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes.

<a id="event-2024-10-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission opens an investigation into Chinese e-commerce company Temu for its sale of illegal and counterfeit products and its addictive design, which violate the EU's Digital Services Act.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-10-31-2-2"></a>

Context: 2024 European floods / 2024 Spain floods.

<a id="event-2024-10-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/ap-berlin-germany-united-states-dubai-b2638983.html>).

Context: Assassination of Marielle Franco.

**Archived source account.** A court in Brazil sentences two former Military Police officers to 59 and 78 years in prison respectively for the assassination of Rio de Janeiro city councilor and human rights activist Marielle Franco in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-judge-sentences-ex-cops-over-marielle-franco-killing/a-70656556>).

<a id="event-2024-10-31-6-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Fijian presidential election.

#### Science and technology

Context: North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korea launches an intercontinental ballistic missile on a "lofted trajectory" toward the Sea of Japan. Japanese Defense Minister Gen Nakatani says that this was the longest-ever launch of a North Korean ICBM, lasting 87 minutes, marking significant progress in range compared to previous tests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/30/north-korea-launches-ballistic-missile-towards-the-sea-south-korea-says>).


## November

### 2024-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1272918975](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20November%201&oldid=1272918975>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-11-01-0-3"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** At least 29 Palestinians are killed in Israeli airstrikes on several refugee camps across the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-29-palestinians-killed-israeli-airstrikes-several-areas-gaza-2024-11-05/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Zaporizhzhian strikes.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and at least 20 others are injured in a Russian missile strike on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-six-injures-20-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-2024-11-05/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Thirty people are killed after an Israeli airstrike against a residential building in Barja, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-hezbollah-mideast-latest-6-november-2024-64bae4547ba0dca7042cf87d32e55cc1>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-29-palestinians-killed-israeli-airstrikes-several-areas-gaza-2024-11-05/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-11-05-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 European floods / 2024 Spanish floods.

**Archived source account.** Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez announces a €10.6 billion (US$11.5 billion) aid package to families affected by the flooding in the country, primarily in the Valencian Community, including a package of €5 billion (US$5.5 billion) in state-guaranteed loans.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/spain-announces-10-6-billion-euro-aid-package-for-flood-affected-areas>); [La Nación](<https://www.nacion.com/el-mundo/presidente-de-espana-anuncia-ayuda-por-10600/I2MX47QOMVGRZDLBFUQUXN3F4E/story/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people, including two election poll workers are killed by flash flooding in the U.S. state of Missouri, caused by torrential rain.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/missouri-flash-flooding-kills-5-including-2-poll-workers/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Egyptian Air Force officers are killed when a helicopter crashes during a training exercise in Suez Governorate, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/north-africa/2024/11/05/two-egyptian-pilots-killed-in-helicopter-crash-in-suez-army>); [Egypt Independent](<https://www.egyptindependent.com/two-egyptian-officers-killed-in-helicopter-crash-during-training/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-11-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Somalia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Somalia reaches an agreement to write off over $1.1 billion of Somali debt.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/11/05/us-writes-off-over-1-billion-of-somalia-debt>); [The EastAfrican](<https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/business-tech/us-cancels-1-1-billion-of-somalia-debt-4815308>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-1"></a>

Context: English Channel migrant crossings.

**Archived source account.** A court in Lille, France, convicts 18 people, including nine in absentia, for participating in an international human smuggling network that transported migrants across the English Channel. The sentences range from two to fifteen years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/french-court-jails-18-members-of-english-channel-people-smuggling-network>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven men from the Saxonian Separatists group are arrested in Germany and another is arrested in Poland for plotting ethnic cleansing terrorist attacks and for plotting to take control of several areas of Saxony.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/eight-members-of-far-right-group-arrested-in-germany-and-poland>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Railway workers launch an eight-hour strike in Italy after a train manager was stabbed and critically injured on a train near Rivarolo Ligure, Genoa, yesterday. Several trains are canceled, with only 30% of services guaranteed.

Source citations (as archived): [Ansa](<https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/general_news/2024/11/05/train-strike-held-across-italy-after-rail-worker-attacked_6d241dbf-9af4-457d-8441-a7b0d4293afc.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Equatoguinean vice-president Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue warns that politicians caught having sex in their offices could face harsh consequences after a civil servant was caught having sex with multiple women while on the job.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyx32945gqo>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Personal Information Protection Commission of South Korea fines Meta Platforms ₩21.6 billion (US$15 million) for illegally collecting personal information on Facebook users and sharing it with advertisers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/meta-facebook-south-korea-fine-privacy-9a1e9500d0462112c422e0612f1f7085>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** French and Dutch police raid Netflix offices in Paris and Amsterdam as part of an investigation into tax fraud and unreported employment practices.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy1vze09wwo>); [Deadline](<https://deadline.com/2024/11/netflix-france-netherlands-alleged-tax-fraud-concealed-employment-investigation-1236167541/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-05-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Swedish court sentences Danish-Swedish politician Rasmus Paludan to four months in jail for inciting hatred against Muslims at two protests in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/05/swedish-court-jails-far-right-leader-who-burned-quran>).

**Archived source account.** Two Chinese nationals are shot by a security guard at a textile mill in Karachi, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pakistani-guard-shoots-wound-2-chinese-working-textile-115505344>).

Context: 2024 United States elections / 2024 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/fake-bomb-threats-linked-russia-briefly-close-georgia-polling-locations-2024-11-05/>).

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protesters demonstrate in Novi Sad, Serbia, to protest the deadly collapse of a railway station canopy on Friday, leading to violent confrontations with police and vandalism of the city hall.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbian-protesters-clash-with-police-over-train-station-disaster-2024-11-05/>).

Context: Protests against the firing of Yoav Gallant.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-11-05-5-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima nuclear accident.

**Archived source account.** A remote-controlled robot retrieves a piece of melted fuel from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, the first time a piece of melted fuel has been retrieved from a nuclear meltdown.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/japan-fukushima-nuclear-melted-fuel-robot-d4bbfb543a0bbf9839ed2b33ea5ea969>).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/worlds-first-wooden-satellite-launched-into-space/a-70691359>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-signs-deal-acquire-25-f-15-fighter-jets-boeing-co-2024-11-07/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-07-0-8"></a>

<a id="event-2024-11-07-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 South American drought.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations reports that almost a half million children in the Amazon are currently experiencing significant food and water scarcity due to prolonged droughts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2024/nov/07/severe-drought-children-food-water-school-amazon-climate-rivers-transport-unicef>).

Context: 2024 Atlantic hurricane season, 2024 Cuba blackouts.

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations / International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The British government announces 56 sanctions on individuals and entities based in countries including China and Turkey, as well as on the Africa Corps mercenary group, in order to target Russia's military-industrial complex and restrict the supply of military equipment to Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/new-uk-sanctions-russia-also-target-africa-corps-2024-11-07/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/uk-blacklists-mercenary-groups-in-africa-in-latest-sanctions-against-russia>).

Context: France–Israel relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel Police forcibly enter the French-administered Church of the Pater Noster compound in Jerusalem and detain two French consulate employees. French foreign minister Jean-Noël Barrot cancels his visit to the site while the French government summons the Israeli ambassador in response.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/07/diplomatic-incident-occurs-in-jerusalem-on-sidelines-of-french-foreign-minister-s-visit_6732054_4.html>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-france-netanyahu-war-gaza-lebanon-macron-church-3f14d060106160b10cbc8abbd3825f7a>).

Context: Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** Germany arrests an American citizen suspected of spying on the U.S. military for China while working at a U.S. military installation in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/germany-arrests-us-national-accused-of-spying-for-china>).

### 2024-11-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1263466375](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20November%208&oldid=1263466375>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-11-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes, Kyiv strikes, Odesa strikes.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and at least 38 others are injured in Russian airstrikes in Kharkiv, Kyiv, and Odesa, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-missiles-drones-bombs-098885dc87ac4ffbeecdc537650a85b0>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Yemeni government soldier opens fire on Saudi troops in Seiyun, Yemen, killing two and injuring one other. Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula and the Houthis are suspected to be the perpetrators of the attack, however no group claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/yemen-saudi-arabia-soldiers-killed-houthis-war-79eb16222c28985a98b77995b4a30149>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-0-6"></a>

Context: 2024 Mozambican general election, Human rights in Mozambique.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch reports that at least 34 people have been killed and at least 66 others have been injured in the past three weeks in police crackdowns of violent protests following the Mozambican presidential election. Mozambican police fired tear gas and rubber bullets at protesters in the capital city Maputo, with the Army later deployed to end the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/8/at-least-30-reported-killed-in-weeks-of-post-vote-violence-in-mozambique>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/mozambique-protests-army-deployed-as-hrw-highlight-death-toll/a-70738750>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-0-8"></a>

Context: November 2024 Amsterdam attacks, Antisemitism in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Pro-Palestinian locals attack supporters of Israeli football team Maccabi Tel Aviv F.C. after a match with AFC Ajax in Amsterdam, Netherlands, following instances of anti-Palestinian and anti-Arab chants and vandalism by Maccabi ultras. At least 30 people are injured, with five hospitalized, and 62 people are arrested. Dutch authorities condemn the attacks as antisemitic with the government of Amsterdam subsequently banning protests and demonstrations in the city for three days.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/07/europe/israel-soccer-fans-attacked-amsterdam-intl-hnk/index.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/8/israeli-football-fans-clash-with-protesters-in-amsterdam>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/israels-pm-aware-very-violent-incident-against-israelis-amsterdam-his-office-2024-11-08/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-11-08-1-1"></a>

Context: 67th Annual Grammy Awards.

**Archived source account.** American musician Beyoncé receives eleven nominations for the 2025 Grammy Awards, making her the most nominated artist in the award's history with 99 total nominations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/grammy-award-nominations-2025-b3db08a95aa45979062e5dc997a3ac98>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-11-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and twelve others are missing when a fishing boat capsizes off the coast of Jeju Island, South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Herald](<https://news.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20241108050238>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2024-11-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian environment and climate change ministry reports that deforestation in the Amazon rainforest decreased by 30.6% compared to last year, the lowest level in nine years. Additionally, deforestation in the Cerrado tropical savannah region decreased by 25.7%, the first decrease in five years.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-amazon-deforestation-lula-wildfires-4a8e25c3dee73ccd942677c192cf3e42>); [Semafor](<https://www.semafor.com/article/11/08/2024/amazon-rainforest-deforestation-falls-to-lowest-levels-in-nine-years>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-11-08-4-1"></a>

Context: South China Sea dispute.

**Archived source account.** President Bongbong Marcos signs into law the Maritime Zones Act and the Archipelagic Sea Lanes Act which defines the maritime entitlements of the Philippines and set designated sea lanes and air routes. China protests against the laws which is linked to territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-president-signs-new-laws-assert-south-china-sea-rights-sovereignty-2024-11-08/>); [Nikkei Asia](<https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/International-relations/South-China-Sea/Philippines-Marcos-signs-laws-to-assert-South-China-Sea-rights>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-4-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States lifts its ban on deploying military contractors to Ukraine, thereby enabling American companies to directly assist with the maintenance and repair of U.S.-made weapons, such as F-16 fighter aircraft and Patriot air defense systems. The U.S. says that its contractors will be positioned far from the front lines and will not engage in combat with Russian forces.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/08/politics/biden-administration-american-military-contractors-deploy-ukraine/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-11-08-5-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Milton / Conspiracy theories about the 2024 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** A Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) employee is fired for having told relief workers to not aid those who supported then-Republican candidate in the upcoming 2024 United States presidential election, Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/08/politics/fema-employee-trump-florida-hurricane/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-5-4"></a>

Context: Security incidents involving Donald Trump, Iranian interference in the 2024 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Justice Department announces that they have formally charged an Afghan national who confessed to a murder-for-hire plan linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeting president-elect Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/08/politics/doj-charges-three-iranian-plot-to-kill-donald-trump/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-08-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of Fiji Frank Bainimarama is released from prison early after serving six months for perverting the course of justice.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/533224/convicted-former-fiji-prime-minister-frank-bainimarama-released-from-prison-early>).

#### Law and crime

Context: 2024 Zhuhai car attack.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-five people are killed and 43 more injured during a vehicle-ramming attack outside a stadium in Zhuhai, Guangdong, China. The perpetrator is in a coma after suffering serious injuries.

<a id="event-2024-11-11-3-3"></a>

Context: Haitian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Several airlines suspend flights to Haiti after a flight attendant was injured when a Spirit Airlines aircraft was hit by gunfire while attempting to land at Toussaint Louverture International Airport in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, and was diverted to Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic.

<a id="event-2024-11-11-3-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0j8dq235e2o>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/law/2024/nov/11/icc-prosecutor-to-face-external-investigation-into-sexual-misconduct-claims>).

<a id="event-2024-11-11-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Italy, the Carabinieri Art Squad seizes more than 2,100 forged artworks worth more than €200 million (US$215 million) that were intended to be sold at auction houses across Europe and also uncovers two art forgery workshops in Tuscany and Venice.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/italy-police-bust-crime-network-forging-renowned-paintings/a-70758728>).

<a id="event-2024-11-11-3-6"></a>

Context: 2024 Japanese general election.

Context: Haitian crisis.

The airport is also closed indefinitely in response to the shooting.

<a id="event-2024-11-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announces that Turkey has suspended all diplomatic relations with and will not develop any further relations with Israel. However, the Turkish embassy in Tel Aviv, Israel, will continue to operate. Israel's foreign ministry denies any change in its diplomatic relationship with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [JNS](<https://www.jns.org/israel-denies-erdogan-claim-of-end-to-diplomatic-relations/>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/turkey-cuts-off-relations-israel-1985013>); [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/turkey-severs-all-relations-israel-says-erdogan>).

<a id="event-2024-11-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Brasília attack.

**Archived source account.** Two explosions occurs near the Supreme Federal Court building and the Praça dos Três Poderes in Brasília, Brazil. The perpetrator dies by suicide bombing, being the only fatality. The Federal Police announces an investigation into the explosions, while the Attorney General's Office calls the situation "an attack against the Supreme Federal Court and the Chamber of Deputies".

Source citations (as archived): [G1](<https://g1.globo.com/df/distrito-federal/noticia/2024/11/13/praca-dos-tres-poderes-em-brasilia-e-isolada-apos-explosoes.ghtml>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/13/americas/brazil-supreme-court-explosions-intl-latam/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India rules that it is unconstitutional for the government to demolish property belonging to people suspected of crimes without a legal process, a practice common in states ruled by the Bharatiya Janata Party.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/sc-bans-bulldozer-justice-calls-it-unconstitutional-drafts-norms/articleshow/115273220.cms>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-supreme-court-bans-bulldozer-justice/a-70771474>).

### 2024-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1261616986](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20November%2025&oldid=1261616986>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-11-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Haitian crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations orders its staff to evacuate from Port-au-Prince, Haiti, as clashes between armed gangs, police, and civilian vigilantes escalate in the city. Nonprofit organization Food for the Poor also ceases operations in Haiti due to gang disruptions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/25/un-evacuation-in-haiti-police-assault-stronghold-of-gang-leader-barbecue>).

<a id="event-2024-11-25-1-1"></a>

Context: German economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Germany's largest steelmaker conglomerate, ThyssenKrupp, announces plans to layoff 11,000 workers, including 5,000 in Europe, by 2030.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-steel-giant-thyssenkrupp-to-slash-11000-jobs/a-70880227>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-11-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 Australian region cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and six others are missing in flash floods caused by Tropical Low 01U in Sumatra, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-north-sumatra-flash-floods-landslide-df987590034f68545597a2e917fc82e9>); [The Irish Examiner](<https://www.irishexaminer.com/world/arid-41523464.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-25-2-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2m7z9xpndo.amp>).

**Archived source account.** One crew member is killed and three others are injured when a DHL Boeing 737-400F cargo plane operated by Swiftair crashes into the ground near a residential building while approaching Vilnius Airport in Lithuania. No one on the ground is injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/dhl-cargo-plane-crashes-near-vilnius-airport-2024-11-25/>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/lithuania-dhl-freight-plane-crashes-near-vilnius-airport/a-70875160>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-11-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of the Security Council of Russia Sergei Shoigu pledges Russia's intent to build closer ties with the Taliban Government of Afghanistan, and states that the United States should lead rebuilding efforts due to its part in the War in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-pledges-broader-afghanistan-ties-says-us-should-help-rebuild-2024-11-26/>).

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jack-smith-dismiss-charges-trump-d-c-election-case/>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2024/11/25/jack-smith-drops-case-trump-election-00191514>).

**Archived source account.** Namibians vote in the first round of the general election between 14 candidates for President, and also vote for the 96 members of the National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/namibia-election-vote-woman-swapo-da175a3b3021bc19eb1db85d548a0fe0>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/namibian-election-swapo-faces-new-challenges-in-tight-race/a-70890329>).

### 2024-11-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1276746518](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20November%2028&oldid=1276746518>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Defence Ministry claims that Russian forces have taken the village of Nova Illinka in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-defence-ministry-says-moscows-forces-take-another-east-ukrainian-2024-11-28/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure, Ukrainian energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches a massive missile and drone attack on civilian and critical infrastructure in Ukraine, injuring at least five people and causing blackouts for more than a million households.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/28/europe/ukraine-russia-war-power-cut-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** More than 130 Syrian Army soldiers are killed and dozens of others are captured as rebel forces led by Tahrir al-Sham advance to within 10 kilometres of Aleppo, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-rebels-launch-attack-against-army-aleppo-province-2024-11-27/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces cut off the strategic M5 Motorway which connects Aleppo to Damascus and also capture the district of Khan al-Asal near Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/israel-at-war/artc-idf-fires-warning-shots-in-lebanon-wounded-reported-in-live-blog>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/28/syrian-insurgents-cut-damascus-aleppo-highway-amid-fresh-offensive>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** An Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps brigadier is killed in a shootout in Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/281120241>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** Russian and Syrian warplanes strike rebel-held positions across Idlib Governorate. Separately, at least 17 people are killed in airstrikes on the towns of Atarib and Darat Izza in Aleppo Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/syrian-russian-jets-bomb-rebel-held-northwest-syria-2024-11-28/>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/350093/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-0-13"></a>

Context: Hezbollah–Israel conflict / 2024 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire agreement.

**Archived source account.** Israel and Hezbollah accuse each other of violating ceasefire terms that came into action the prior day, following an Israeli Air Force airstrike on a Hezbollah missile storage facility and the Israeli Defense Forces opening fire on suspected combatants moving into southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-tank-fires-3-south-lebanese-towns-lebanese-security-sources-media-say-2024-11-28/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-11-28-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 Australian region cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Landslides and flash floods caused by Cyclone Robyn kill at least 27 people and injure dozens of others in North Sumatra, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/landslides-indonesias-sumatra-kill-least-27-rescuers-search-missing-2024-11-28/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-1-3"></a>

Context: 2024 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** At least twelve people, including four children, are killed and more than 250,000 people are evacuated due to flooding and landslides caused by Deep Depression BOB 08 in Sri Lanka.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/sri-lanka-several-dead-as-storm-causes-floods-landslides/a-70905137>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-1-5"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean snowstorm.

**Archived source account.** At least six people are killed in traffic accidents and more than 140 flights are canceled in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, due to a winter storm in the country, marking the third heaviest snowfall in Seoul since 1907.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.dw.com/en/south-korea-at-least-4-dead-in-heavy-snowfall/a-70904356>); [Yonhap](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20241128001351315>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/south-korea-reports-dead-record-snowfall-travel-1993225>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-1-7"></a>

Context: 2024 Ugandan landslides.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 113 others are missing in landslides in Bulambuli, Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/28/casualties-after-landslides-bury-homes-in-uganda>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-11-28-2-2"></a>

Context: Georgia–European Union relations, Potential enlargement of the European Union / Accession of Georgia to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Georgia Irakli Kobakhidze temporarily suspends the country's accession to the European Union until 2028 and accuses the European Parliament of blackmail.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/28/georgia-to-suspend-eu-accession-talks-until-2028>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/georgia-pause-eu-accession-bid-until-2028-irakli-kobakhidze/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-2-4"></a>

Context: Chad–France relations.

**Archived source account.** The government of Chad announces it will terminate its defense pact with France, stating it wants to fully assert its sovereignty following its independence from France in 1960.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/chad-to-end-security-cooperation-with-france/a-70914205>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/chad-ends-defense-cooperation-agreement-with-france/7881027.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-11-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese Communist Party suspends the Director of the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission Admiral Miao Hua from his post following a corruption investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/china-top-military-official-miao-hua-suspended-investigation-4775906>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-3-3"></a>

Context: PTI do-or-die protest, Freedom of the press in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani senior journalist Matiullah Jan and his colleague are abducted by unidentified men while they were reporting on the protests for the release of former Prime Minister Imran Khan in Islamabad, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/khan-protest-pakistan-reporter-matiullah-jan-arrested/a-70907445>); [The Nation](<https://www.nation.com.pk/29-Nov-2024/atc-sends-journalist-matiullah-jan-in-2-days-physical-remand>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-11-28-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Georgian parliamentary election protests, Accession of Georgia to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in Tbilisi, Georgia, to protest against Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze and his party's decision to suspend the country's accession plans to the European Union. Riot police fire tear gas and water cannons at protesters near the parliament building.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-thousands-protest-after-pm-suspends-eu-entry-bid/a-70913068>); [Yahoo\! News](<https://uk.news.yahoo.com/thousands-georgians-march-tbilisi-protest-233853861.html?guccounter=1>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/29/world/europe/georgia-protests-eu-membership.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Romanian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Romania requests a recount of all votes cast in the first round of the presidential election following a complaint by candidate Cristian Terheș.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/romania-election-president-recount-georgescu-far-right-34f4284d54ea34a841225e2c3a968c6d>).

<a id="event-2024-11-28-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian House of Representatives passes a bill to restrict social media access for people under the age of 16 years.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/australia-passes-landmark-social-media-ban-children-16-rcna181124>).

### 2024-11-29

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** Anti-Assad forces led by Tahrir al-Sham enter the city of Aleppo, Syria, for the first time since 2016 with heavy urban fighting reportedly underway in the western neighbourhoods of the city. A rebel coalition spokesman confirms that an operation to capture Aleppo has officially begun.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/29/world/syria-rebels-aleppo-war-intl/index.html>); [The New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/syria-rebels-fighting-within-aleppo-offensive-continues>).

<a id="event-2024-11-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces reach the city centre of Aleppo after overrunning multiple neighbourhoods, including New Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/armed-groups-opposed-to-assads-regime-in-syrian-enter-aleppo-city-center/3408670>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-attack-clashes-aleppo-9c07da6f83036f34d4b18a479de9d085>).

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d9%88%d8%b3%d8%b7-%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a6%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%81%d8%b5%d8%a7/738280/>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine, Ukraine–NATO relations / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/43076>).

<a id="event-2024-11-29-0-14"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

<a id="event-2024-11-29-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/society/2024/nov/29/mps-vote-for-assisted-dying-in-england-and-wales>).

### 2024-11-30

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** Pro-government forces close Aleppo International Airport and major roads in Aleppo, Syria, as rebels continue to advance into the city. The airport is later captured by the rebels.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/11/30/syrian-rebels-capture-aleppo-airport-seize-majority-city/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/aleppo-airport-closed-sources-say-syrian-rebels-reach-heart-city-2024-11-29/>).

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** Rebels capture the Citadel of Aleppo and the University of Aleppo as they continue to advance through the city.

Source citations (as archived): [New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/syrian-rebels-reach-aleppo-citadel-impose-curfew-after-assault>).

<a id="event-2024-11-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** Rebel tanks reach the main Saadallah al-Jabiri Square in Aleppo's city centre with the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reporting that a majority of the city is now under the control of rebel forces.

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Battle of Aleppo.

**Archived source account.** A Russian airstrike hits a busy roundabout in Aleppo, killing at least 16 people and injuring 20 others, the first time that Russian warplanes have targeted the city since 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%b4%d9%87%d8%a7%d8%af-16-%d8%b4%d8%ae%d8%b5-%d9%85%d8%ac%d8%b2%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d9%85%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%b9%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d8%aa%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%87%d8%a7-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b7%d8%a7/738431/>).

<a id="event-2024-11-30-0-10"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Araby](<https://www.alaraby.co.uk/politics/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%B9%D8%A7-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%91-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%8A%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%B9-%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D8%AF%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86>).

<a id="event-2024-11-30-0-23"></a>

<a id="event-2024-11-30-0-25"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and four others are injured after an attack in a commercial zone in Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato, Mexico. Local authorities say the attack relates to the drug sales in the region.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-11-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnam approves a US$67 billion 1541 km high speed rail line from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City, which will be an updated version of the North–South express railway proposal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-approves-data-electricity-laws-67-bln-rail-plan-2024-11-30/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-11-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 27 people are killed and more than 100 others are missing when a boat capsizes in the Niger River in Kogi State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/several-dead-after-boat-capsizes-in-nigeria>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-11-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Ibar-Lepenac attack.

**Archived source account.** Police arrest eight people linked to an explosion on a canal near Zubin Potok, Mitrovica District, Kosovo, that supplies water to the country's two main power plants. The Kosovar government blames Serbia for the "terrorist" acts, which Serbia denies.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/kosovo-pm-blames-serbia-for-explosion-at-canal-supplying-power-plants>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/30/kosovo-blames-serbia-for-explosion-that-cut-water-and-power-supplies>); [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/30/explosion-at-kosovo-canal-feeding-key-power-plants-labeled-a-terrorist-attack-by-pm_6734656_4.html>).

<a id="event-2024-11-30-3-3"></a>

Context: San Andrés Preparatory School attack.

**Archived source account.** A student attacks his classmates with a hammer and injures two before being subdued by other students at a high school in Guadalajara, Jalisco, México. The attack was streamed on X, where the perpetrator published Nazi views and other violent content.

Source citations (as archived): [El Debate](<https://www.debate.com.mx/guadalajara/Joven-que-ataco-a-sus-companeros-en-preparatoria-de-Guadalajara-anuncio-previamente-agresion-20241130-0144.html>).

#### Politics and elections

Context: 2024 Georgian post-election protests.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 demonstrators are arrested in Tbilisi, Georgia, while protesting against Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze's decision to temporarily suspend the country's accession plans to the European Union to 2028.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/100-arrested-georgian-police-clash-protesters-suspension-eu-116332873>).

<a id="event-2024-11-30-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Icelandic parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Iceland vote in a snap election to elect the 63 members of the Althing national parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/iceland-holds-parliamentary-election-after-governments-collapse>).

#### Sports

Context: 2024 Copa Libertadores.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Botafogo win their first Copa Libertadores title after defeating Atlético Mineiro 3–1 in an all-Brazilian final at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/copa-libertadores-final-botafogo-mineiro-dbe253cb384372888fc049d97b0ac8cb>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-03-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** During an emergency address to the nation, South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declares martial law in order to clear out alleged "threats posed by North Korean communist forces and to eliminate anti-state elements." Yoon says that the decision to declare martial law was made in order to "remove North Korean forces" and to protect South Korea's "liberal constitutional order".

Source citations (as archived): [KBS](<https://world.kbs.co.kr/service/news_view.htm?lang=e&amp;Seq_Code=189470>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn38321180et>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-president-yoon-declares-martial-law-2024-12-03/>); [Barrons](<https://www.barrons.com/news/south-korea-president-declares-emergency-martial-law-99c52b4f>).

<a id="event-2024-12-03-4-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** South Korean Army general Park An-su is appointed Martial Law Commander by Yoon Suk Yeol, with Park announcing that media organizations will be subject to military control and that protests will be banned.

Source citations (as archived): [YNA](<https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20241203162600504>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/dec/03/south-korea-declares-emergency-martial-law-yoon-suk-yeol-north-korea-latest-updates>).

<a id="event-2024-12-03-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters clash with police while attempting to storm the National Assembly building in Seoul.

<a id="event-2024-12-03-4-4"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** In defiance of the declaration of martial law, which prohibits political activities, the National Assembly votes unanimously to order Yoon Suk Yeol to lift martial law. Korean soldiers that were guarding the National Assembly building withdraw following the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/dec/03/south-korea-declares-emergency-martial-law-yoon-suk-yeol-north-korea-latest-updates>).

<a id="event-2024-12-03-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yoon Suk Yeol announces that he will lift the martial law that he declared hours earlier amid staunch opposition from both the opposition and his own People Power Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-president-yoon-declares-martial-law-2024-12-03/>).

**Archived source account.** In France, the Barnier government collapses after 331 of 577 deputies vote in favor of a no-confidence motion, the first time since 1962 that the government has collapsed following a no-confidence motion. The left subsequently calls on President Emmanuel Macron to resign and hold early presidential elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-lawmakers-set-vote-ousting-prime-minister-barnier-2024-12-04/>).

The arrest comes as the government continues to crack down on the opposition in response to protests against delaying negotiations to join the European Union. More than 100 demonstrators are also injured during clashes with riot police in Tbilisi.
