<a id="event-2024-12-05-5-2"></a>

Context: European Union Space Programme / Copernicus Programme.

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency (ESA) successfully launches the Vega C rocket carrying the Sentinel-1C satellite to monitor Earth from the Guiana Space Centre in Kourou, French Guiana, two years after its failed commercial flight.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/european-vega-c-rocket-launches-after-two-year-gap/a-70978600>); [European Space Agency](<https://www.esa.int/Space_in_Member_States/Spain/Doble_victoria_para_Europa_Sentinel-1C_y_Vega-C_surcan_los_cielos>).

<a id="event-2024-12-05-5-3"></a>

Context: European Union Space Programme.

**Archived source account.** ISRO successfully launches the PSLV-XL rocket carrying the European Space Agency's PROBA-3 satellites from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, India, in a solar observatory mission to gather data about the Sun's atmosphere.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-with-esa-satellites-launches-artificial-eclipse-quest/a-70970788>); [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2024/12/04/675027a5fc6c83fe268b4589-video.html>).

### 2024-12-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1272916833](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%206&oldid=1272916833>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / 2024 Homs offensive.

**Archived source account.** After capturing the town of Talbiseh and the city of Al-Rastan, rebel forces capture several more towns and villages in the northern countryside of Homs Governorate, Syria, reaching the town of Al-Dar al-Kabirah and approaching the outskirts of Homs.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/350716/>); [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/ar/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9/%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%BA%D9%84-%D8%A8%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%B5/3416211>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / 2024 Homs offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian and Syrian warplanes bombard rebel-held areas in Homs Governorate, killing at least 20 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Southern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Army soldiers from the 8th Armoured Division in Daraa defect to the Syrian opposition as rebels launch attacks on pro-government checkpoints across Daraa Governorate, taking control of several towns, including Inkhil, Ghabaghib, and al-Jiza, as well as the city of Jasim. Rebels later claim near total control of the governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Yeni Safak](<https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/clashes-intensify-in-syrias-southern-province-of-daraa-3695387>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Southern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** Rebels take full control of the city of Daraa after agreeing to allow Ba'ath Party officials to leave the city with safe passage to Damascus, and also take full control of the mainly Druze city of Suwayda.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/syrian-rebels-take-over-southern-city-of-daraa-in-deal-with-army-rebel-sources/>); [The New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/syrian-regime-collapses-daraa-and-east-dozens-killed-gaza>); [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/clashes-intensify-in-syrias-southern-province-of-daraa/3416138>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/syria-civil-war-live-updates-syrian-state-media-denies-damascus-under-attack-rebels-advance-1996713>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Southern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** Jordan closes its border with Syria after rebel forces seize the main Nasib Border Crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/jordan-closes-border-crossing-into-syria-ministry-says-2024-12-06/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Deir ez-Zor offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces take control of Deir ez-Zor and its airport following the withdrawal of pro-government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Enab Baladi](<https://english.enabbaladi.net/archives/2024/12/syrian-regime-withdraws-forces-from-deir-ezzor/>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/350727/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Deir ez-Zor offensive.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi militias withdraw from the Syrian side of the Al-Qa'im border crossing on the border with Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Shafaq](<https://shafaq.com/en/Iraq/Iraqi-factions-withdraw-from-Syria-toward-Al-Qaim-as-SDF-seizes-Al-Bukamal-crossing>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Russia–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia tells its citizens to leave Syria on commercial flights while they still can amid rebel advances in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/12/06/russia-tells-its-nationals-to-leave-syria>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-15"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Turkish involvement in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Turkey freezes the assets of deceased former commander of Tahrir al-Sham Abu Maria al-Qahtani, who was killed in April, to comply with the United Nations Security Council's policies.

Source citations (as archived): [Turkish Minute](<https://www.turkishminute.com/2024/12/06/turkey-froze-assets-of-late-islamic-militant-leader-link-hts/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-16"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Tahrir al-Sham leader Abu Mohammad al-Julani says that his forces will not end their military campaign until Syrian president Bashar al-Assad is removed from power.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20241206-syria-rebel-leader-says-goal-is-to-overthrow-assad>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-17"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Egypt and Jordan both urge Bashar al-Assad and his family to leave Syria, saying that Assad can no longer stop the rebel offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/syrian-rebels-advance-on-third-major-city-in-growing-threat-to-assad-bd21f39f>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-18"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Indian Ministry of External Affairs advises its citizens to leave Syria and avoid all travel to the country indefinitely.

Source citations (as archived): [WION](<https://www.wionews.com/world/indians-advised-to-leave-syria-at-the-earliest-as-bashar-al-assad-loses-control-of-another-city-782177>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-21"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Kamal Adwan Hospital sieges.

**Archived source account.** Israeli drone strikes on the northern and western sides of the Kamal Adwan Hospital in Beit Lahia in the Gaza Strip kill at least 29 Palestinians. Israeli forces subsequently raid the hospital, killing four doctors.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/12/6/live-israel-kills-dozens-in-gaza-continues-to-target-southern-lebanon>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2024/12/06/middleeast/kamal-adwan-gaza-israel-hospital-raid-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-0-24"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Russian missile strike kills ten civilians in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, and injures four others, including two children. Separately, a missile attack on an administrative building in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, kills two people and injures 16 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-two-wounds-13-ukraines-kryvyi-rih-2024-12-06/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-12-06-1-1"></a>

Context: EU–Mercosur Association Agreement.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and Mercosur trade bloc finalize a free trade deal in Montevideo, Uruguay, after 25 years of negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20241206-%F0%9F%94%B4-european-union-and-mercosur-trade-bloc-finalise-contentious-free-trade-agreement>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 European windstorm season.

**Archived source account.** Millions of people receive emergency alerts in the United Kingdom as Storm Darragh prepares to make landfall over the British Isles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dxlwz219ko>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-six people are killed and 28 more injured after a collision between two minibuses in Brokoua, Ivory Coast.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ivory-coast-road-accident-bf1242dae98700c462d9cbb26987cb21>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Police presume that two Americans and a Canadian are dead after evidence suggests they fell while attempting to summit Mount Cook (Aoraki), suspending search operations.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/06/us/us-canada-climbers-new-zealand-hnk-intl/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Belarus–Russia relations, Nuclear risk during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin and Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko sign an agreement in Minsk, Belarus, offering security guarantees to Belarus including nuclear security and the possible use of Russian nuclear weapons in order to repel aggressions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-belarus-security-agreement-nuclear-doctrine-c07ef5d341f93be6934ac14a77b58f8b>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Antisemitism in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Two people are injured in an arson attack on a synagogue in Melbourne, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/australia-police-suspect-arson-attack-at-synagogue/a-70979260>); [The Australian Jewish News](<https://www.australianjewishnews.com/adass-shul-blaze-suspicious/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-4-3"></a>

Context: Restrictions on TikTok in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A United States court of appeals upholds the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act, which requires China-based company ByteDance to sell TikTok by January 19 or face an effective ban on operations in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2024/12/06/tiktok-divestment-law-upheld-by-federal-appeals-court.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-06-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Aruban general election.

**Archived source account.** Arubans vote to elect the 21 members of the Parliament. The Aruban People's Party wins nine seats and the People's Electoral Movement wins eight seats, neither parties achieving a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [Aruba Papers](<https://arubapapers.com/aruba-prepares-for-election-day-tomorrow-why-youre-seeing-colored-flags-everywhere/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-5-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Mauritian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** An uncontested election is held for the President of Mauritius, with former minister of education and Labour Party representative Dharam Gokhool winning without contest. Robert Hungley is elected Vice-President.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20241207/099e2e3939774046a018b86ed5a253ca/c.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-06-5-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Romanian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Romania annuls the first round results of the presidential election vote two days before the second round of the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/12/06/romania-election-president-georgescu-court/d43bd9e2-b3d4-11ef-9d23-e5faa22ad216_story.html>).

### 2024-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358134613](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%207&oldid=1358134613>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Operation Dawn of Freedom / Manbij offensive.

**Archived source account.** Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces conduct extensive drone strikes and artillery shelling on villages near U.S.-backed Kurdish Syrian Democratic Forces positions in the city of Manbij in Aleppo Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Motabaat](<https://www.motabaat.com/2024/12/07/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9/>); [Asharq Al-Awsat](<https://aawsat.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%%20D8%A8%D9%8A/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B%201%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A/5089231-%D8%B3%D%209%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%20%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%20%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D9%86-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%88%D8%A7%%20D8%B3%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%81-%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%20%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%8A>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** The Military Operations Command coalition led by Tahrir al-Sham says that a military operation to capture Damascus is underway with rebels reportedly advancing on the capital on several fronts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-832357>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces capture the cities of Al-Dumayr and Yabroud and the town of Sa'sa' in Rif Dimashq Governorate as the Syrian Defense Ministry denies reports that its troops are abandoning positions in the Damascus countryside.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/07/syrian-opposition-secures-sanamayn-near-damascus-commander-says>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d8%b9%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%a8-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%b1%d9%8a%d9%81-%d8%af%d9%85%d8%b4%d9%82-%d9%88%d9%85%d8%af%d9%86-%d9%85%d8%aa/739738/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Syrian security officials and Arab officials say that First Lady of Syria Asma al-Assad fled with her three children to Russia last week. However, amid conflicting reports, Syrian state television says that President Bashar al-Assad remains in Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/russia-not-come-assad-rescue-172820336.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Special Envoy for Syria Geir Otto Pedersen calls for an "orderly political transition" from the collapsing Syrian government to the Syrian opposition in order to end the conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-assad-sweida-daraa-homs-hts-qatar-7f65823bbf0a7bd331109e8dff419430>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/protesters-topple-statue-of-assad-s-father-in-damascus-suburb-witnesses-bb9c4ba3>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** A statue of former Syrian president Hafez al-Assad is toppled in the Damascus suburb of Jaramana.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/video/syrian-rebels-take-control-of-damascus-suburb-226468933570>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/protesters-topple-statue-of-assad-s-father-in-damascus-suburb-witnesses-bb9c4ba3>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Southern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Armed Forces announce a complete withdrawal from the Daraa and Suwayda Governorates in order to reinforce Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-assad-sweida-daraa-homs-hts-qatar-7f65823bbf0a7bd331109e8dff419430>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Southern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces capture the city of Al-Sanamayn in Daraa Governorate and also capture the city of Quneitra.

Source citations (as archived): [First Post](<https://www.firstpost.com/world/rebel-forces-just-20-km-away-from-syrian-capital-city-of-damascus-report-13842566.html>); [The Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/syria-conflict-live-updates-syrian-civil-war-bashar-al-assad-december-7-2024-101733532224129.html>); [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/07/syrian-opposition-forces-say-they-took-control-of-quneitra-near-israeli-border>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-15"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / 2024 Homs offensive.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces enter the city of Homs, eventually capturing the city after hours of urban warfare to oust Assad loyalists. Rebels also capture Homs Central Prison and release around 3,500 prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-rebels-seize-fourth-city-close-homs-threat-assads-rule-2024-12-07/>); [Times Now](<https://www.timesnownews.com/world/middle-east/syria-rebels-capture-homs-celebrate-at-famous-clock-tower-watch-article-116088698>); [Cedar News](<https://cedarnews.net/folders/newstasks/793569/video-the-homs-central-prison-has-been-captured-by-syrian-rebels/>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/rebel-leader-in-syria-says-freed-3-500-prisoners-in-homs-57284915>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-17"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Deir ez-Zor offensive.

**Archived source account.** More than 1,000 Syrian soldiers seeking refuge cross into Iraq through the Al-Qa'im border crossing according to Iraqi authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News Agency](<https://ina.iq/eng/36884-more-than-1000-syrian-soldiers-inside-iraqi-territory-says-senior-security-source.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-19"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Palmyra offensive.

**Archived source account.** The U.S.-backed Revolutionary Commando Army takes control of the city of Palmyra in Homs Governorate following heavy fighting with pro-government forces. Rebels also capture the towns of Al-Sukhnah and Al-Qaryatayn in Homs Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Yeni Safak](<https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/us-backed-syrian-free-army-takes-control-of-homs-palmyra-district-from-regime-forces-3695430>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-20"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army withdraws from the cities of Al-Hasakah and Qamishli in Al-Hasakah Governorate, transferring control of the Kurdish-majority cities to the Syrian Democratic Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/syrian-regime-withdraws-from-east-of-euphrates/3417069>); [Yeni Safak](<https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/syrian-regime-withdraws-from-east-of-euphrates-3695426>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-22"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iranian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Iran begins to evacuate military personnel, diplomatic staff, and civilians from Syria amid rebel advances.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/06/world/middleeast/iran-syria-evacuation.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-24"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Refugees of the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The UN World Food Programme reports that the renewed conflict in Syria is estimated to displace around 1.5 million Syrians.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://aje.io/pq3n3i?update=3370395>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-28"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people, including six children, are killed in Israeli airstrikes on the Nuseirat refugee camp in Deir al-Balah Governorate, Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://aje.io/y5lfzx>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-29"></a>

Context: Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani says at the Doha Forum that his country is seeing a momentum build up for a ceasefire to end the conflict between Israel and Hamas in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/7/qatari-pm-says-momentum-building-back-up-in-gaza-ceasefire-efforts>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-31"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Six Pakistan Army soldiers and 22 Tehreek-e-Taliban militants are killed in clashes near the Afghan border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/six-pakistani-soldiers-killed-firefight-with-militants-army-says-2024-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-0-32"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Six soldiers are killed and seven are injured after a mass shooting at a military checkpoint in Kurram District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-kurram-checkpoint-attack-taliban-e784f6cd506841decc0b8367ad4bb03f>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-07-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024–25 European windstorm season / Storm Darragh.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed by falling trees in England and more than 1.5 million people experience power outages in Ireland and the United Kingdom as Storm Darragh hits the British Isles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1j00p3j2dpo>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/millions-urged-to-stay-inside-as-storm-darragh-hits-uk-and-ireland-with-rare-red-weather-warning-issued-13268433>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-1-4"></a>

Context: 2024 The Hague explosion.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed, four others are injured, and several others are missing in an explosion that destroyed several apartments in The Hague, Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clykk717n1ko>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/12/08/at-least-five-killed-after-explosion-rips-through-apartment-in-dutch-city-the-hague>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Cross-strait relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors in Taiwan charge four soldiers with espionage, accusing the soldiers of passing photographs of Taiwan's military capability to Chinese agents in exchange for money between 2022 and 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/taiwanese-soldiers-charged-with-spying-for-china/a-70980382>); [The Standard](<https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/3/223519/Four-Taiwan-soldiers-charged-with-spying-for-China>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis / Attempted impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol.

**Archived source account.** A vote to impeach South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol fails in the National Assembly due to a boycott of the vote by members of Yoon's People Power Party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-politics-yoon-martial-law-impeachment-3f2a9190bf5cec83b49e2c6ad5cf5379>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-3"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** President Yoon Suk Yeol apologizes to the South Korean population, promising that he will not avoid legal sanctions or institute martial law a second time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/07/south-korean-president-apologises-for-martial-law-attempt-as-impeachment-vote-looms>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Indian farmers' protest.

**Archived source account.** Over 100 Indian farmers march from Punjab to the capital city New Delhi to demand for the legal assurance of a minimum support price for all crops as well as loan forgiveness for farmers.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-clashes-as-farmers-march-to-delhi-over-crop-prices/a-70983824>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-6"></a>

Context: 2024 Indian farmers' protest.

**Archived source account.** Punjab Police set up barricades and fire tear gas at the marching farmers as they enter Haryana, causing them to turn around and return to Shambhu, Punjab.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/chandigarh-news/punjab-farmers-halt-march-return-to-shambhu-protest-site-after-teargas-shelling-101733481768199.html>); [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/police-use-tear-gas-to-block-farmers-march-toward-indian-capital/3416578>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-8"></a>

Context: 2024 Ghanaian general election.

**Archived source account.** Ghanaians vote to elect the President and the 275 members of the Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/video/20241207-ghana-votes-in-tight-election-amid-hopes-for-better-economic-times>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-10"></a>

Context: 2025 Singaporean general election.

**Archived source account.** Former Workers' Party Secretary-General and longest-serving opposition Member of the Parliament of Singapore Low Thia Khiang announced retirement in politics ahead of the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/former-workers-party-chief-low-thia-khiang-not-contesting-in-next-general-election>); [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/former-workers-party-chief-low-thia-khiang-not-standing-general-election-4793036>).

<a id="event-2024-12-07-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Interim President and military junta leader of Burkina Faso Ibrahim Traoré dismisses Prime Minister Apollinaire J. Kyélem de Tambèla and dissolves the government.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-military-junta-dissolves-government/a-70989590>); [Irish Examiner](<https://www.irishexaminer.com/world/arid-41531900.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-12-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian Space Agency successfully launches the Simorgh rocket carrying two satellites and the Saman-1 space tug from the Imam Khomeini Space Launch Terminal in Semnan, Iran, the heaviest payload ever launched in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/iran-launches-its-heaviest-ever-payload-into-space/a-70981129>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2024-12-07-5-1"></a>

Context: MLS Cup 2024.

**Archived source account.** In association football, the Los Angeles Galaxy defeat the New York Red Bulls 2–1 to win a record 6th championship.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mls-cup-galaxy-red-bulls-score-691dda52fac25cdbf401e81d0e917554>).

### 2024-12-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358134650](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%208&oldid=1358134650>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad leaves the country on a flight from Damascus International Airport to Moscow, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.livemint.com/news/world/syria-news-live-bashar-al-assad-hayat-tahrir-al-sham-us-russia-iran-iraq-civil-war-damascus-aleppo-homs-hama-11733624419642.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Russian state media reports that Bashar al-Assad is in Moscow, and that he and his family have been granted asylum by the Russian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/08/syrian-rebels-take-the-capital-damascus-say-bashar-al-assad-has-fled-the-country>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/syrias-president-bashar-al-assad-is-in-moscow-and-has-been-granted-asylum-confirms-russian-state-media-13269955>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Senior Syrian government officials are reportedly in talks with the Syrian opposition and are preparing to defect.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/syria-civil-war-12-07-2024-intl#cm4eq0eru00143b6pwhulcx5f>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Prime Minister Mohammad Ghazi al-Jalali says that he is not leaving Syria and will commit to a peaceful transition of power to the Syrian opposition. Al-Jalali also calls on rebel forces to not damage state institutions in Damascus or to harm civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/2024/12/08/syria-damascus-assad-regime-collapse>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army says that Bashar al-Assad's rule has ended and orders all of its troops to lay down arms and stop fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-rebels-celebrate-captured-homs-set-sights-damascus-2024-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Syrian rebels seize state television and announce to the nation that Bashar al-Assad has been toppled and that a new government will be formed.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20241208/e7764429b7494ef2b85f963c83556b45/c.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces seize the Presidential Palace in Damascus, which is later looted by armed soldiers and civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2024/dec/08/syrian-rebels-carry-furniture-from-presidential-palace-after-capturing-damascus-video>); [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/08/military-operations-administration-fighter-reach-entrance-of-syria-s-presidential-palace->).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces take control of Sednaya Prison and begin releasing thousands of prisoners, including many political prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/syria-rebels-monitor-say-gates-open-at-damascus-notorious-sednaya-jail-2f669832>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Damascus residents gather in Umayyad Square to celebrate the collapse of the Assad regime.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** A video posted to X shows Syrians tearing down posters of former Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah and former Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commander Qasem Soleimani at the Iranian embassy in Damascus. Statues of former president Hafez al-Assad are also toppled across the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Bawaba](<https://www.albawaba.com/node/syrians-tear-nasrallah-poster-down-1595943>); [Madhyama Online](<https://madhyamamonline.com/world/statues-of-presidents-father-dragged-through-syrian-streets-1358083>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-14"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Fall of Damascus.

**Archived source account.** Syrians abroad celebrate the collapse of the Assad regime, with rallies being held in cities across Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20241208-thousands-of-syrians-in-berlin-celebrate-departure-of-assad>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/dec/08/syria-bashar-al-assad-damascus-rebels-latest-updates-live?page=with:block-6755f4898f08d291b219b2f2#block-6755f4898f08d291b219b2f2>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-16"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Manbij offensive, Operation Dawn of Freedom.

**Archived source account.** Turkish security sources claim that 80% of Kurdish-held positions in the city of Manbij in Aleppo Governorate have been taken by the Turkey-backed Syrian National Army.

Source citations (as archived): [Türkiye Today](<https://www.turkiyetoday.com/turkiye/80-of-manbij-under-control-cleared-of-pkk-ypg-turkish-security-sources-90068/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-17"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Manbij offensive, Operation Dawn of Freedom.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan threatens "appropriate measures" against Kurdistan Workers' Party-aligned rebel groups, and states that Turkey will never allow these groups control over any part of Syria or its government.

Source citations (as archived): [Shafaq](<https://shafaq.com/en/World/Turkish-FM-Ankara-monitors-threats-from-ISIS-and-PKK>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-19"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives / Deir ez-Zor offensive.

**Archived source account.** Syrian regime forces reportedly surrender Deir ez-Zor to opposition forces, according to Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t?post=asset%3Aba5147fa-5c8f-4eef-84c2-6dd9cb910dd2#post>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-22"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel and the Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** Israeli tanks and troops enter Syria's Quneitra Governorate to reportedly establish a buffer zone, marking Israel's first crossing of the ceasefire line in 50 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/reports-claim-israeli-tanks-crossing-into-syria-buffer-zone/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://aje.io/pq3n3i?update=3371476>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-23"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel and the Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces take control of the towns of Madinat al-Baath and Khan Arnabah in Quneitra Governorate and also capture the Syrian side of Mount Hermon in Rif Dimashq Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Factjo](<https://factjo.com/news.aspx?Id=223422>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israeli-air-force-captures-syrian-side-of-mount-hermon-located-within-buffer-zone-without-resistance/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-24"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel and the Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force launches targeted airstrikes on ammunition and equipment depots at Mezzeh Air Base in Damascus and Khalkhalah air base in Suwayda Governorate. An Israeli airstrike also targets the Scientific Research Center in Damascus's security zone, which oversees chemical weapons and ballistic missile programs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/syria-live-rebels-say-assad-gone-regime-toppled-2024-12-08/>); [Sada El-Balad](<https://www.elbalad.news/6408292>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2024/12/8/%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-25"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel and the Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says that the 1974 Agreement on Disengagement between Israel and Syria has "collapsed" and orders the Israel Defense Forces to occupy the Syrian side of the Golan Heights.

Source citations (as archived): [New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/israels-netanyahu-declares-end-syria-border-agreement>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-28"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / US intervention in the Syrian civil war / War against the Islamic State.

**Archived source account.** The United States launches airstrikes on ISIL targets in Syria following the collapse of the Assad regime.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/12/08/us-launches-air-strikes-on-isis-targets-syria/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-29"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / US intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Outgoing U.S. President Joe Biden praises the end of the Ba'athist Syria regime and announces that the U.S. will support Syria and its neighbors during Syria's political transition.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2024/12/08/biden-says-us-will-support-syria-and-its-neighbors-after-assad-dynasty-collapses.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-30"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Turkish forces bombard positions in Syrian Democratic Forces-controlled areas in Al-Hasakah.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/350861/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-31"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian opposition takes control of the city of Jableh in Latakia Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2024/12/8/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%A8%D8%AC-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%81>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-34"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 16 Palestinians are killed in Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip, including in Deir al-Balah and the Bureij refugee camp.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/8/israeli-attack-on-gaza-camp-kills-five-displaced-family-members>).

<a id="event-2024-12-08-0-37"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Casualties of the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that 43,000 Ukrainian soldiers have been killed in action since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022 and that 370,000 soldiers have been injured, while estimating the number of Russian casualties at 198,000 soldiers killed and more than 550,000 soldiers injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-volodymyr-zelenskyy-announces-its-total-military-casualties-first-time/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2024-12-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Reopening of Notre-Dame de Paris.

**Archived source account.** The Notre-Dame cathedral in Île de la Cité, Paris, France, reopens and holds its first public mass five years after a structural fire damaged the building and destroyed its spire. French President Emmanuel Macron and dozens of world leaders attend the reopening ceremony.

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** South Korean National Police arrest former national defense minister Kim Yong-hyun and raid his home, alleging that Kim helped President Yoon Suk Yeol institute martial law.

Context: 2024 Ghanaian general election.

**Archived source account.** Former Ghanaian President and National Democratic Congress candidate John Mahama wins the presidential election as incumbent vice president and New Patriotic Party candidate Mahamudu Bawumia concedes defeat.

**Archived source account.** In auto racing, McLaren wins the World Constructors' Championship at the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, its first title since 1998.

### 2024-12-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1324709431](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2013&oldid=1324709431>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel and the Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** Syrian sources report that Israeli forces met with village dignitaries in the Yarmouk Basin area of Daraa Governorate, instructing them to surrender all weapons in the villages and for villagers to comply with home searches.

Source citations (as archived): [Erem News](<https://www.eremnews.com/news/arab-world/gd8e55c>); [Sada El-Balad](<https://www.elbalad.news/6413121>).

<a id="event-2024-12-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / US intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military evacuates American citizen Travis Timmerman out of Syria after Timmerman had previously been reported missing in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/missing-american-travis-timmerman-found-syria-released-us-forces-offic-rcna184171>).

<a id="event-2024-12-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Moldova and the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Moldova votes in favor of declaring a 60-day national state of emergency beginning on December 16 due to Ukraine not renewing its transit contract with Gazprom to deliver Russian gas to Moldova.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/moldova-declares-state-emergency-risk-russian-gas-cutoff-looms-2024-12-12/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-13-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches one of its largest attacks on the Ukrainian energy infrastructure since the conflict began, with about 290 missiles fired and drones striking multiple regions. The Russian Defense Ministry claims that the attack was in response to a recent Ukrainian ATACMS attack on Taganrog-Central air base in Rostov Oblast, Russia.

<a id="event-2024-12-16-2-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/17/world/middleeast/17syria-israel-netanyahu.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-17-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

Source citations (as archived): [JFeed](<https://www.jfeed.com/news-israel/son5ct>).

<a id="event-2024-12-17-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Operation Dawn of Freedom.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/u-s-fears-military-buildup-by-turkey-signals-preparations-for-incursion-into-syria-1c2e88e9>).

<a id="event-2024-12-17-0-11"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian Lieutenant General Igor Kirillov, head of the NBC Protection Troops, and his assistant are assassinated by an IED hidden inside of an e-scooter in Moscow, Russia. A Ukrainian source claims that the Security Service of Ukraine is responsible for the killings, after Kirillov was charged in absentia yesterday for the use of chemical weapons, which made him a "legitimate target". Dmitry Medvedev, deputy chairman of the Security Council of Russia, says that the Ukrainian leadership would face an "imminent revenge" for the killings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2ek388yxzo>); [Deccan Herald](<https://www.deccanherald.com/world/russias-medvedev-says-kyiv-will-face-imminent-revenge-for-killing-of-russian-general-ria-3321059>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2024 Syrian opposition offensives.

**Archived source account.** Iraq announces the repatriation of members of the Syrian Armed Forces who fled after the fall of the Assad regime through the Al-Qa'im border crossing, back to Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/19/iraq-starts-to-send-syrian-soldiers-back-home>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Satellite imagery reveals that Russian forces are mobilizing heavy planes at Khmeimim Air Base in Latakia Governorate and are also mobilizing ships at Tartus naval base, indicating a potential withdrawal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2ev2prep2o>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-14"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Abdul Hamid Dbeibah, the Prime Minister of the Tripoli-based Government of National Unity of Libya, denounces the entry of Russian forces from Syria into the eastern part of Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Libya Observer](<https://libyaobserver.ly/news/pm-dbeibah-rejects-entry-russian-forces-libya-coming-syria>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-15"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin says that Russia helped evacuate 4,000 Iranian fighters from Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/putin-says-russia-evacuated-4-000-iranian-fighters-from-syria/3428955>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-17"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Prosecution of Syrian civil war criminals.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Interim Government announces that they have begun preparing lists of people from the former regime who were involved in war crimes, torture, and murder.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-834146>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-20"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / December 2024 Israeli airstrikes in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Israel carries out a series of airstrikes against the Houthis in western Yemen, damaging the Ras Isa oil facility, the port of as-Salif and several power stations in Sanaa, and killing at least nine people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/israel-carries-out-air-strikes-on-yemen>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-21"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of the Treasury announces sanctions on the governor of the Central Bank of Yemen in Sanaa, Yemen, and several Houthi officials and associated companies and vessels, accusing them of trafficking dual-use weapon components and Iranian petroleum to the Houthis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/us-imposes-more-sanctions-on-yemens-houthis-amid-escalation-with-israel>); [JNS](<https://www.jns.org/us-announces-sanctions-on-19-people-entities-for-supporting-iran-houthis/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-24"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza genocide, Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch accuses Israel of committing "acts of genocide" in Gaza by damaging water supply infrastructure and depriving civilians of clean water.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/israel-accused-of-acts-of-genocide-over-gaza-water-access/a-71106235>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/human-rights-watch-says-israels-deprivation-water-gaza-is-act-genocide-2024-12-19/>); [Human Rights Watch](<https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/19/israels-crime-extermination-acts-genocide-gaza>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-27"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aids during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, United Kingdom and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** British defence secretary John Healey announces a proposal to send military advisors to train Ukrainian forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c878ypxgl3qo>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-29"></a>

Context: 2024 Parliament of Abkhazia shooting.

**Archived source account.** A lawmaker is killed and another is injured in a shooting inside the Parliament in Sukhumi, Abkhazia. The perpetrator, identified as MP and former Sukhumi mayor Adgur Kharazia, flees the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/lawmaker-shot-dead-in-parliament-in-breakaway-georgian-region-of-abkhazia>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-0-31"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Two soldiers are killed after an explosion caused by an improvised landmine at a drug laboratory in Michoacán, Mexico. Three days earlier, two other soldiers were killed and three more injured during a similar incident in Michoacán.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-explosives-soldiers-killed-ieds-bomb-michoacan-de63fe119d1d0f32154b1b47b9113a01>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Cyclone Chido in Mozambique increase to 73, including 66 in Cabo Delgado Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/cyclone-chido-death-toll-in-mozambique-rises-to-73>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** A vessel carrying approximately 80 migrants heading for Spain sinks in Moroccan waters, leaving 70 people missing and eleven survivors rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/12/26/morocco-migrant-boat-wreck-on-dec-19-left-70-missing-mali_6736472_4.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-1-5"></a>

Context: Fire at the Central Warehouse.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed during a fire at a PX Mart warehouse building under construction in Taichung, Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/taiwan-taichung-fire-px-mart-supermarket-foam-bd06e5c2992a6a048ad8203749e945eb>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-19-2-2"></a>

Context: China–India relations / Sino-Indian border dispute.

**Archived source account.** Indian national security advisor Ajit Doval and Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi meet in Beijing, China, and reach a six-point consensus to maintain peace along the border, refine border management rules, resume cross-border exchanges, and work toward resolving border disputes. A follow-up meeting is planned to be held in India next year.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/18/asia/china-india-resume-border-talks-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-2-4"></a>

Context: Georgia–United Kingdom relations, Georgia–United States relations, 2024 Georgian post-election protests.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom and the United States impose sanctions on Georgian officials, including Interior Minister Vakhtang Gomelauri, in response to alleged violent crackdowns on pro-European protests.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE](<https://efe.com/en/latest-news/2024-12-19/us-uk-sanction-georgian-minister-of-internal-affairs-over-crackdown-on-protests/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-2-6"></a>

Context: Hungary–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** Hungary grants political asylum to former Polish deputy justice minister Marcin Romanowski, who faces allegations of corruption in Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungary-grants-asylum-former-polish-deputy-minister-romanowski-says-orbans-chief-2024-12-20/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** France's Directorate-General for External Security reports that four French nationals detained in Burkina Faso on allegations of being foreign intelligence agents have been released following mediation by Morocco.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/burkina-faso-releases-french-nationals-after-detaining-year-116937449>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Northeastern United States drone sightings.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration bans the flying of drones over multiple cities in New Jersey citing "special security reasons".

Source citations (as archived): [WPVI-TV](<https://6abc.com/post/drones-restrictions-effect-amid-ongoing-sightings-new-jersey/15675675/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-3-3"></a>

Context: Deportation and removal from the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency reports 271,484 deportations in the past fiscal year, the most since 2014 and almost double of the previous fiscal year.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/immigration-deportations-trump-mexico-ice-e09b2f8b9eb5e91ebc8f143748f0021a>); [FOX News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/ice-deportations-catch-up-trump-era-numbers-fy-2024-biden-admin-comes-close>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-3-5"></a>

Context: Mazan rapes.

**Archived source account.** The Judicial Court in Avignon, France, finds Dominique Pelicot guilty of the aggravated rape of his ex-wife Gisèle Pelicot, and imposes the maximum sentence of 20 years in prison. The 50 other defendants in the case are also convicted of crimes ranging from attempted rape to aggravated rape, and receive prison sentences ranging from three to 15 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/verdict-due-gisele-pelicot-rape-case-that-horrified-world-2024-12-19/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian journalist Cecilia Sala is detained by Iranian authorities in Tehran and held at Evin Prison.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italian-journalist-cecilia-sala-detained-iran-fb8e6a9adb9ca3b5adf3943b5d146ca1>).

<a id="event-2024-12-19-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Malaysian high court acquits Rosmah Mansor, the wife of former prime minister Najib Razak, of 17 charges of money laundering and tax evasion due to insufficient evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysian-court-acquits-wife-ex-pm-najib-money-laundering-tax-evasion-2024-12-19/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aleksandar Šapić, the mayor of Belgrade, Serbia, announces the city will make all public transit free on January 1, 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/belgrade-to-make-public-transport-free-from-january-1/a-71102418>); [Novinite](<https://www.novinite.com/articles/229958/>).

### 2024-12-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1276751529](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2020&oldid=1276751529>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign / Siege of El Fasher.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Office reports that the Rapid Support Forces have killed over 782 civilians and wounded over 1,143 others in El Fasher, North Darfur, Sudan, since May, and urges the RSF to halt their incursions into the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/20/more-than-700-killed-in-siege-of-sudans-el-fasher-un-says>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-4"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign / Siege of El Fasher.

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people, mostly from the Zaghawa ethnic group, have been killed by the Rapid Support Forces in the past week in El Fasher, North Darfur State, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article294873/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).

**Archived source account.** Israeli soldiers injure a Syrian man protesting against the soldiers' presence in Ma'ariya, Daraa Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/20/israeli-forces-fire-at-syrian-protesters-in-deraa-wounding-one>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** The United States drops the $10 million terrorism bounty offered for capture of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham leader Abu Mohammad al-Julani who ousted Assad.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-united-states-austin-tice-assad-de71dc4920d4677fcfb2d31a2b6e6e54>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/after-damascus-meeting-us-drops-10-million-terror-bounty-for-new-syrian-leader/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / US intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** U.S. forces kill regional ISIS leader Abu Yusif, also known as Mahmud, in an airstrike in Deir ez-Zor Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [US CENTCOM](<https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PRESS-RELEASES/Press-Release-View/Article/4014610/centcom-forces-kill-isis-leader-during-precision-strike-in-syria/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-14"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, 2024 Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian missile strike kills six people and injures 10 others in Rylsk, Kursk Oblast, Russia, according to acting Kursk Oblast governor Alexander Khinshtein. Russia says that it will raise the issue of the missile strike at the United Nations Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-people-were-killed-wounded-ukrainian-missile-attack-kursk-region-2024-12-20/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-16"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kryvyi Rih strikes, Kyiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and eight others are injured in Russian missile strikes on civilian infrastructure in Kryvyi Rih and Kyiv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/kryvyi-rih-residential-building-hit-in-russian-rocket-attack-victims-excavated/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russian-missile-attack-kyiv-injures-two-damages-buildings-officials-say-2024-12-20/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-19"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in the Sahel / Mali War.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people are killed in attacks on six villages in Mali's Mopti Region by suspected jihadists linked to al-Qaeda and the Islamic State, who also destroy property during the assaults.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/over-20-civilians-killed-central-mali-village-attacks-2024-12-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-22"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war, Israeli settler violence.

**Archived source account.** Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in Marda, Salfit Governorate, in the occupied West Bank and deface the building's facade with anti-Arab statements, including "Death to Arabs".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/20/israeli-settlers-set-mosque-on-fire-in-occupied-west-bank>); [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/amp/news/palestinian-officials-accuse-israeli-settlers-of-mosque-arson-in-west-bank-c5cba85b>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-25"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany / 2024 Magdeburg car attack.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and over 200 others are injured in a vehicle-ramming attack at a Christmas market in Magdeburg, Germany. The suspected perpetrator is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/20/two-dead-as-car-ploughs-into-christmas-market-crowd-in-germany>); [Blick](<https://www.blick.ch/breaking-news/anschlag-in-magdeburg-auto-rast-ueber-weihnachtsmarkt-11-tote-60-verletzte-id20431562.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-0-27"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Arakan Army claims to have captured the Tatmadaw's regional headquarters in Rakhine State, Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-rakhine-arakan-army-asean-military-thailand-e1fb9ecc90d26571ec04fbc00e94fd77>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-20-1-2"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 / Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** Malaysian Minister of Transport Anthony Loke announces a new search effort for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370, which went missing in March 2014, to be conducted by American marine robotics company Ocean Infinity.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/malaysia-to-resume-search-for-missing-mh370-plane/a-71115876>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-1-4"></a>

Context: Rohingya genocide.

**Archived source account.** The Sri Lanka Navy rescues 102 Rohingya refugees, including 25 children, that were found adrift on a fishing trawler and takes them to Trincomalee, Sri Lanka.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/20/sri-lanka-navy-rescues-over-100-rohingya-adrift-in-the-indian-ocean>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/south-asia/sri-lanka-navy-rohingya-refugees-b2667829.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty-eight people are killed, 20 people are rescued, and over 100 others remain missing after a ferry capsizes while crossing the Busira River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-capsizes-busira-river-ac222ab809e107b119a8e86f1d5aa3f2>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/22/dozens-dead-after-ferry-capsizes-in-dr-congo-official>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed, 45 others are injured and 37 vehicles are destroyed after an LPG tank truck catches fire and explodes after a speeding truck crashed into it in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Statesman](<https://www.thestatesman.com/india/11-burnt-to-death-45-injured-in-lpg-tanker-truck-explosion-in-jaipur-centre-raj-govt-petroleum-co-announce-relief-1503378114.html>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-1-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and 18 others are rescued when a speedboat carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of Rhodes, Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/greece-migrations-migration-turkey-smuggling-deaths-fe8a791935f8eab2303aa16038939a5f>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Solomon Islands relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia agrees to provide Solomon Islands with financing, training, and infrastructure support worth AU$190 million (US$118 million) over four years to strengthen its police force as part of a renewed security partnership between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20241220-australia-agrees-deal-to-finance-train-solomons-police>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Hungary–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** Poland's Ministry of Foreign Affairs summons Hungary's ambassador to protest the Hungarian government's decision to grant asylum to former Polish deputy justice minister Marcin Romanowski, who is wanted under the European Arrest Warrant for alleged corruption. Poland also recalls its ambassador to Hungary Sebastian Kęciek for consultations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/poland-hungary-asylum-politician-dispute-6c528154f2ca2a67ef45fad333aa1984>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-20-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Zagreb school stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A child is killed and seven other people are injured in a mass stabbing at a primary school in Zagreb, Croatia. The 19-year-old perpetrator is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj6znexl7ljo>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Inter-American Court of Human Rights rules that El Salvador violated the human rights of a woman denied an abortion during a high-risk pregnancy in 2013 and orders the country to implement measures allowing abortions in cases where the woman's life is at risk.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/20/el-salvador-abortion-death-ruling>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guatemalan authorities rescue 160 minors from the Lev Tahor sect in Oratorio, Santa Rosa, amid allegations of human trafficking, forced marriage, and child abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/guatemalan-authorities-rescue-160-children-jewish-lev-tahor-sect-2024-12-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau files a lawsuit against banks JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo for failing to protect consumers against alleged widespread fraud on the built-in payment system Zelle equating over $870 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2024/12/20/us-consumer-watchdog-sues-big-banks-over-widespread-fraud-on-zelle-app>); [Detroit Free Press](<https://www.freep.com/story/money/personal-finance/susan-tompor/2024/12/20/zelle-bank-of-america-jp-morgan-case-wells-fargo-fraud/77102020007/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-20-4-2"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal budget / Government shutdowns in the United States, National debt of the United States, United States debt ceiling.

**Archived source account.** A funding bill ensuring full operation of the U.S. federal government service with an amendment supported by President-elect Donald Trump that would enforce a two-year suspension of the federal debt ceiling is rejected in the Republican-majority House of Representatives, with multiple Republicans and nearly all Democrats opposing the bill. A government shutdown is expected to occur if no bill is passed by midnight.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz6l9e3jq7xo>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-4-3"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal budget / Government shutdowns in the United States, National debt of the United States, United States debt ceiling.

**Archived source account.** House Speaker Mike Johnson reintroduces a funding bill without Trump's debt ceiling suspension, stating that "we will not have a government shutdown". The bill, which will fund the government until March 2025, passes the House by a vote of 336–34 and will now go to the Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/12/20/government-shutdown-bill-house-trump-musk/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-4-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Belarusian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Estonia says that it will not recognize the results of the upcoming presidential election in Belarus, which it claims has already been rigged to ensure that President Alexander Lukashenko will be re-elected.

Source citations (as archived): [ERR](<https://news.err.ee/1609556065/estonia-will-not-recognize-belarusian-presidential-elections-charade>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Italy, the Meloni government survives a confidence vote in the Chamber of Deputies on the 2025 budget.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/italy-govt-calls-confidence-vote-over-deficit-cutting-2025-budget-2024-12-19/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-20-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sam Hou Fai is sworn in as Chief Executive of Macau, succeeding Ho Iat Seng.

Source citations (as archived): [RTHK](<https://gbcode.rthk.hk/TuniS/news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1784304-20241220.htm>).

### 2024-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1271614672](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2021&oldid=1271614672>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** At least seven Ukrainian drones strike Kazan, Russia, six of which reportedly hit residential areas, including a 32-story apartment building.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrainska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/12/21/7490106/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-kazan-airport-temporarily-halts-operations-aviation-watchdog-says-2024-12-21/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-21-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the December 1 parliamentary elections, President Klaus Iohannis asks incumbent Prime Minister Marcel Ciolacu to form a new majority coalition cabinet, comprising of the Social Democratic Party, National Liberal Party and Democratic Alliance of Hungarians parties. The government is named and confirmed by the Chamber of Deputies, and takes office the same day.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20241224-romania-forms-new-pro-european-coalition-government-amid-political-crisis>).

<a id="event-2024-12-23-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Greek government restores citizenship to ten members of the former royal family, including the children and grandchildren of King Constantine II, following their agreement to adopt the surname "De Grece", renounce royal claims, and formally recognize Greece's status as a parliamentary democracy.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/greece-royal-family-citizenship-constantine-caf79e9ca01a799fc9b68adb5b134b14>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-12-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of scientists at the North-Eastern Federal University in Sakha Republic, Russia, unveil the highly preserved remains of a 50,000-year-old female juvenile woolly mammoth named Yana. The researchers say Yana was roughly about one-year-old when she died, likely from drowning, and was discovered in the Batagaika crater by locals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy47xj4lpyzo>).

### 2024-12-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1326819173](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2025&oldid=1326819173>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Siege of North Gaza, Gaza famine.

**Archived source account.** The United States-funded Famine Early Warning Systems Network removes a report estimating that food insecurity conditions in northern Gaza have surpassed the highest IPC famine thresholds, after the United States envoy to Israel criticized the report's methodology as "irresponsible" for "outdated" and "inflated" estimates of the civilian population of Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [FEWS NET](<https://archive.is/0LFkL>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-backed-monitor-takes-down-report-alleging-north-gaza-famine-after-objections/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / Constitutional crisis in Somalia / Jubaland crisis.

**Archived source account.** The federal government of Somalia imposes a flight ban on Jubaland, including all flights to and from Jubaland, particularly affecting the cities of Kismayo and Doolow. The flight ban was initiated amid ongoing political tensions and military engagements after Jubaland forces reportedly defeated Somali Armed Forces in several locations, including Ras Kamboni, Kulbiyow, and Dolow.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-fgs-s-aerial-lockdown-on-jubaland-sparks-new-conflict-strands-travelers>); [The Somali Digest](<https://thesomalidigest.com/fgs-imposes-flight-ban-on-jubaland-amid-military-setbacks/>); [The Eastleigh Voice](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/99577/somalia-bans-flights-to-jubaland-as-tensions-escalate>).

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure, Ukrainian energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** A series of Russian ballistic missile and drone strikes target critical energy infrastructure in cities across in Ukraine, killing at least two people, injuring 20 others, and causing widespread emergency blackouts. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemns Russian President Vladimir Putin for the "inhumane" attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/russia-terrorizes-ukraine-with-mass-missile-drone-attack-on-christmas-morning/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/25/russia-christmas-day-attack-ukraine-energy-system>); [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2024/1225/1488087-ukraine-russia/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-13"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / 2024 famine in Sudan.

**Archived source account.** The IPC Famine Review Committee determines the presence of famine in five areas in Darfur and South Kordofan, Sudan, and estimates that five more areas will face famine by May 2025 due to ongoing conflict and blocked aid distribution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News Hausa](<https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cr567y3117vo>).

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-16"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Western Syria clashes.

**Archived source account.** Syria's new government says that fourteen of its troops were killed and 10 others were injured in clashes with Assad regime loyalists in Tartus Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0ew5g3vzreo>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-forces-suffer-14-fatalities-tartous-clashes-2024-12-25/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-25-0-18"></a>

Context: Ethiopian civil conflict.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian military forces close the country's border with Somalia following ongoing heavy fighting in rural areas of Harshin, Fafan Zone, between Ethiopia's Somali regional forces and local clan militias after the killing of a local security chief and his bodyguards. Hundreds of people, including children, flee from their homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Dec/199528/ethiopian_military_closes_border_with_somaliland_as_fighting_erupts_in_somali_region.aspx>); [Somali Guardian](<https://somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/tensions-soar-along-ethiopia-somaliland-border-as-clashes-resume/>).

### 2024-12-27

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / Constitutional crisis in Somalia / Ethiopian–Somali conflict, 2024 Ethiopia–Somaliland memorandum of understanding.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council approves the Resolution 2767 deployment of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), effective January 1, replacing the current African Union Transition Mission in Somalia. However, Somalia rejects Ethiopia's participation in AUSSOM amid tensions over a memorandum of understanding that Ethiopia signed with Somaliland in January. Somalia considers the memorandum a violation of its sovereignty and has instead asked Egypt to contribute troops to the mission.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/un-security-council-authorizes-new-somalia-peacekeeping-mission-2024-12-27/>); [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/un-security-council-approves-new-african-union-mission-for-somalia-aussom/>); [UNSC](<https://press.un.org/en/2024/sc15955.doc.htm>).
