Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/the-worlds-oldest-living-person-is-now-a-football-loving-nun-from-brazil-13284345>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Cambodia–Philippines relations.

**Archived source account.** Cambodia pardons and repatriates 13 Filipino women who were convicted of human trafficking for participating in a surrogacy scheme prohibited under Cambodian law.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-12-29/cambodia-pardons-jailed-surrogate-filipino-mothers/104769854>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Chadian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Chad elect the 188 members of the National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/28/voting-begins-in-chad-as-opposition-parties-call-for-election-boycott>).

<a id="event-2024-12-29-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Croatian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Croatians vote to elect the President between incumbent Zoran Milanović and seven other candidates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/croats-vote-elect-new-president-2024-12-29/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-29-4-5"></a>

Context: 2024 Georgian post-election protests.

**Archived source account.** Mikheil Kavelashvili is inaugurated as the 6th President of Georgia, with outgoing president Salome Zourabichvili announcing that she would vacate her residence at the Orbeliani Palace in Tbilisi. Zourabichvili continues to claim that the new presidency is illegitimate and calls for continued protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/georgia-pro-russia-protest-salome-zourabichvili-georgian-dream-party-mikheil-kavelashvili/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/georgia-president-zourabichvili-russia-kavelashvili-215020983cefb6ce1eb2ecad184a9c1e>).

<a id="event-2024-12-29-4-7"></a>

Context: Death and state funeral of Jimmy Carter.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter dies at the age of 100 in Plains, Georgia, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpww85w5p30o>).

<a id="event-2024-12-29-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** At the conclusion of the annual year-end general meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the appointment of Pak Thae-song to replace Kim Tok-hun in the post of Prime Minister of North Korea is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20241229000500315?section=nk/nk>).

### 2024-12-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1283170099](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2030&oldid=1283170099>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine exchange hundreds of prisoners of war in a deal brokered by the United Arab Emirates. Ukraine says that many of those released by Russia are soldiers captured during the Siege of Mariupol in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c938x3v148yo>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese government says at least nine people are killed and 121 others injured in shelling by the Rapid Support Forces in Khartoum.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article295274/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli invasion of Syria.

**Archived source account.** Israel Defense Forces operating in the Syrian side of the 1974 buffer zone, in Quneitra Governorate, advance into the Syrian town of Madinat al-Baath.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/reports-idf-troops-advance-in-syria-buffer-zone-search-government-buildings-in-madinat-al-baath/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Trinidad and Tobago declares a state of emergency as gang violence escalates in the country, after five people were shot dead at a shop in Laventille, Port of Spain, the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgnzg40p7eo>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/30/trinidad-and-tobago-announces-state-of-emergency-to-combat-gang-violence>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2024-12-30-1-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Fall of the Assad regime.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian transitional government appoints Maysaa Sabreen as the first female governor of the Central Bank of Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-new-rulers-appoint-maysaa-sabrine-lead-central-bank-official-says-2024-12-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-1-4"></a>

Context: Moldova–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Moldovan prime minister Dorin Recean states his country is envisaging the possible nationalization of the Moldovagaz energy company, which Russia's Gazprom owns 50% of, following the announcement by Gazprom that the current gas supply deal that expires on December 31 will not be renewed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/moldova-prepares-possible-moldovagaz-nationalisation-2024-12-30/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Pakistan, ten people are killed and seven are injured in a bus crash on a highway in Fateh Jang, Punjab. Separately, eight people are killed during a van–truck collision in Naushahro Feroze, Sindh.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-speeding-bus-highway-accidents-83e8bcef3bc9ce2ca8531487a991ef0c>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three tourists are killed and seven others are injured in a fire at a hotel on Khaosan Road in Bangkok, Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-ember-hotel-fire-tourism-khao-san-road-0d335679d5c8bc1ebf1161c6b6d36683>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Syria–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Syria says that it hopes to form a "strategic partnership" with Ukraine following a high-level meeting in Damascus, Syria, between Syria's de-facto leader Ahmed al-Sharaa and Ukrainian foreign minister Andrii Sybiha, where the two countries re-established diplomatic relations. Ukraine also vowed to send additional food aid to Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/syrias-de-facto-leader-hosts-ukraines-foreign-minister-sana-says-2024-12-30/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials formally requests an arrest warrant for impeached South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol over his declaration of martial law.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/skorea-joint-investigation-unit-requests-arrest-warrant-yoon-over-martial-law-2024-12-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan prosecutor general Tarek William Saab announces the release of 413 protesters from prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-free-additional-413-election-protesters-2024-12-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-5"></a>

Context: Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Second Circuit Court of Appeals upholds a jury verdict finding Donald Trump liable for sexual abuse and defamation in E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2024/12/30/trump-e-jean-carroll-sexual-abuse-defamation-appeal/75680589007/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-7"></a>

Context: Yazidi genocide.

**Archived source account.** Germany's federal prosecutor charges an Iraqi couple, allegedly members of the Islamic State, with enslavement, torture, and war crimes, after they allegedly kept two Yazidi girls as slaves and sexually and physically abused them.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-iraqi-couple-accused-of-abusing-yazidi-girls/a-71186224>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Argentine judge issues arrest warrants for Nicaraguan president Daniel Ortega, Vice President Rosario Murillo, and several others for alleged crimes against humanity, invoking universal jurisdiction.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2584792/world>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuba releases Salvadoran national Raúl Ernesto Cruz León after he completed a 30-year prison sentence for his involvement in the 1997 hotel bombings.

Source citations (as archived): [BSS](<https://www.bssnews.net/international/234693>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Venezuela fines social media platform TikTok $10 million for "not implementing measures" to prevent viral challenges that allegedly led to the death of three children.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-tiktok-viral-video-childrens-deaths-c2e9a4d6f7387c72d0c53b881c54786d>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2024-12-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Death and state funeral of Jimmy Carter.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Joe Biden orders a state funeral for former president Jimmy Carter to be held in Washington, D.C. on January 9. Biden also orders flags to be lowered to half-staff for thirty days in accordance with federal law.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/ce98937nrqrt>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban government of Afghanistan announces it will close all national and foreign nongovernmental organizations in the country that currently employ women.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-ngo-women-closure-1fde989369785f8df0e83c81d48626f1>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenya Police fire tear gas at demonstrators in Nairobi protesting against alleged government extrajudicial abductions in the past few months.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/30/kenya-police-fire-tear-gas-at-protest-against-alleged-government-abductions>).

<a id="event-2024-12-30-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Bongbong Marcos signs an order removing Vice President Sara Duterte and former presidents from the National Security Council, allowing the president to appoint other officials and private citizens as members.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-marcos-drops-estranged-vp-duterte-security-council-2025-01-03/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2024-12-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully launches its Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle rocket carrying the Space Docking Experiment twin satellite mission from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Andhra Pradesh, with the satellites expected to perform a docking maneuver on January 7, 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-successfully-launches-its-first-space-docking-mission/a-71187928>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/isro-launches-space-docking-satellites-india-on-path-to-elite-club-pslv-last-stage-has-24-payloads/articleshow/116805228.cms>).

### 2024-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1277418669](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2024%20December%2031&oldid=1277418669>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2024-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Opération Chammal.

**Archived source account.** The French Air Force conducts airstrikes against several Islamic State targets in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Parisien](<https://www.leparisien.fr/international/syrie/syrie-larmee-francaise-a-effectue-des-frappes-contre-des-sites-de-daech-31-12-2024-XVZZ5KOH35AV3BA22FWBH5GJJQ.php>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-0-4"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Somali Civil War, Puntland military offensives into ISIS.

**Archived source account.** Ten Islamic State militants are killed by Puntland forces in an attempted attack involving suicide bombers on a military base in Dharjaale, Bari, Puntland, Somalia. This comes after the semi-autonomous region of Puntland announced a military offensive against the Islamic State and Al-Shabaab.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/foreign-fighters-killed-in-foiled-isis-attack-in-somalia-s-puntland>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalia-security-forces-repulse-suicide-attack-by-islamic-state-2024-12-31/>); [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-forces-neutralize-isis-militant-attack-in-dharjaale-of-bari-region/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States Air Force launches at least 12 airstrikes in Sanaa, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/12/31/live-seventh-palestinian-freezes-to-death-in-gaza-amid-israeli-siege?update=3416457>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2024-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One crew member is killed and two others are missing after a cargo ship sinks in the San Bernardino Strait near Samar, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [News Central](<https://newscentral.africa/cargo-ship-sinks-in-philippines-one-dead-two-missing/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico experiences a power outage, impacting 1.3 million clients.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/31/us/puerto-rico-power-blackout.html/>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna185849/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2024-12-31-2-2"></a>

Context: French military withdrawal from West Africa / France–Ivory Coast relations.

**Archived source account.** In his New Year's speech, Ivorian President Alassane Ouattara announces that the French military base in Abidjan will be handed over to the Ivorian Government in January.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/fr/afrique/20241231-la-base-de-l-arm%C3%A9e-fran%C3%A7aise-%C3%A0-abidjan-sera-r%C3%A9troc%C3%A9d%C3%A9e-%C3%A0-la-c%C3%B4te-d-ivoire-en-janvier>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-2-4"></a>

Context: French military withdrawal from West Africa / France–Senegal relations.

**Archived source account.** In his New Year's speech, Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye announces the closure of French military facilities and the withdrawal of all foreign military forces from Senegal beginning in 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Figaro](<https://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-actu/le-senegal-annonce-la-fin-de-toutes-presences-militaires-etrangeres-des-2025-20241231>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Ecuadorian conflict.

**Archived source account.** An Ecuadorian judge issues arrest warrants for 16 soldiers accused of the disappearance and murder of four children in Guayaquil after genetic tests confirm the charred remains found near a military base belong to the missing victims.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-violence-missing-children-military-charged-cb6c5eacce2c92cdb085bf8ea97b5c43>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-3"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Seoul Western District Court issues an arrest warrant for impeached president Yoon Suk Yeol.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2024/12/31/asia-pacific/politics/south-korea-yoon-arrest-warrant/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-5"></a>

Context: Belgrade school shooting.

**Archived source account.** A Serbian court sentences the parents of a boy who killed 10 people in a Belgrade primary school in 2023 to over 14 years and three years in prison, respectively, for child neglect and abuse, and also sentences a shooting range instructor to 1 and a half years for perjury.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbian-court-sentences-parents-boy-mass-shooter-2024-12-30/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-7"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Zimbabwe.

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe approves a law abolishing the death penalty in the country, effective immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn8gqz7n559o>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-9"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict, Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** A military tribunal in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, sentences 13 soldiers to death for charges including murder, looting, and cowardice, following territorial losses attributed to desertion during the conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-sentences-13-soldiers-death-bid-boost-discipline-2025-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are wounded during a mass stabbing amid New Year's Eve celebrations in Verucchio, Province of Rimini, Italy. The perpetrator is shot dead by a soldier. The perpetrator was carrying a Koran and an Islamic prayer cap, while also possessing antipsychotic drugs at his residence.

Source citations (as archived): [Il Resto del Carlino](<https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/rimini/cronaca/terrore-coltello-carabinieri-sparano-uccidono-jb1zyqh2>).

<a id="event-2024-12-31-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man steals an excavator in Grünsfeld, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, and rams the excavator against vehicles, injuring four police officers, before being shot dead.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/police-shoot-dead-man-on-suspected-rampage-with-excavator/a-71191556>).
